title_translated: 探索稀疏自编码器在基于文本的因果混杂调整中的应用
summary_translated: 在许多场景中，基于文本数据研究因果问题需要对文本中的混杂信息进行调整。然而，在构建文本表示用于调整时存在权衡：表示必须足够大和/或密集以保留必要的混杂变量以实现无偏效应估计，但又必须足够小和/或稀疏以满足有限样本重叠并获得低方差估计。为解决这一权衡，我们转向稀疏自编码器（SAEs），并提出一种新颖的因果调整流程，通过条件独立性检验迭代选择最小的SAE特征集。我们发现，在具有二元混杂变量的标准半合成评估中，SAE表示比其他表示实现更好的调整效果（更低偏差、更高覆盖率），且其可解释性为 falsification 提供了机会。我们还引入了一种更真实的半合成评估，使用多标签数据作为未观测混杂变量，发现现有调整方法在这些更复杂设置下需进一步深入研究。

summary: Deep-research agents answer complex questions by interacting with search and browsing tools, yet they often search along a single evolving trajectory. Our trajectory-level analysis reveals a common failure mode in which the agent may encounter an early search state with several plausible directions, but follow one direction before collecting enough comparative evidence. Once this happens, subsequent tool calls tend to reinforce the same path, increasing the chance of failure when the initial direction is misleading. We further find that successful trajectories reduce this risk through two behaviors: grounding vague exploration in concrete candidates and shifting directions when the current path is weak or incomplete. Based on these findings, we propose HypoSearch, which generates lightweight hypotheses as soft search hints, explores them through bounded independent branches, and compares branch-level evidence before commitment. Across four deep-research benchmarks and three backbone models, HypoSearch consistently outperforms single-trajectory search and standard parallel baselines, improving Qwen3.5-122B from 46.7 to 60.0 on BC-small while using fewer tool calls than five independent trajectories. A pilot supervised fine-tuning study further shows that these behavioral signals can curate compact training trajectories and reduce degradation from unfiltered data.
title: Explore Before Committing: Hypothesis-Guided Search for Deep Research Agents
title_translated: 探索后再决定：基于假设引导的深度研究智能体搜索方法
summary_translated: 深度研究智能体通过与搜索和浏览工具交互来回答复杂问题，但通常沿着单一不断演进的轨迹进行搜索。我们的轨迹级分析揭示了一种常见失败模式：智能体可能在早期搜索状态中遇到多个合理的方向，但在收集足够比较证据前就选择了一个方向。一旦发生这种情况，后续的工具调用往往会强化同一路径，当初始方向具有误导性时，失败概率显著增加。我们进一步发现，成功的轨迹通过两种行为降低这一风险：将模糊探索建立在具体候选对象基础上，并在当前路径薄弱或不完整时及时转向。基于这些发现，我们提出了HypoSearch方法，该方法生成轻量级假设作为软搜索提示，通过有界独立分支进行探索，并在做出决策前比较各分支的证据。在四个深度研究基准和三种主干模型上，HypoSearch始终优于单轨迹搜索和标准并行基线方法，在BC-small数据集上将Qwen3.5-122B的性能从46.7提升至60.0，同时使用的工具调用次数少于五个独立轨迹。一次初步的监督微调研究还表明，这些行为信号可用于构建紧凑的训练轨迹，并减少未经过滤数据带来的性能退化。

summary: Emotion is expressed in text along a wide spectrum, from surface lexical cues to inferences entangled with content. Most layer-wise analyses of emotion in LLMs use a single corpus, leaving open whether the depth at which emotion becomes accessible is a property of the model or also of the text source. We investigate this across three datasets spanning different degrees of explicitness and contextualization in emotion expression (Twitter posts, Reddit comments, and autobiographical narratives) and eight 1B--9B open-weight LLMs from the Llama, Qwen, and Granite families. We combine layer-wise probing with offline feature scaling and online forward interventions, transfer analyses, and an early-exit classifier. We find that (i) the best probing layer shifts systematically across corpora, from input-adjacent layers to over half model depth, and this ordering persists after matching label-by-length-bin distributions; (ii) across the evaluated settings, forward-pass interventions on probe-selected bands reduce test accuracy by 5--6 points more than same-width random bands ($q < 0.01$); (iii) selected bands transfer across datasets and emotion categories, suggesting partially shared affective information rather than strictly per-emotion substrates; and (iv) probe-selected early-exit representations outperform full-depth exits by $6.9$ percentage points on average.
title: Some Emotions Run Deeper: Layer-wise Probing and Causal Intervention in Large Language Models
title_translated: 某些情绪更深：大语言模型中的分层探测与因果干预
summary_translated: 情感在文本中以广泛谱系表达，从表面词汇线索到与内容交织的推断。大多数针对大语言模型（LLM）中情感的分层分析仅使用单一语料库，因此无法确定情感可访问性的深度是模型本身的属性，还是也受文本来源影响。我们在三个涵盖不同情感表达显性程度和上下文化水平的数据集（推特帖子、Reddit评论和自传叙事）以及来自Llama、Qwen和Granite系列的八款1B–9B开源LLM上进行了研究。我们结合分层探测、离线特征缩放、在线前向干预、迁移分析和早期退出分类器。研究发现：(i) 最佳探测层在不同语料库间系统性地变化，从靠近输入的层延伸至超过模型深度一半的位置，且在按长度分箱标签分布匹配后该顺序依然保持；(ii) 在所有评估设置中，对探测选定区域的前向传递干预导致测试准确率下降5–6个百分点，显著高于相同宽度随机区域（q < 0.01）；(iii) 选定区域在不同数据集和情感类别间具有可迁移性，表明情感信息部分共享而非严格按情感划分；(iv) 探测选定的早期退出表示平均比全深度退出高出6.9个百分点。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies over a shared budgeted operating space, scored post hoc with pass@$k$, self-consistency, best-of-$N$, and first-finish success. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo, we ask whether an RL default-policy curve can be approximated by a structured path of Base operating points. On Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval, the pass@$k$ recovery path follows a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule (BOPTR), $N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx αN_{\mathrm{RL}}^β$, with benchmark-conditioned exponents. On Qwen2.5-7B, BOPTR gives the lowest transfer error among the non-oracle rules we test, 3.41 pp (95% CI [2.32, 5.53]); a three-seed replication gives 3.07 $\pm$ 0.39 pp. The rule extends to ten models across four families (3.28 to 4.87 pp on checkpoints added after fitting), to four benchmarks it was never fitted on (5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp in fit), and holds without an RL checkpoint for the target model (4.19 pp) or without RL supervision of any kind (5.08 pp). These results support a qualified internalized-search reading: under the recipe we test, much of the measured RL gain corresponds to a change in sampling efficiency toward operating points the base model can already reach under search. We treat the scaling patterns as descriptive of this recipe and cohort, report where they break down, and use UDF and BOPTR as behavioral diagnostics rather than evidence of parameter-level equivalence.
title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
title_translated: 从基础采样到强化学习推理：预算搜索视角下的分析
summary_translated: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但这种提升与推理时解码和搜索的关系仍不明确。强化学习是否创造了基础模型原本缺乏的推理能力，还是仅仅将采样分布推向了基础模型本可达到却极少采样的轨迹？我们通过统一解码框架（UDF）从行为角度研究这一问题，该框架将词级采样、类束搜索、树搜索和序列级重采样统一为共享预算空间上的可执行策略，并以pass@$k$、自洽性、best-of-$N$和首次完成成功率等指标进行事后评分。利用SimpleRL-Zoo提供的基础/强化学习检查点配对，我们探讨强化学习默认策略曲线能否由基础模型的操作点构成的结构化路径近似。在Math500、AIME、GPQA和IFEval上，pass@$k$恢复路径遵循预算操作点转移规则（BOPTR），即$N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx αN_{\mathrm{RL}}^β$，其指数由基准条件决定。在Qwen2.5-7B上，BOPTR在所测试的非Oracle规则中误差最低，为3.41 pp（95% CI [2.32, 5.53]）；三次种子复制结果为3.07 ± 0.39 pp。该规则扩展至四个系列共十款模型（拟合后添加检查点的误差为3.28至4.87 pp），适用于从未用于拟合的四个基准（拟合内为4.44 pp，外推为5.03 pp），且无需目标模型的强化学习检查点或任何形式的强化学习监督也能成立（误差分别为4.19 pp和5.08 pp）。这些结果支持一种“内部化搜索”的限定解释：在我们测试的范式下，大部分测量到的强化学习增益对应于采样效率的提升，即向基础模型已能到达但很少采样的操作点靠拢。我们将这些缩放模式视为对该范式和群体的描述性总结，报告其失效情况，并将UDF和BOPTR用作行为诊断工具，而非参数等价性的证据。

summary: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily optimized for written text, often producing outputs that are grammatically correct and helpful yet poorly suited for spoken delivery via Text-to-Speech (TTS). In this work, we study how to make LLMs natively generate TTS-friendly text, which we frame as a preference alignment problem: instead of relying on downstream rewriting modules, we directly align LLMs to generate text optimized for spoken delivery. We introduce two preference datasets spanning different target domains, CORA and Recipe, which contain paired TTS-friendly and TTS-unfriendly responses. We further propose an evaluation suite combining a pattern-based heuristic metric, a TTS$\to$ASR evaluation pipeline, and a MUSHRA listening study with human judges. Our experiments compare the recently proposed Feature-aware Sampling and Tuning (FaST) framework -- leveraging interpretable features instead of a black-box reward model -- against an array of alignment baselines on the TTS-friendly generation task. Notably, we found that FaST achieves the best overall tradeoff between TTS-friendliness and helpfulness across various settings. We also identified a strong correlation between our different metrics, highlighting the ability to reliably assess TTS-friendliness via an efficient heuristic.
title: Ready to Speak: Aligning LLMs for TTS-Friendly Text Generation
title_translated: 准备发声：面向语音合成友好文本生成的大语言模型对齐
summary_translated: 当前的大语言模型（LLM）主要针对书面文本优化，常生成语法正确但不适合通过文本转语音（TTS）进行口语化表达的内容。本文研究如何使LLM原生生成适合TTS的文本，将其定义为偏好对齐问题：不再依赖下游重写模块，而是直接对齐LLM以生成优化于口语表达的文本。我们引入两个覆盖不同目标领域的偏好数据集CORA和Recipe，包含成对的TTS友好与TTS不友好响应。我们还提出一个评估套件，结合基于模式的启发式度量、TTS→ASR评估流水线以及由人类评委参与的MUSHRA听觉实验。我们的实验对比了最近提出的特征感知采样与调优（FaST）框架——利用可解释特征而非黑盒奖励模型——与多种对齐基线在TTS友好生成任务上的表现。值得注意的是，FaST在各种设置下均实现了TTS友好性与有用性之间的最佳权衡。我们还发现不同度量之间存在强相关性，表明可通过高效启发式方法可靠评估TTS友好性。

summary: Clinical trials are essential for advancing cancer care and drug development, but many fail because of insufficient patient enrollment. While there is growing interest in using AI to support patient recruitment, existing systems largely perform eligibility assessment alone and have rarely been evaluated in real-world oncology workflows. Here we present TrialGPT 2.0, an AI-assisted clinical trial recommendation system designed for real-world deployment. Rather than asking only whether a patient may qualify, the system also assesses which trials warrant further consideration given the patient's current clinical needs and local workflow priorities, and provides structured, inspectable explanations for expert review. Importantly, we evaluated TrialGPT 2.0 retrospectively and prospectively across multiple oncology-focused settings, spanning government, academic cancer-center, patient-advocacy, and NIH referral workflows. In retrospective multicenter cohorts comprising 288 cases, TrialGPT 2.0 retrieved at least one clinician-recommended trial in its top 10 recommendations for approximately 91% of cases while reducing clinician screening time by 55.0%. In a six-month prospective evaluation embedded in an active precision oncology tumor board, TrialGPT 2.0 contributed additional trial opportunities missed by the routine workflow, expanding patient access to clinical trial participation by 90.9%. To support scientific reproducibility, we also introduce NIH-TrialBench, a clinician-authored dataset comprising 126 diverse synthetic patient vignettes and matching scenarios from 11 NIH Institutes and Centers. Together, these results support the value of AI to assist clinical trial matching by improving clinician efficiency and identifying frequently overlooked trial opportunities, ultimately helping to expand and accelerate accrual to cancer trials.
title: Towards AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Matching: Practical Considerations, Multicenter Evaluation, and Real-World Deployment
title_translated: 迈向AI辅助临床试验匹配：实际考量、多中心评估与真实世界部署
summary_translated: 临床试验对于推进癌症治疗和药物研发至关重要，但许多试验因患者招募不足而失败。尽管越来越多关注使用AI支持患者招募，现有系统大多仅执行资格评估，且极少在真实肿瘤学工作流中进行评估。本文介绍TrialGPT 2.0，一个专为真实世界部署设计的AI辅助临床试验推荐系统。该系统不仅判断患者是否符合资格，还评估在患者当前临床需求和本地工作流程优先级下哪些试验值得进一步考虑，并提供结构化、可审查的解释供专家审阅。重要的是，我们在多个聚焦肿瘤学的场景中进行了回顾性和前瞻性评估，涵盖政府、学术癌症中心、患者倡导组织及NIH转诊流程。在包含288例病例的回顾性多中心队列中，TrialGPT 2.0在前10项推荐中至少检索到一名临床医生推荐的试验，覆盖约91%的病例，同时将临床医生筛选时间减少55.0%。在为期六个月的前瞻性评估中，嵌入活跃精准肿瘤学肿瘤委员会的工作流程，TrialGPT 2.0发现了常规流程遗漏的额外试验机会，使患者参与临床试验的机会扩大了90.9%。为支持科学可复现性，我们还推出了NIH-TrialBench，一个由临床医生撰写的包含126个多样化合成患者案例及其匹配场景的数据集，来自11个NIH研究所和中心。这些结果共同支持AI在辅助临床试验匹配方面的价值，通过提升临床医生效率并识别常被忽视的试验机会，最终帮助扩大和加速癌症试验的入组。

summary: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can serve as strong matchers across domains, but most methods either make independent pairwise decisions or rely on manually designed composite pipelines, thus lacking flexibility in realistic multi-candidate settings. At the same time, they typically ignore inference cost at scale. We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations. Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality-cost objective. The policy interacts with abstract operators, allowing the same controller to be reused with different underlying LLM backends at inference time without retraining. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that CaRL-EM (i) learns to dynamically plan the usage of inexpensive and expensive operators based on task complexity, (ii) achieves robust zero-shot transfer across diverse datasets and domains, and (iii) consistently achieves a better quality-cost trade-off than strong LLM-based baselines and manually designed pipelines, yielding a lower inference cost at comparable or higher quality.
title: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
title_translated: CaRL-EM：基于大语言模型的实体匹配中考虑成本的强化学习
summary_translated: 实体匹配（EM）需要精细的上下文理解与领域知识。近期研究表明，大语言模型（LLMs）可在跨领域场景中作为强大的匹配器，但大多数方法要么独立进行成对决策，要么依赖手动设计的复合流程，因此在现实中的多候选场景下缺乏灵活性。同时，它们通常忽略大规模推理时的计算成本。本文将带有候选集的基于LLM的EM建模为一个考虑成本的序列决策问题，并提出CaRL-EM，一种用于管理LLM操作的强化学习控制器。给定锚记录的状态、其候选集及成本信息，CaRL-EM可自适应地在不同操作符（匹配/比较/选择/决定）和模型容量之间进行选择，以最大化质量-成本目标。该策略与抽象操作符交互，使得同一控制器可在推理时无需重新训练即可适配不同的底层LLM后端。在7个基准数据集上的实验表明，CaRL-EM（i）能够根据任务复杂度动态规划低成本与高成本操作符的使用；（ii）在多样数据集和领域间实现稳健的零样本迁移；（iii）始终在质量-成本权衡上优于强基线方法和人工设计的流程，在保持或提升质量的同时显著降低推理成本。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing digital communication by powering conversational agents deployed across domains such as customer service, digital sales, and insurance. These agents, built on LLMs, can understand user input, retrieve relevant information, and generate coherent responses. However, while they excel at factual communication, they often lack the ability to engage in truly persuasive, context-sensitive dialogue, especially in domains like insurance, where trust and clarity are critical. Building on this need within the insurance domain, our work focuses on improving the persuasiveness of digital agents, aka LLMs. To support this, we introduce InsureDial, a Persuasive Insurance Dialogue dataset, designed to capture the nuances of persuasive communication specific to motor insurance interactions. We introduce PersuaRL, a reinforcement learning-based framework that equips LLM-driven dialogue agents with the ability to adaptively explore, select, and coordinate strategies across multiple expert modules, guided by the evolving dialogue context, to achieve more effective persuasion. We conduct extensive automatic human and qualitative evaluations on two benchmark persuasion dialogue datasets, including our InsureDial. Our evaluations consistently demonstrate that PersuaRL outperforms baseline, generating contextually appropriate and highly persuasive responses.
title: PersuaRL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multi-Expert Selection for Persuasive Dialogue Generation in Insurance
title_translated: PersuaRL：面向保险领域说服性对话生成的强化学习驱动多专家选择框架
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）正在革新数字通信，推动客服、数字销售及保险等领域中对话代理的发展。这些基于LLM的代理能够理解用户输入、检索相关信息并生成连贯回复。然而，尽管它们在事实性沟通方面表现优异，却往往缺乏真正具有说服力且情境敏感的对话能力，尤其在保险等高度依赖信任与清晰表达的领域。针对保险领域的这一需求，本研究致力于提升数字代理（即LLMs）的说服力。为此，我们构建了InsureDial——一个专门用于捕捉机动车保险互动中说服性沟通细微差别的说服性保险对话数据集。我们提出了PersuaRL，一种基于强化学习的框架，使LLM驱动的对话代理能够根据不断演化的对话上下文，自适应地探索、选择并协调多个专家模块的策略，从而实现更有效的说服。我们在两个基准说服性对话数据集（包括我们的InsureDial）上进行了广泛的自动评估与人工定性分析。结果一致表明，PersuaRL优于基线方法，生成了情境恰当且高度有说服力的回应。

summary: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, coloring every claim supported, refuted, or insufficient (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026). On a uniform random sample the true rate is 68.4% - more than 21 pp below MMLU - with 30.5% of claims insufficient: assertions no benchmark probes and the world's largest encyclopedia cannot adjudicate - long-tail knowledge or plausible hallucination, the evidence cannot tell - extending to free text the coverage gap GPTKB established for triples (Hu et al., 2025). The resulting live, open encyclopedia lets visitors inspect this frontier one claim at a time through five one-click views - link-traversal exploration, claim-level factuality, cross-model and political-persona comparison, and a guided topic drill-down - each page, claim, and verdict at a stable URL. LLMPEDIA is live at https://llmpedia.net
title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
title_translated: LLMPEDIA：浏览、验证与比较大语言模型的参数化百科知识
summary_translated: 旗舰级语言模型在MMLU等基准测试中得分已超过90%，看似已趋于饱和——但这些基准仅测试研究者预设的问题，存在固定题集带来的可用性偏差。LLMPEDIA使这种偏差可测量、可浏览。我们通过递归方式从三个模型家族（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B）的参数记忆中无检索地生成约130万篇文章，随后对分层抽样的原子命题进行审计，依据维基百科和精选网络资源判断其支持、反驳或证据不足（Saeed and Razniewski, 2026）。在均匀随机样本中，真实命题比例仅为68.4%，比MMLU低超过21个百分点，其中30.5%的命题缺乏足够证据：这些断言既未被任何基准探测到，也无法由全球最大的百科全书裁定——属于长尾知识或合理幻觉，证据无法辨别，这扩展了GPTKB在三元组层面建立的覆盖差距（Hu et al., 2025）至自由文本。由此形成的实时开放百科全书允许访问者通过五个一键视图逐条检视这一前沿：链接遍历探索、命题级真实性、跨模型与政治人格对比、以及引导式主题钻取——每一页、每一命题与每一条裁决均拥有稳定URL。LLMPEDIA现已上线：https://llmpedia.net

summary: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisation during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-based model that jointly learns to generate and tokenise masked words. We train both for the Strict and Strict-small tracks. Our top submission to Strict is SubSegDeBERTa, which achieves notable gains in zero-shot evaluation. Our top submission to Strict-small is SubSegGPT, which outperforms tokenisation-based baselines. Our results show that learnable subword tokenisation can improve sample-efficiency for BabyLM pretraining. We analyse the subword learning dynamics of our models and find that tokenisation gradually converges on subword units that balance morphological alignment and fine-grained segmentation.
title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
title_translated: 子词分段BabyLM：为高效预训练学习分词
summary_translated: 在标准语言模型训练流程中，子词分词作为预处理步骤执行。子词分段语言建模是一种替代范式，其中分词过程在训练期间被学习，使模型能发现优化自身训练目标的子词单元。本文提交了2026年BabyLM挑战赛的两项新子词分段语言模型：SubSegGPT与SubSegDeBERTa。SubSegGPT是一个仅解码器模型，在自回归预训练过程中学习分词；SubSegDeBERTa是一个编码器模型，联合学习掩码词的生成与分词。我们分别在Strict与Strict-small赛道进行训练。在Strict赛道中，最佳提交为SubSegDeBERTa，其在零样本评估中取得显著提升；在Strict-small赛道中，最佳提交为SubSegGPT，其表现优于基于分词的基线方法。结果表明，可学习的子词分词能提升BabyLM预训练的样本效率。我们分析了模型的子词学习动态，发现分词逐渐收敛于在形态一致性与细粒度分割之间取得平衡的子词单元。

summary: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework has emerged as a promising solution for cheap, reproducible, reference-free Natural Language Generation (NLG) evaluation. Prior work seeks to improve LLMaJ by decomposing evaluation tasks into simpler sub-tasks. In this work, we systematically compare LLMaJ methods with and without decomposition on multiple NLG datasets. We find no evidence that LLMaJ with task decomposition leads to performance gains over a fair baseline that does not use decomposition. Instead, we find that previously reported performance gains in decomposition-based LLMaJ stem from using human labels as training data, and not task decomposition itself. Also, we find that, when human labels are available, LLMaJ without using task decomposition can perform comparably to human annotators.
title: Does task decomposition improve automatic NLG evaluation?
title_translated: 任务分解是否能提升自动自然语言生成评估效果？
summary_translated: 大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge, LLMaJ）框架已成为一种廉价、可复现且无需参考的自然语言生成（NLG）评估的有前景方案。先前工作试图通过将评估任务分解为更简单的子任务来改进LLMaJ。本文系统比较了在多个NLG数据集上采用与不采用任务分解的LLMaJ方法。我们未发现任务分解能带来性能提升；相反，此前报道的分解方法的优势源于使用人类标签作为训练数据，而非任务分解本身。此外，当人类标签可用时，不使用任务分解的LLMaJ可达到与人类标注者相当的表现。

summary: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding enables high-quality text generation by selecting the hypothesis that maximizes a utility metric over sampled pseudo-references. However, it is highly susceptible to metric overfitting: it can irregularly inflate the chosen utility metric at the direct expense of other unoptimized evaluation metrics. To mitigate this, we introduce SVD-MBR, which frames the pairwise utility matrix as a noisy information signal. By computing a low-rank approximation via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and retaining only the top-$k$ components, we effectively decouple true consensus from metric noise. Experiments demonstrate that SVD-MBR successfully regularizes decoding, yielding substantial gains across a range of generalized metrics. Furthermore, we reveal that this denoising is metric-dependent: neural metrics encode a robust low-rank consensus ideal for SVD, whereas surface-level metrics struggle to separate signal from metric noise.
title: Overfitting Mitigation via Singular Value Decomposition in Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
title_translated: 通过奇异值分解缓解最小贝叶斯风险解码中的过拟合
summary_translated: 最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码通过选择在采样伪参考上最大化效用度量的假设来实现高质量文本生成。然而，它极易受到效用度量过拟合的影响：会不规则地放大所选效用度量，从而牺牲其他未优化的评估指标。为缓解此问题，我们提出SVD-MBR，将成对效用矩阵视为一个噪声信息信号。通过奇异值分解（SVD）计算低秩近似，并仅保留前k个分量，有效分离了真实共识与度量噪声。实验表明，SVD-MBR成功实现了解码正则化，在多种泛化度量上均取得显著提升。此外，我们发现这种去噪效果具有度量依赖性：神经网络度量编码了稳健的低秩共识，适合SVD处理；而表层度量难以区分信号与度量噪声。

summary: Dialectal Arabic (DA) remains under-resourced compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), particularly for machine reading comprehension (MRC) and question answering (QA). Existing Arabic QA benchmarks primarily focus on formal written MSA or multiple-choice QA, with limited coverage of naturally spoken dialects. Here, we aim to bridge this gap. We introduce EDRAC, the first large-scale benchmark for dialectal Arabic machine reading comprehension (MRC) and generative QA, covering five major dialects: Egyptian, Moroccan, Emirati, Syrian, and Saudi Arabic. EDRAC contains 499 passages derived from naturally occurring spoken interactions and 4,977 corresponding QA pairs generated through a human--LLM collaborative pipeline combining iterative generation, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human verification. We benchmark Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs on EDRAC using lexical and semantic metrics. Our results reveal substantial gaps between semantic answer quality and dialectal fidelity, highlighting the limitations of existing evaluation metrics for dialectal Arabic generation. EDRAC provides a realistic and challenging MRC benchmark for future research on dialectal Arabic NLP.
title: EDRAC: Benchmarking Arabic Dialect Reading Comprehension
title_translated: EDRAC：阿拉伯方言阅读理解基准测试
summary_translated: 方言阿拉伯语（DA）相较于现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）仍属资源匮乏，尤其在机器阅读理解（MRC）和问答（QA）任务中。现有阿拉伯语QA基准主要聚焦于正式书面的MSA或多项选择题，对自然口语方言覆盖有限。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们提出了EDRAC，首个大规模针对阿拉伯方言机器阅读理解（MRC）和生成式问答的基准，涵盖埃及、摩洛哥、阿联酋、叙利亚和沙特阿拉伯五种主要方言。EDRAC包含499段源自自然口语互动的篇章，以及通过人机协同流程生成的4,977个对应问答对，该流程结合了迭代生成、大模型作为裁判评估和人工验证。我们在EDRAC上使用词汇和语义度量对以阿拉伯语为中心和多语言大模型进行了基准测试。结果揭示了语义答案质量与方言忠实度之间的巨大差距，凸显了现有评价指标在方言生成任务中的局限性。EDRAC为未来阿拉伯方言NLP研究提供了真实且具有挑战性的MRC基准。

summary: Clinical LLM assistants must reason over multi-visit patient trajectories, yet whether the compact history representations used to scale them---retrieval, structured timelines, LLM summaries, agentic memory---preserve the longitudinal signal clinical reasoning needs has not been measured. We introduce ClinTraceBench: 385 MIMIC-IV-derived verified dialogues with event-ID provenance, a nine-task taxonomy (T1--T9), and L0--L4 deterministic + L5 human-audit validation (98.92\% agreement). We evaluate eight history representation strategies---a no-context floor, \textit{last-visit-only}, \textit{full-context}, BGE-M3 \textit{dense-retrieval}, two compression schemes, and two agentic-memory systems (\textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem})---across four backbones (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, Haiku~4.5, Sonnet~4.6) on 6{,}271 questions: 32 cells, 200{,}672 predictions. Four findings: (SP4) a controlled T3 injection probe isolates compression-induced \textit{relation} loss---with the attribution sentence present \textit{before} construction, \textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem} and \textit{llm-summary} still recover only 0--5.3\% of the injected positives; (SP1) compressed strategies pay an aggregation tax on multi-visit trends and cross-patient comparisons; (SP2) the blind-to-full gap spans $+29.8$~pp (GPT-4o-mini) to $+62.7$~pp (Haiku); (SP3) abstention scales non-monotonically with context length. On the Pareto frontier Haiku dominates Sonnet under \textit{full-context} (\$25.76 vs.\ \$106.21), inverting the ``biggest backbone wins'' heuristic.
title: ClinTraceBench: Source-Verifiable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning over EHR-Derived Dialogues
title_translated: ClinTraceBench：基于电子病历对话的可溯源纵向临床推理基准
summary_translated: 临床大模型助手需对多访次患者轨迹进行推理，但用于扩展其规模的紧凑历史表示——如检索、结构化时间线、大模型摘要、代理记忆等——是否保留了临床推理所需的纵向信号尚未被衡量。我们引入ClinTraceBench：385个源自MIMIC-IV的经验证对话，带有事件ID溯源信息，九项任务分类（T1–T9），以及L0–L4确定性验证与L5人工审计验证（98.92%一致性）。我们在6,271个问题上，对八种历史表示策略（无上下文基线、仅最后就诊、全上下文、BGE-M3密集检索、两种压缩方案，以及两种代理记忆系统Mem0和A-Mem）在四种骨干模型（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4o-mini、Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6）上进行了评估：共32个单元，200,672次预测。四项发现：(SP4) 控制性T3注入探针揭示了压缩导致的关系丢失——即使在构造前提供归属句，Mem0、A-Mem和LLM摘要也仅能恢复0–5.3%的注入正例；(SP1) 压缩策略在多访次趋势和跨患者比较上付出聚合代价；(SP2) 从盲视到全上下文的差距达+29.8pp（GPT-4o-mini）至+62.7pp（Haiku）；(SP3) 拒绝回答随上下文长度非单调增长。在帕累托前沿上，Haiku在全上下文条件下优于Sonnet（$25.76 vs. $106.21），颠覆了“模型越大越优”的直觉。

summary: Reducing the modality gap between image and text representations in CLIP is widely expected to improve cross-modal alignment and downstream performance. However, a smaller average image-text gap does not necessarily lead to consistent accuracy gains. We analyze this mismatch from the perspective of the decision structure in zero-shot classification, i.e. selecting the most similar class-text prototype for an input image. Zero-shot accuracy depends not only on average image--text alignment, but also on class-wise decision margins. Using Linear correction as an analytically tractable case, we show that modality gap correction can alter the relative decision structure among classes and cause predictions to concentrate on a small subset of classes. We refer to this output-space failure mode as prediction-level hubness. Furthermore, experiments across multiple datasets show that accuracy degradation under gap correction is consistently associated with increased prediction concentration, both for Linear correction and for learning-based correction methods. This provides a systematic explanation of why modality gap reduction does not consistently improve CLIP zero-shot accuracy from the perspective of downstream decision structure. Our results suggest that gap correction should be evaluated not only by average alignment, but also by its impact on downstream prediction structure.
title: When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP
title_translated: 当模态间隙缩减失败时：CLIP中的预测级枢纽现象
summary_translated: 普遍认为，减少CLIP中图像与文本表示之间的模态间隙可改善跨模态对齐及下游性能。然而，更小的平均图像-文本间隙并不必然带来一致的准确率提升。我们从零样本分类的决策结构角度分析这一矛盾，即为输入图像选择最相似的类别文本原型。零样本准确率不仅取决于平均图像-文本对齐程度，还受类别间决策边界的影响。以线性修正为例，我们证明模态间隙修正可能改变类别间的相对决策结构，导致预测集中于少数几个类别。我们将这种输出空间的失效模式称为预测级枢纽现象。此外，多个数据集上的实验表明，间隙修正导致的准确率下降始终与预测集中度上升相关，无论是线性修正还是基于学习的修正方法。这从下游决策结构的角度系统解释了为何模态间隙缩减不能持续提升CLIP的零样本准确率。我们的结果表明，间隙修正应不仅通过平均对齐度评估，还应考察其对下游预测结构的影响。

summary: In current Mixture-of-Experts architectures, routing is performed based on representations dominated by structure shared across all tokens, limiting expert specialization. We show that contrasting each token against an Exponential Moving Average of the layer's hidden states, rather than routing on absolute magnitude, concentrates the routing signal onto a low-dimensional, highly separable subspace. Building on this, we propose the Contrastive Routing Mechanism (CoRM), which scores each expert by the gap between its affinity for the incoming token and its affinity for this shared reference state, interpreted through a distinct per-expert projection. The resulting experts have routing boundaries that align with linguistic structure significantly more than the Top-k baseline. Our experiments show that CoRM improves average zero-shot accuracy by +0.67 to +1.69 points (Top-1) and +1.38 to +1.77 points (Top-2) over standard Top-k MoE baselines on nine zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, at the minimal cost of 2.9% added parameters and 2.6% added FLOPs per token.
title: Beyond Magnitude: Contrastive Routing for Modular Mixture-of-Experts
title_translated: 超越幅度：面向模块化专家混合的对比路由机制
summary_translated: 在当前的专家混合（MoE）架构中，路由通常基于所有标记共享的结构化表示，限制了专家的专业化能力。我们发现，将每个标记与其所在层隐藏状态的指数移动平均进行对比，而非基于绝对幅度进行路由，可使路由信号集中在低维且高度可分的子空间。基于此，我们提出对比路由机制（CoRM），通过计算每个专家对输入标记的亲和力与其对共享参考状态的亲和力之差，并通过各专家独立的投影进行解释，来评分专家。由此产生的专家路由边界显著更符合语言结构，优于传统的Top-k基线。实验表明，在九个零样本推理基准上，CoRM相比标准Top-k MoE基线，将平均零样本准确率提升了+0.67至+1.69点（Top-1）和+1.38至+1.77点（Top-2），仅增加2.9%的参数和每标记2.6%的FLOPs。

summary: Large language models often answer the same multiple-choice question inconsistently when it is posed under support-oriented and elimination-oriented framings. We investigate whether these discrepancies arise from different internal representations induced by the two framings. We introduce a dual-framing protocol with minimally varied prompts that use either support- or elimination-oriented framing while keeping the evaluation target fixed. To probe the internal computation, we append an untrained special token, [STATE], and treat its residual-stream activation as an intervention interface. Across both models, the two framings induce separable [STATE] activations concentrated in intermediate layers. Swapping these activations between paired prompts systematically changes predictions and improves cross-framing agreement, providing intervention-based evidence that the activations are behaviorally relevant. Beyond instance-level substitution, mean-difference steering directions derived from the dual-framing contrast exhibit more bounded layer-wise responses than matched contrastive activation addition directions under the evaluated protocol.
title: StateSwap: Probing Support-Elimination Hidden States in Multiple-Choice Questions
title_translated: StateSwap：探测多选题中支持消除型隐藏状态
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在采用支持导向和消除导向框架提出同一道多选题时，常常给出不一致的答案。我们探究这些差异是否源于两种框架引发的不同内部表示。为此，我们设计了一种双框架协议，通过最小变化的提示，分别使用支持或消除导向的表述，同时保持评估目标不变。为探测内部计算过程，我们在模型中添加一个未经训练的特殊标记[STATE]，并将它的残差流激活视为干预接口。在两个模型中，两种框架均诱导出可分离的[STATE]激活，且集中在中间层。在成对提示间交换这些激活，系统性地改变了预测结果并提升了跨框架的一致性，提供了基于干预的证据，表明这些激活具有行为相关性。除了实例级替换外，从双框架对比中提取的均值差异引导方向，在评估协议下表现出比匹配的对比激活添加方向更受约束的逐层响应。

summary: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework offers a cost-effective and reproducible solution for automatic evaluation. However, current evaluation practices typically compare LLMaJ judgments against aggregated ground-truth labels, overlooking the valuable information contained in Human Label Variation (HLV). Inspired by an increasing line of work that proposes to leverage HLV, we systematically study LLMaJ performance on predicting both a single, aggregated ground truth hard-label and unaggregated soft-labels that represent Human Judgment Distributions (HJD). Our results across five diverse datasets reveal that while LLMs achieve near human-level performance at hard-label prediction on most tasks, they exhibit poor performance when predicting soft-labels. To address this limitation, we propose NAPHA (eNtropy-Aware Post-Hoc Alignment), a simple yet effective lightweight post-hoc alignment method that matches the LLM distribution to the HJD by first assigning an instance to a discrete entropy class and then routing it to specialized, trained alignment models. We find that NAPHA consistently improves soft-labels prediction across base LLM models and datasets, with particularly strong gains on high-entropy instances where capturing diverse human perspectives is most critical. We also show via oracle experiments that improving entropy class prediction can substantially enhance NAPHA's practical effectiveness.
title: Post-hoc Alignment of LLM-judges to Human Judgment Distribution
title_translated: 后处理对齐LLM裁判以匹配人类判断分布
summary_translated: LLM作为裁判（LLMaJ）框架提供了一种成本低且可复现的自动评估解决方案。然而，当前评估实践通常将LLMaJ的判断与聚合的真实标签进行比较，忽略了人类标签变异（HLV）所包含的宝贵信息。受越来越多研究利用HLV的启发，我们系统研究了LLMaJ在预测单一聚合真实标签硬标签以及代表人类判断分布（HJD）的非聚合软标签方面的表现。在五个不同数据集上的结果显示，尽管LLM在大多数任务上对硬标签预测已接近人类水平，但在预测软标签方面表现不佳。为解决这一局限，我们提出了NAPHA（熵感知后处理对齐），一种简单而有效的轻量级后处理对齐方法，通过先将实例分配到离散熵类别，再将其路由至专门训练的对齐模型，使LLM分布匹配HJD。我们发现，NAPHA在基础LLM模型和数据集上持续提升软标签预测性能，尤其在高熵实例上增益显著，因为此时捕捉多样化的主观视角最为关键。我们还通过Oracle实验表明，提升熵类别预测能力可显著增强NAPHA的实际效果。

summary: The heavy-tailed distribution of output lengths in Large Language Model (LLM) serving poses major challenges for resource provisioning and cluster scheduling. Although output-length prediction can mitigate these issues, existing approaches have key drawbacks: external proxy models add substantial latency and often have limited fidelity, whereas internal state-based methods are efficient but rely on shallow probes of current model states. We identify a structural connection between speculative decoding (SD) and length prediction: latent representations produced by the draft decoder in advanced frameworks (e.g., EAGLE-3) encode signals that are predictive of generation length. Building on this insight, we introduce OUTLETS (Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones), which repurposes the speculative backbone as a trajectory-aware length predictor. When its draft representations are already computed for speculative decoding, OUTLETS adds only a lightweight regression head and achieves lower MAE than the evaluated methods. Under saturated disaggregated serving, OUTLETS predictions enable standard scheduling policies to prioritize shorter requests and distribute requests more evenly across decoding instances, reducing short-request P99 latency by 34.8%.
title: OUTLETS: Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones
title_translated: OUTLETS：从推测解码主干中预测输出长度
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务中的输出长度呈现重尾分布，给资源规划和集群调度带来重大挑战。虽然输出长度预测可以缓解这些问题，但现有方法存在关键缺陷：外部代理模型增加显著延迟且保真度有限；而基于内部状态的方法虽高效，却依赖于对当前模型状态的浅层探测。我们发现推测解码（SD）与长度预测之间存在结构关联：先进框架（如EAGLE-3）中草稿解码器产生的潜在表示编码了可预测生成长度的信号。基于此洞察，我们提出OUTLETS（从推测解码主干中预测输出长度），将推测主干重新用作轨迹感知的长度预测器。当草稿表示已为推测解码计算时，OUTLETS仅需添加一个轻量级回归头，其平均绝对误差低于所评估的其他方法。在饱和的分布式服务环境下，OUTLETS的预测使标准调度策略能够优先处理较短请求，并更均匀地分配请求到解码实例，将短请求的P99延迟降低34.8%。

summary: Across the full Pythia suite (160M-12B, eight checkpoints, four task families), a linear probe can read a target variable from the residual stream as early as step 1,000 at every scale -- yet steering along that same reading direction remains null-equivalent in 43 of 48 model-checkpoint cells. Internal readability systematically outruns causal efficacy, and the lag does not shrink with scale. We call this structure lagged coupling and decompose it into three dissociable tracks: (i) internal readability, saturated (AUROC >= 0.990) from the first checkpoint everywhere; (ii) behavioral readability, which develops gradually and progressively later at larger scales (12B reaches 0.909 only at the final checkpoint); (iii) causal efficacy, almost always null-equivalent, occasionally counterproductive early, with one isolated positive pulse (12B, step 8,000, z = +2.49) our grid cannot resolve. The ordering is dominantly read-before-write (11/11 units, no inversion). Representation headroom along the probe direction grows up to 57x with training and scale while causal write-in stays below 0.11% of headroom -- the variable is increasingly written into the representation and increasingly ignored by the readout. Under a fully pre-registered protocol, both single-onset hypotheses resolve INDETERMINATE (scale slope +0.24, 95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]; time vote 3:3) -- a disciplined negative explained by the three-track decomposition. A pre-registered OLMo-2 replication preserves the direction at attenuated magnitude. Our results caution against inferring steerability from probe accuracy and establish a developmental bottleneck: representation formation reliably outpaces causal readout consolidation.
title: Lagged Coupling: Internal Representations Become Readable Before They Become Causal
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Pre-registered developmental interpretability study on the full Pythia suite with an OLMo-2 replication
title_translated: 滞后耦合：内部表示在成为因果前即变得可读
summary_translated: 在完整的Pythia系列模型（160M-12B，八个检查点，四个任务族）中，线性探测器可在每个尺度上最早第1000步就从残差流中读取目标变量——然而沿同一读取方向进行操控在48个模型-检查点单元中有43个仍为零效。内部可读性系统性地领先于因果有效性，且这种滞后不随模型规模增大而缩小。我们称此结构为滞后耦合，并将其分解为三个可分离的路径：(i) 内部可读性，从第一个检查点起即饱和（AUROC ≥ 0.990）；(ii) 行为可读性，逐步发展，大模型中出现较晚（12B仅在最终检查点达到0.909）；(iii) 因果有效性，几乎始终为零效，早期偶有反向作用，仅有一个孤立正向脉冲（12B，第8000步，z = +2.49）未被网格解析。主导顺序为读先于写（11/11单元，无反转）。沿探测方向的表示冗余量随训练和规模增长达57倍，而因果写入量始终低于冗余量的0.11%——变量被不断写入表示，却被读出机制日益忽略。在完全预注册协议下，单次启动假设均判定为不确定（尺度斜率+0.24，95%置信区间[-0.60, +0.87]；时间投票3:3），这一严谨的否定结果由三路径分解解释。预注册OLMo-2复现验证了该方向的存在，但幅度减弱。我们的结果警示不应仅凭探测准确率推断可操控性，并确立了一个发展瓶颈：表示形成可靠地快于因果读出的巩固。

summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale Large Language Model (LLM) capacity efficiently by activating a sparse subset of experts per token. However, modern MoE inference remains heavily constrained by the rigid, whole-expert abstraction. Existing frameworks manage, schedule, or prune experts as atomic execution units, which fixes the optimization boundary too early and leaves fine-grained intra-expert computational redundancy underexplored. In this work, we present PCoMoE, a path-compositional execution framework that shifts MoE inference from coarse-grained expert selection to fine-grained path composition. PCoMoE incorporates a path-level formulation of expert computation, a compatibility-aware layer-wise pruning strategy to suppress low-value path combinations, and a hardware-friendly execution engine to exploit reusable sub-expert structures under strictly bounded overheads. Experimental results demonstrate that PCoMoE achieves up to a 1.31x end-to-end inference speedup while enhancing model accuracy by 10%. The code is available at https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE
title: PCoMoE: Shifting MoE Inference from Monolithic Expert Selection to Fine-Grained Path Composition
title_translated: PCoMoE：将MoE推理从整体专家选择转向细粒度路径组合
summary_translated: 混合专家（MoE）架构通过每token激活稀疏的专家子集，高效扩展大型语言模型（LLM）容量。然而，现代MoE推理仍严重受限于刚性的、整体专家抽象。现有框架将专家作为原子执行单元进行管理、调度或剪枝，过早固定优化边界，导致细粒度的专家内部计算冗余未被充分探索。本文提出PCoMoE，一种路径组合式执行框架，将MoE推理从粗粒度专家选择转向细粒度路径组合。PCoMoE引入专家计算的路径级建模，采用兼容性感知的逐层剪枝策略以抑制低价值路径组合，并设计硬件友好的执行引擎，严格控制开销的同时利用可复用的子专家结构。实验结果表明，PCoMoE实现了高达1.31倍的端到端推理加速，同时提升模型准确率10%。代码已公开于https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE。

summary: Current speech synthesis struggles with code-switching, which mixes a foreign language phrase into a primary language utterance, causing the phrase to be spoken with the primary language's accent rather than its native one. We propose Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance (LCG), a training-free inference framework that restores a native accent to code-switched phrases in cross-lingual text-to-speech. LCG replaces the single language guidance applied across the whole utterance with a separate guidance for each region, so each part is guided by its own language. To choose where to apply this localized guidance, we propose a self-attention probing technique that finds the phrase boundaries without external alignments. Together, these components generate speech in which each region carries the accent of its own language, requiring no fine-tuning or auxiliary models. Across diverse language pairs, LCG robustly increases the nativeness of the code-switched phrase while suppressing accent leakage, and preserving overall speaker identity and naturalness.
title: Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance: Training-Free Localized Accent Control for Code-Switching Text-to-Speech
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Demo: this https URL
title_translated: 短语定位的语言对比引导：无需训练的跨语言文本转语音中代码切换短语的本地化口音控制
summary_translated: 当前语音合成在处理代码切换（即在主语言话语中插入外语短语）时存在困难，导致这些短语以主语言口音而非其母语口音发音。我们提出一种无需训练的推理框架——短语定位的语言对比引导（LCG），用于在跨语言文本转语音中恢复代码切换短语的母语口音。LCG将原先在整个话语上统一应用的语言引导替换为针对每个区域的独立引导，使每个部分由其自身语言指导。为确定应用局部引导的位置，我们提出一种自注意力探测技术，无需外部对齐即可识别短语边界。这两项组件共同生成每段语音均带有其对应语言口音的输出，且无需微调或辅助模型。在多种语言对上，LCG显著提升了代码切换短语的自然度，同时抑制了口音泄露，并保持了整体说话人身份和自然性。

summary: When a question has valid answers under different normative frameworks, a language model must decide which framework to use and whether it can answer correctly within it. We call this setting normative pluralism and study it in Islamic finance using a four-choice taxonomy that separates framework selection from within-framework correctness. This separation reveals the stereotype trap: a cultural cue steers a model toward one framework, but the model selects an incorrect answer within that framework. Across twelve models, two languages, and fifty demographic signals, cultural cues change framework selection and reveal substantial differences in accuracy, especially among non-frontier models. Under the strongest signal, large open-weight models select the Islamic framework 97% of the time. A two-choice evaluation would report near-perfect alignment, although 57--66% of those selections are incorrect. These findings motivate, but do not directly test, the competence-conditioned routing hypothesis: models may favor frameworks where they are more accurate, while cultural cues may expose framework-specific competence gaps.
title: Right Frame, Wrong Rule: Cultural Cues Expose the Financial Knowledge Gap They Were Meant to Close
title_translated: 正确的框架，错误的规则：文化线索暴露了它们本应弥合的金融知识鸿沟
summary_translated: 当一个问题在不同规范框架下均有有效答案时，语言模型必须决定采用哪个框架以及是否能在该框架内正确作答。我们称此情境为规范多元主义，并通过一个四选一分类体系研究伊斯兰金融中的这一现象，将框架选择与框架内正确性分离。这种分离揭示了刻板印象陷阱：文化线索会引导模型偏向某一框架，但模型在该框架内仍可能选择错误答案。在十二个模型、两种语言和五十个社会人口学信号的实验中，文化线索显著改变了框架选择，并暴露出准确率的巨大差异，尤其在非前沿模型中更为明显。在最强文化线索下，大型开源权重模型有97%的时间选择伊斯兰框架。若采用两选一评估，会报告近乎完美的对齐，但实际上57%至66%的选择是错误的。这些发现支持但未直接验证‘能力条件路由’假设：模型可能倾向于其更擅长的框架，而文化线索则暴露了各框架下的能力差距。

summary: Word Sense Disambiguation has advanced rapidly for English and a handful of well-resourced modern languages, but it continues to assume the existence of a sense inventory and a word-to-sense mapping in the source language (Navigli, 2026). These assumptions break down for most historical and low-resource languages, whose dedicated WordNets are either incomplete or still under construction. We present Inspicio, an open-vocabulary retrieval pipeline that links tokens in context to synsets of the Open English WordNet (McCrae et al., 2020) without requiring any source-language inventory or mapping. For each occurrence, an instruction-tuned LLM produces two English translations of the surrounding sentence, a small set of candidate dictionary-style definitions, and a few candidate English lemmas. These outputs drive a hybrid retrieval step that combines dense definition-synset similarity, sparse lemma matching, and Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking. We evaluate the pipeline across a 6x6 grid of LLMs and sentence-embedding models on a new bilingual set of manually annotated Latin and Ancient Greek perception verbs, on a subset of PREMOVE dataset (Farina, 2025), and on a diachronic sample of Italian. The best configuration reaches 96% Recall@50 on the perception-verb test set, with each component contributing measurable gains, and remains competitive in the out-of-domain and cross-lingual settings.
title: Inspicio: Open-Vocabulary, LLM-Based Sense Retrieval for Historical Languages
title_translated: Inspicio：基于大语言模型的历史语言开放词汇词义检索
summary_translated: 词义消歧在英语及少数资源丰富的现代语言中已取得快速进展，但其前提假设是源语言中存在词义清单和词到义的映射关系（Navigli, 2026）。这些假设在大多数历史语言和低资源语言中不成立，因为其专用WordNet要么不完整，要么仍在构建中。我们提出Inspicio，一种无需源语言词库或映射关系的开放词汇检索流程，可将上下文中的标记链接至Open English WordNet（McCrae et al., 2020）的同义词集。对于每个词例，经过指令微调的大语言模型生成周围句子的两个英文翻译、一组候选词典式定义以及若干候选英文词干。这些输出驱动一个混合检索步骤，结合密集定义-同义词相似度、稀疏词干匹配和最大边际相关重排序。我们在新构建的拉丁语与古希腊语感知动词双语标注数据集、PREMOVE数据集子集（Farina, 2025）以及意大利语历时样本上评估该流程。最佳配置在感知动词测试集上达到96%的Recall@50，各组件均带来可测量的性能提升，并在跨领域和跨语言场景中保持竞争力。

summary: Using a large language model to play the user is now standard in scalable evaluation. It has a repeatedly diagnosed failure: the simulated user is excessively cooperative, so a system under test can score by the sheer number of questions it asks rather than by making the user willing to speak. We answer with a disclosure gate conditioning information release on the companion agent's behaviour: its state is a ladder of five ordered gates, merged onto three observable depth layers. We specify, ablate, and audit it, and train a user simulator against that specification. Gating behaviour is learned from the training corpus's synthetic branch, while the real branch supplies how people speak and react; after training, the simulator need not be told at runtime which gate each item sits behind. The gate is a load-bearing component of the environment: on the English corpus of a published companion-agent benchmark (CompanionBench), once training no longer states per example which gate each item sits behind, the largest rank displacement across 12 systems under test exceeds the noise band set by re-running that environment under a new seed, while per-system scores show no detectable change. We state two acceptance criteria: a ranking must be order-preserving, and absolute scores must be scale-stable. Of the candidates we examine, only one passes both -- the simulator we release -- and its leaderboard correlates at 0.993 with the benchmark's original simulator. By contrast, prompting a frontier model as the simulator barely moves the ranking while shifting every score upward -- a shift invisible to anyone checking the ranking alone. The environment we specify is the one that benchmark already used. That publication describes the mechanism in about four hundred words, and we supply what it lacked: specification, ablations, human studies, negative controls, and downstream sensitivity analysis.
title: Disclosure-Gated User Simulation for Companion-Agent Evaluation
title_translated: 披露门控用户模拟用于伴侣型智能体评估
summary_translated: 使用大语言模型扮演用户已成为可扩展评估的标准方法。然而，该方法反复出现一个缺陷：模拟用户过于合作，导致被测系统仅通过提问数量即可获得高分，而非真正促使用户开口交流。为此，我们提出一种披露门控机制，根据伴侣智能体的行为来控制信息释放：其状态为五个有序门的阶梯，合并为三个可观测层级。我们对这一机制进行了定义、消融分析与审计，并基于该规范训练用户模拟器。门控行为从训练语料库的合成分支中学习，而真实分支提供人们实际说话与反应的方式；训练完成后，模拟器在运行时无需被告知每个项目位于哪个门后。该门控是环境的核心组件：在已发表的伴侣智能体基准（CompanionBench）的英文语料上，一旦训练不再明确每个示例对应的门，12个被测系统的最大排名偏移超过由重新运行环境并更换种子所设定的噪声范围，而各系统得分无显著变化。我们提出两项接受标准：排名必须保持顺序不变，绝对得分必须尺度稳定。在所考察的候选方案中，仅我们发布的模拟器同时满足这两项标准，其排行榜与原始模拟器的相关系数高达0.993。相比之下，使用前沿模型作为模拟器仅轻微改变排名，却使所有得分大幅上移——这一变化若仅看排名则无法察觉。我们所指定的环境正是基准原本使用的环境。该出版物仅用约四百字描述机制，而我们补充了缺失的关键内容：规范定义、消融实验、人类研究、负向对照及下游敏感性分析。

summary: We target practical anonymization of Persian customer chats by training a compact NER model from LLM-labeled supervision and selecting the best labeler for deployment. We compare three instruction-tuned LLMs: DeepSeek-V3-0324, GPT-OSS-120B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507, to produce span annotations under a shared JSON protocol, yielding four corpora (OSS_ZeroShot, Qwen_ZeroShot, Qwen_FewShot, DeepSeek_FewShot). A MatinaRoberta-based token-classifier is trained per corpus and evaluated with token-level Precision/Recall/F1 (overall and per-class). We also report Label Coverage Recall (LCR), the proportion of gold non-O tokens predicted as non-O, and quantify cross-labeler behavior via a token-level Venn on test annotations. Finally, we contrast test-set annotation latency of the LLMs on H200 nodes with the trained NER's test-time labeling on a single RTX 3090. Results show that supervision from OSS_ZeroShot yields the strongest macro-F1 and LCR, while the resulting NER labels an entire 40K-message test set in approximately 2 minutes on one consumer GPU. This establishes a practical path to high-quality, low-cost anonymization for Persian industrial data.
title: PersianAnonymizer: Evaluating LLM-Labeled Training for Efficient NER-based Anonymization in Persian

title_translated: PersianAnonymizer：评估基于LLM标注的训练以实现高效的波斯语NER匿名化
summary_translated: 我们致力于通过使用LLM标注的监督信号训练紧凑的命名实体识别（NER）模型，实现波斯语客户聊天记录的实用匿名化，并选择最优标注器进行部署。我们比较了三种指令微调的LLM：DeepSeek-V3-0324、GPT-OSS-120B 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507，按照统一的JSON协议生成跨度标注，共生成四个语料库（OSS_ZeroShot、Qwen_ZeroShot、Qwen_FewShot、DeepSeek_FewShot）。针对每个语料库训练一个基于MatinaRoberta的token分类器，并以token级别的精确率/召回率/F1值（总体及类别级）进行评估。我们还报告了标签覆盖率召回率（LCR），即预测为非O类的黄金标签非O token的比例，并通过测试标注上的token级Venn图量化跨标注器行为差异。最后，我们对比了LLM在H200节点上的测试集标注延迟与训练好的NER模型在单张RTX 3090显卡上的推理延迟。结果表明，OSS_ZeroShot提供的监督信号在宏F1和LCR上表现最佳，且训练后的NER模型可在单张消费级GPU上约2分钟内完成4万条消息的全量测试集标注。这为波斯语工业数据提供了高质量、低成本的实用匿名化路径。

summary: Multi-turn tool calling is a core evaluation scenario for large language model (LLM) agents. On public tool-calling benchmarks, open-weight models now approach or even surpass closed-source frontier models in aggregate accuracy. However, this metric averages over many different multi-turn situations and obscures whether progress is balanced across them. We propose an action-class-oriented diagnostic framework that decomposes multi-turn failures into two orthogonal modes: action-class miscalibration and action-execution failure. The framework operates over a four-class action space (TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM) and introduces a self-revealing upper bound Acc <= GAR (Gold Action Recall); the two modes show up as bound violation (Acc > GAR, exposing state-grader masking of miscalibration) and large bound slack (GAR >> Acc, localizing execution failure within TOOL_CALL). We validate it on a panel of tool-calling models across multiple multi-turn benchmarks. Across our panel, the diagnostic reveals action-class miscalibration as a substantial failure mode the state grader cannot see. This gap inflates standing for heavily tool-trained families, which our diagnostic separates from families with context-appropriate action choice. Calibration is reshapable through context-only perturbations, but the reshape is heterogeneous: a single perturbation moves accuracy in opposite directions across families (up to +11.5 vs -21.0 pp on the same scenario), and its effect further depends on the perturbation mechanism. We argue that multi-turn tool-calling evaluations should supplement aggregate accuracy with action-class diagnostics that expose what the model actually does in each scenario.
title: Calibration is the Bottleneck: An Action-Class Diagnostic of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 校准是瓶颈：多轮工具调用的动作类别诊断
summary_translated: 多轮工具调用是大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的核心评估场景。在公开的工具调用基准上，开源模型的总体准确率已接近甚至超过闭源前沿模型。然而，这一指标对多种不同的多轮情境进行了平均，掩盖了进展是否在各类情境中均衡分布。我们提出一种面向动作类别的诊断框架，将多轮失败分解为两种正交模式：动作类别校准偏差和动作执行失败。该框架基于四类动作空间（TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM），引入自揭示的上限 Acc <= GAR（黄金动作召回率）；两种模式分别表现为上限违反（Acc > GAR，暴露状态评分器对校准偏差的掩盖）和显著的上限松弛（GAR >> Acc，定位到 TOOL_CALL 内部的执行失败）。我们在多个多轮基准上的工具调用模型面板中验证了该框架。结果显示，动作类别校准偏差是一个被状态评分器忽视的重要失败模式。这种差距放大了高度工具训练模型家族的表现，而我们的诊断方法能将其与具有上下文适配动作选择的家族区分开来。通过仅改变上下文的扰动即可重塑校准，但这种重塑具有异质性：同一扰动在不同模型家族中导致准确率朝相反方向变化（在同一场景下最高达 +11.5 vs -21.0 个百分点），且其效果还取决于扰动机制。我们认为，多轮工具调用评估应补充动作类别诊断，以揭示模型在每种情景下的实际行为。

summary: Solving problems through repeated attempts is a sequential modeling task: at each step, the solver receives feedback and decides how to revise their solutions. Predicting whether performance improves, plateaus, or regresses across attempts is central to understanding any iterative problem-solving process in both human learners and autonomous agents. Beyond outcomes, modeling what errors persist and how strategies shift across attempts provides deeper insight into the mechanics of sequential learning. Studying these dynamics requires observing many solvers as they attempt, receive feedback, and revise. Programming courses with automated grading provide this setting, as students iteratively submit code to test suites and receive feedback on every attempt. We therefore curate CodeInsight, a large-scale dataset of over 3 million submissions from 3,286 undergraduates across 2 introductory C++ courses in 2 academic years, with test-case-level outcomes, timestamps, and source code. On this dataset, we build a benchmark that evaluates models spanning parametric, sequential, and generative traditions under a shared calibration-and-scoring protocol, including a Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) adapted to track solver characteristics through discrete latent variables and an LLM-based predictor that generates explicit solutions. The adapted RSSM achieves the strongest predictive accuracy on three of the four courses. The LLM predictor is less accurate but produces full submissions at each attempt, enabling direct analysis of failure modes. We find that the model's coding proficiency is inversely related to predictive performance in this setting, with the LLM better understood as a generative solver conditioned on context rather than a faithful predictor of solver behavior. We publicly release our code and the dataset on request to facilitate future research.
title: A Dataset for Modeling Iterative Problem-Solving
title_translated: 用于建模迭代式问题解决的数据集
summary_translated: 通过反复尝试解决问题是一种序列建模任务：每一步中，求解者接收反馈并决定如何修改解决方案。预测性能在尝试过程中是否提升、停滞或退化，是理解人类学习者和自主智能体迭代式问题解决过程的核心。除了结果之外，建模哪些错误持续存在以及策略如何随尝试演变，可提供对序列学习机制的更深入洞察。研究这些动态需要观察大量求解者在尝试、接收反馈和修正过程中的表现。带有自动评分的编程课程提供了这一场景，学生反复提交代码至测试套件，并在每次尝试后获得反馈。因此，我们构建了 CodeInsight 数据集，包含来自 3,286 名本科生在两年内两门入门级 C++ 课程中的超过 300 万次提交记录，涵盖测试用例级别的结果、时间戳和源代码。在此数据集上，我们建立了一个基准，评估跨越参数化、序列化和生成式传统模型的统一校准与评分协议，包括一个适应于通过离散潜在变量追踪求解者特征的递归状态空间模型（RSSM），以及一个基于大语言模型的预测器，可生成显式的解决方案。经过调整的 RSSM 在四个课程中的三个上取得了最强的预测准确性。基于 LLM 的预测器虽然准确性较低，但可在每次尝试中生成完整提交，从而实现对失败模式的直接分析。我们发现，模型的编码能力与其在此设置下的预测性能呈负相关，表明 LLM 更应被视为一种由上下文条件驱动的生成式求解器，而非对求解者行为的忠实预测器。我们已公开代码和数据集，供未来研究使用。

summary: Deep Research agents tackle knowledge-intensive tasks through multi-round retrieval and decision-oriented generation. However, these agents suffer from severe overconfidence, making their expressed confidence unreliable for user trust and downstream abstention. To address this, we augment the Deep Research pipeline with step confidence elicitation after each retrieval, building on the commonly used post-answer verbalized confidence. Interestingly, we find that Evidence Confidence (E-Conf), elicited after the final retrieval step, provides a stronger uncertainty signal than Answer Confidence (A-Conf), elicited after answer generation, and that A-Conf is largely shaped by E-Conf. Based on these findings, we propose DualStake, a dual-path calibration method that applies margin-clipped, confidence-dependent stake rewards to jointly align E-Conf and A-Conf with answer correctness while limiting extreme confidence optimization. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen3-4B across 8 QA benchmarks demonstrate that DualStake consistently improves calibration without sacrificing answer accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/FloXXXt/DualStake.
title: DualStake: Dual-Path Confidence Calibration in Deep Research Agents
title_translated: DualStake：深度研究智能体中的双路径置信度校准
summary_translated: 深度研究智能体通过多轮检索和面向决策的生成来处理知识密集型任务。然而，这些智能体存在严重的过度自信问题，使其表达的置信度无法用于用户信任和下游的放弃决策。为解决此问题，我们在深度研究流程中引入每轮检索后的步骤置信度提取，基于常见的答案后口头置信度表达。有趣的是，我们发现，在最终检索步骤后提取的证据置信度（E-Conf）比在答案生成后提取的答案置信度（A-Conf）提供了更强的不确定性信号，且 A-Conf 大部分由 E-Conf 决定。基于这些发现，我们提出 DualStake，一种双路径校准方法，通过应用边际截断、依赖置信度的奖励机制，联合对齐 E-Conf 和 A-Conf 与答案正确性，同时限制极端置信度优化。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-4B 上跨 8 个问答基准的实验表明，DualStake 能持续改善校准，而不牺牲答案准确性。代码已发布于 https://github.com/FloXXXt/DualStake。

summary: Language models can ignore prompt evidence when it conflicts with memorized knowledge. Post-training can make models follow such evidence more reliably, but it is unclear whether these gains require new machinery or strengthen machinery already present. We compare nine post-training arms spanning GRPO, SFT, and DPO from one starting checkpoint, with key comparisons extended across scales and families. We estimate a grounding direction from that checkpoint before training. Across five tested GRPO variants, grounding gains are small. For the two variants replicated across seeds, equivalence tests bound their effects below the conflict-SFT gain even as the rewarded metric improves. Conflict-SFT improves grounding moderately, while DPO drives grounding near ceiling on its matched distribution. Conflict-SFT and DPO largely use the same causal attention-head set as the starting model. Subtracting the starting-model direction suppresses both gains, while adding it to the starting model recovers 35% of DPO's gain at a dose passing all stated side-effect checks. After a supervised warm start makes the context answer appear in more rollouts, the same GRPO recipe adds essentially no further grounding gain. In our setting, grounding gains largely depend on machinery already present in the starting model.
title: Context-Grounding Gains Are Mediated by Pre-existing Machinery: Auditing GRPO, SFT, and DPO
title_translated: 上下文锚定收益由已有机制中介：对 GRPO、SFT 和 DPO 的审计
summary_translated: 语言模型在提示信息与记忆知识冲突时可能忽略提示证据。后训练可使模型更可靠地遵循此类证据，但尚不清楚这些收益是否需要新机制，还是强化了已存在的机制。我们比较了从同一初始检查点出发的九种后训练方法，涵盖 GRPO、SFT 和 DPO，并在不同规模和模型家族间进行关键对比。我们在训练前估计了该检查点的锚定方向。在五个测试的 GRPO 变体中，锚定收益较小。对于两个在种子间重复的变体，等效性检验表明其效果低于冲突-SFT 的收益，即使奖励指标有所提升。冲突-SFT 中度改善锚定，而 DPO 在其匹配分布上将锚定推向接近天花板水平。冲突-SFT 和 DPO 大部分使用与初始模型相同的因果注意力头集合。减去初始模型的方向会抑制这两种收益，而将该方向加回初始模型则可恢复 DPO 收益的 35%，且剂量通过所有声明的副作用检查。在监督预热后使上下文答案出现在更多采样轨迹中，相同的 GRPO 方法几乎不再带来额外的锚定收益。在我们的设定中，锚定收益主要依赖于初始模型中已存在的机制。

summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative modeling paradigm to autoregressive LMs, offering advantages such as parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. Despite growing interest in their generative capabilities, the privacy risks of DLMs remain underexplored. We identify a phenomenon termed token-level memorization asymmetry through theoretical analysis of diffusion training dynamics. Building on this finding, we propose Q-Skew, a quantile-weighted skewness-based indicator for membership inference on finetuned DLMs. Experiments across multiple fine-tuning datasets and models show that our method outperforms existing baselines. Moreover, we show that Q-Skew can also facilitate other privacy violations, such as PII extraction. Our findings reveal a previously underexplored privacy attack surface and highlight the need for systematic privacy evaluation of DLMs.
title: Membership Inference in Fine-tuned Diffusion Language Models via Token-level Memorization Asymmetry
title_translated: 通过令牌级记忆不对称实现微调扩散语言模型的成员推断
summary_translated: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）最近作为自回归语言模型的替代建模范式出现，具有并行生成和双向上下文建模等优势。尽管对其生成能力的兴趣日益增长，但 DLMs 的隐私风险仍缺乏充分探索。我们通过扩散训练动态的理论分析识别出一种称为令牌级记忆不对称的现象。基于此发现，我们提出了 Q-Skew，一种基于分位数加权偏度的成员推断指标，适用于微调后的 DLMs。在多个微调数据集和模型上的实验表明，该方法优于现有基线。此外，我们还展示了 Q-Skew 可用于其他隐私侵犯行为，如个人身份信息（PII）提取。我们的研究揭示了一个此前未被充分关注的隐私攻击面，并强调了对 DLMs 进行系统性隐私评估的必要性。

summary: Customer-service QA in an AI contact center (AICC) runs under deployment constraints that benchmark QA misses: tight voice-hotline latency and a high cost for unsupported or wrong automatic answers. We deploy a system that answers only from a closed set of verified QA units: it returns a retrieved unit verbatim, or routes to clarify, abstain, or handoff. The index is enriched offline by staged linguistic seeding (SLS): a human authors a per-unit world-grounded slot recipe, gpt-4.1-mini renders it into variants, and a light human gate filters them. One methodology is reused across both domains, so inference stays a single retrieval pass with no query-time generation. On held-out query variants from two industrial domains, SLS lifts hybrid R@1 to 0.881/0.930 (+0.27/+0.34), with gains across all five retrievers tested. At the same gpt-4.1-mini generation budget, SLS beats doc2query by +0.20/+0.32, while cross-provenance evaluation provides additional evidence of transfer across generated-query distributions. Verified-unit answering also removes free-form generation's unsupported-content surface (7-13% versus approximately 0%). We report this as an application study, including negative results.
title: Staged Linguistic Seeding: Grounded Query Expansion for Verified-Unit QA in AI Contact Centers
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted to the Grounding Language Models (GroundLM) Workshop at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 分阶段语言播种：面向AI客服中心验证单元问答的 grounded 查询扩展
summary_translated: AI客服中心（AICC）中的客户服务问答在部署约束下运行，这些约束导致传统基准测试遗漏问题：严格的语音热线延迟要求以及错误或不支持自动回答的高成本。我们部署了一个仅从一组已验证的QA单元中回答的系统：它直接返回检索到的单元内容，或引导至澄清、回避或转接。索引通过分阶段语言播种（SLS）离线增强：人类作者为每个单元编写基于现实世界的槽位配方，GPT-4.1-mini将其生成多种变体，并由轻量级人工筛选。该方法在两个工业领域中复用，使推理保持单次检索，无需查询时生成。在两个工业领域的保留查询变体上，SLS将混合R@1提升至0.881/0.930（+0.27/+0.34），在所有五个测试检索器中均取得增益。在相同GPT-4.1-mini生成预算下，SLS优于doc2query（+0.20/+0.32），跨来源评估进一步证明了生成查询分布间的迁移能力。验证单元回答还消除了自由生成带来的非支持内容表面（7-13% vs 约0%）。本研究以应用研究形式报告，包含负面结果。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents typically relies on outcome rewards. However, it often fails to achieve effective credit assignment, due to the unclear value of intermediate steps. It is hard to separate their contributions from the final result. In this paper, we propose a dense process supervision method based on fact utility estimation, which models the reasoning process as the accumulation of discrete evidence facts. We first extract structured facts from raw observations and organize them into an explicit fact store. To support credit assignment, we then cluster semantically equivalent facts and infer the posterior utility of each fact cluster using Bayesian estimation over group rollouts. Finally, we convert the estimated fact utilities into dense step-level rewards to guide RL training. Experiments on seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines. Ablation studies validate clear relative improvements on multi-hop QA compared to outcome reward-only training.
title: Dense Process Supervision for Search Agents via Fact Utility Estimation
comment: Accepted in the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
title_translated: 基于事实效用估计的密集过程监督用于搜索智能体
summary_translated: 搜索智能体的强化学习（RL）通常依赖于最终结果奖励，但往往难以实现有效的信用分配，因为中间步骤的价值不明确，其贡献难以与最终结果分离。本文提出一种基于事实效用估计的密集过程监督方法，将推理过程建模为离散证据事实的累积。我们首先从原始观测中提取结构化事实，并组织成显式的事实存储。为支持信用分配，我们对语义等价的事实进行聚类，并使用贝叶斯估计在组回放基础上推断每个事实簇的后验效用。最后，我们将估计的事实效用转化为密集的步骤级奖励以指导RL训练。在七个单跳和多跳问答基准上的实验表明，该方法持续优于现有基线。消融研究验证了在多跳问答任务上相比仅使用结果奖励训练的显著相对提升。

summary: The exponential growth of scientific publications calls for automatic Information Extraction (IE) systems to support knowledge discovery. In this context, the GutBrainIE benchmark evaluates Named Entity Recognition (NER), Named Entity Recognition and Disambiguation (NERD), and Relation Extraction (RE) systems in the gut-brain axis domain. We propose Two-stage Workflow for Information eXtraction (TWIX), an end-to-end IE pipeline featuring three interconnected modules, each leveraging a two-stage framework to solve all four GutBrainIE subtasks. Evaluation on the development and test sets shows that our method substantially outperforms the baseline by a wide margin, while also ranking first among all participant submissions across all subtasks. These results indicate that the proposed two-stage pipeline effectively improves both precision and recall in practical settings.
title: TWIX: a Two-Stage Approach for End-To-End Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction
comment: Accepted at CLEF 2026: the 17th Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum
title_translated: TWIX：一种端到端命名实体识别与关系抽取的两阶段方法
summary_translated: 科学出版物的指数增长呼唤自动化信息抽取（IE）系统以支持知识发现。在此背景下，GutBrainIE基准评估了在肠-脑轴领域中的命名实体识别（NER）、命名实体识别与消歧（NERD）以及关系抽取（RE）系统。我们提出了两阶段信息抽取流程（TWIX），一个端到端的IE流水线，包含三个相互关联的模块，每个模块均采用两阶段框架来解决GutBrainIE的全部四项子任务。在开发集和测试集上的评估显示，我们的方法大幅超越基线，且在所有子任务中均排名第一。这些结果表明，所提出的两阶段流水线在实际场景中有效提升了精度与召回率。

summary: Multi-party interaction is a central setting for human communication and a necessary target for human-agent interaction systems that must participate in group conversation. Yet available corpora often focus on meetings, task-oriented interaction, text-based interaction, or acted scenarios, and fewer resources support cross-linguistic comparison of spontaneous face-to-face triadic discussion. This paper presents TEIDAN, a multilingual multimodal corpus that currently consists of Japanese and English three-party conversations. TEIDAN records groups of three participants discussing open-ended topics with individual pin microphones, a microphone array, and participant-facing cameras, and provides IPU-based transcripts for both language portions. Earlier studies used subsets of the Japanese portion for task-specific benchmarks in multi-party dialogue modeling; in contrast, this paper presents TEIDAN as a corpus resource spanning both Japanese and English, with planned expansion to additional languages. We describe the collection design, participants, recording setup, transcription format, and corpus statistics, and provide preliminary analyses to illustrate how TEIDAN can support research on turn-taking, addressee recognition, and multimodal grounding in human-human and human-agent interaction.
title: TEIDAN: A Multilingual Multiparty Dialogue Corpus
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. To appear in the Companion Proceedings of the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI Companion '26)
title_translated: TEIDAN：一个多语言多方对话语料库
summary_translated: 多方互动是人类交流的核心场景，也是必须参与群体对话的人机交互系统的重要目标。然而，现有语料库大多聚焦于会议、任务导向型互动、文本交互或表演性场景，较少资源支持自发面对面三人讨论的跨语言比较。本文介绍了TEIDAN，一个多语言多模态语料库，目前包含日语和英语的三方对话。TEIDAN记录三名参与者围绕开放主题进行讨论，配备个人麦克风、麦克风阵列和面向参与者的摄像头，并提供基于IPU的双语转录文本。先前研究曾使用日语部分的子集构建特定任务的多方对话建模基准；相比之下，本文将TEIDAN作为涵盖日语和英语的语料资源，并计划扩展至更多语言。我们描述了数据采集设计、参与者、录音设置、转录格式及语料库统计，并提供初步分析，展示TEIDAN如何支持关于轮流发言、指称识别和人机/人际互动中的多模态对齐的研究。

summary: As one of the most critical challenges in large language models, contextual faithfulness directly determines their reliability in knowledge-intensive applications. This task is particularly challenging as it requires balancing factual consistency with generation efficiency. Contrastive decoding methods require dual forward passes (with and without context) to compare model outputs, doubling inference computational overhead, while post-training alignment demands extensive reinforcement learning with substantial computational overhead. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{SFAD}, a speculative decoding framework that enhances contextual faithfulness without inference degradation. We first construct \textbf{ConFide}, a preference dataset with fine-grained atomic perturbations, to train a context-faithful draft model via Direct Preference Optimization. During inference, Epistemic Friction detects potential hallucinations by quantifying distributional tension weighted by specialist certainty. When friction exceeds the threshold, Asymmetric Logit Steering refines the target distribution through residual-based logit injection; otherwise, standard speculation proceeds. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFAD substantially improves faithfulness while achieving $2.48\times$ speedup, offering a practical solution for efficient LLMs.
title: SFAD: Speculative Factuality-Aware Decoding
title_translated: SFAD：一种推测性事实性感知解码
summary_translated: 在大型语言模型中，上下文忠实性是最关键的挑战之一，直接决定其在知识密集型应用中的可靠性。这一任务尤其具有挑战性，因为它需要在事实一致性与生成效率之间取得平衡。对比解码方法需要两次前向传播（有无上下文）来比较模型输出，导致推理计算开销翻倍；而事后对齐则需要大量强化学习，带来巨大的计算负担。为应对这一挑战，我们提出	extbf{SFAD}，一种推测性解码框架，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升上下文忠实性。我们首先构建	extbf{ConFide}，一个带有细粒度原子扰动的偏好数据集，通过直接偏好优化训练一个上下文忠实的草稿模型。在推理过程中，认知摩擦通过量化专家确定性加权的分布张力来检测潜在幻觉；当摩擦超过阈值时，非对称逻辑转向通过基于残差的逻辑注入修正目标分布；否则，标准推测继续进行。大量实验表明，SFAD显著提升了忠实性，同时实现了2.48倍的速度提升，为高效LLM提供了实用解决方案。

summary: In this work, we introduce Instella-MoE, a fully open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 16 billion total parameters and 2.8 billion active parameters per token, trained entirely from scratch on AMD Instinct MI300X and MI325X GPUs. Instella-MoE combines a sparsely activated MoE design with architectural and system-level innovations, including Gated Multi-head Latent Attention (Gated MLA) and FarSkip-Collective connectivity, enabling efficient large-scale training and inference. The model is developed through a multi-stage pipeline comprising pre-training, mid-training, long-context extension, supervised fine-tuning with feedback-driven data curation, direct preference optimization, and reinforcement learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Instella-MoE achieves an average score of 76.7 across standard pre-training benchmarks, outperforming prior fully open models including OLMo-3-7B, SmolLM3-3B, and OLMoE-1B-7B, while remaining competitive with open-weight MoE and dense baselines at comparable active-parameter scales, including Moonlight-16B-A3B and Qwen3.5-4B. After post-training, our final Think checkpoint achieves an average score of 73.2 across instruction-following, reasoning, math, coding, and chat benchmarks, outperforming both fully open and open-weight models with comparable or larger active parameter counts in our evaluation. To support transparent and reproducible research, we release the complete Instella-MoE model flow, including model weights, training configurations, data mixtures, and training code. Together, these contributions establish Instella-MoE a strong, fully open foundation for efficient, high-performing MoE models and reproducible research.
title: Instella-MoE Technical Report
title_translated: Instella-MoE 技术报告
summary_translated: 本文介绍了 Instella-MoE，一个完全开源的专家混合（MoE）语言模型，总参数量为160亿，每token激活参数量为28亿，完全在AMD Instinct MI300X和MI325X GPU上从零开始训练。Instella-MoE结合了稀疏激活的MoE设计与架构及系统级创新，包括门控多头潜在注意力（Gated MLA）和FarSkip-Collective连接机制，实现了高效的规模化训练与推理。该模型通过多阶段流程开发，包括预训练、中期训练、长上下文扩展、基于反馈驱动数据整理的监督微调、直接偏好优化以及多教师在线策略蒸馏的强化学习。Instella-MoE在标准预训练基准测试中平均得分为76.7，优于此前完全开源模型如OLMo-3-7B、SmolLM3-3B和OLMoE-1B-7B，同时在相近激活参数规模下与开源权重MoE及密集基线模型（如Moonlight-16B-A3B和Qwen3.5-4B）保持竞争力。经过后训练，我们的最终Think检查点在指令遵循、推理、数学、编程和聊天基准测试中平均得分为73.2，超越了具有可比或更大激活参数量的完全开源及开源权重模型。为支持透明且可复现的研究，我们发布了完整的Instella-MoE模型流程，包括模型权重、训练配置、数据混合及训练代码。这些贡献共同确立了Instella-MoE作为高效、高性能MoE模型和可复现研究的强大、完全开源基础。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to decline queries that fall outside their knowledge (knowledge-based refusal, KR) or violate safety policies (safety-based refusal, SR). Although KR and SR result in superficially similar responses, they have largely been studied in isolation, leaving open whether they share an underlying mechanism. We address this gap with a systematic study on a new dataset of 213 contrastive quadruples that jointly probe both refusal types. We find that KR and SR are governed by overlapping yet distinguishable mechanisms. Both share a refusal direction, yet the overlap is asymmetric: SR signals transfer more strongly to KR than the reverse. Type-specific specialization emerges mainly in upper layers, with KR aligning with uncertainty- and knowledge-related representations and SR with safety- and policy-related ones. We thus characterize refusal as a commit-then-specify process: a shared initial mechanism commits to refusing, then type-specific features in later layers specify whether the grounds are epistemic or normative.
title: A Unified Mechanistic Analysis of Knowledge- and Safety-Based Refusals
title_translated: 知识与安全拒绝的统一机制分析
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被训练以拒绝超出其知识范围的问题（基于知识的拒绝，KR）或违反安全政策的问题（基于安全的拒绝，SR）。尽管KR和SR在表面响应上相似，但它们长期以来被孤立研究，尚未明确二者是否共享底层机制。我们通过一项新数据集（包含213组对比四元组）对这两种拒绝类型进行系统性研究，发现KR和SR由重叠但可区分的机制支配。两者共享一个拒绝方向，但这种重叠呈不对称性：SR信号向KR的传递强于反向。特定类型的专业化主要出现在网络上层，其中KR与不确定性及知识相关表征对齐，而SR则与安全和政策相关表征对齐。因此，我们将拒绝过程描述为‘先承诺再指定’：共享的初始机制决定拒绝，随后在后续层中的类型特异性特征确定拒绝依据是认知性的还是规范性的。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly handle in-context learning (ICL) tasks where a long, novel context defines the rules, knowledge, and output schema for a series of questions. On benchmarks that grade against every detail of the context, even strong open-weights models pass only 12-16% of tasks: a single overlooked rule fails the whole response. We argue this brittleness is structural: the dominant "read-and-reason" paradigm asks the model to extract, plan, generate, and self-verify in one forward pass. We therefore ask whether explicit context compilation can fix it, how it compares to existing long-context strategies (gist retrieval, multi-agent self-play), and where the resulting harness benefit holds across task structure and model scale. We propose the Context Compilation Architecture (CCA), whose central novelty is a typed intermediate representation (IR) with fixed slots (rules.{must_do, must_not, conditional}, output_spec, available_tools, data_profile) into which any prose context is compiled once; executable verifiers and a violation-gated correction loop follow as downstream consequences. On CL-bench (1,899 tasks across 4 open base models), CCA outperforms vanilla prompting and two long-context baselines (ReadAgent-P, Ctx2Skill) on every base model, lifting Kimi K2.5 from 15.4% to 21.4% with gains concentrated on rule-dense sub-categories. Code and cached completions are available at https://github.com/TonyQJH/cca-emnlp2026.
title: Compile, Don't Memorize: A Context Compilation Architecture (CCA) for In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Findings). Code, data, and cached completions available at this https URL
title_translated: 编译而非记忆：用于上下文学习的上下文编译架构（CCA）
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地处理上下文学习（ICL）任务，其中长篇新颖的上下文定义了一系列问题的规则、知识和输出格式。在要求严格匹配上下文每一细节的基准测试中，即使强大的开源权重模型也仅能完成12%-16%的任务：只要遗漏一条规则，整个响应即失败。我们认为这种脆弱性源于结构缺陷：主流的‘读取并推理’范式要求模型在一次前向传播中完成提取、规划、生成和自我验证。因此，我们探讨了显式上下文编译能否解决此问题，其与现有长上下文策略（如摘要检索、多智能体自博弈）的比较，以及该方法在不同任务结构和模型规模下的适用性。我们提出上下文编译架构（CCA），其核心创新在于一种带固定槽位（rules.{must_do, must_not, conditional}, output_spec, available_tools, data_profile）的类型化中间表示（IR），任何自然语言上下文均可一次性编译进入该结构；后续则由可执行验证器和违规触发的纠错循环构成。在CL-bench（涵盖4个开源基础模型的1,899个任务）上，CCA在所有基础模型上均优于原始提示和两种长上下文基线（ReadAgent-P、Ctx2Skill），将Kimi K2.5的性能从15.4%提升至21.4%，增益集中在规则密集子类别。代码与缓存补全已公开于https://github.com/TonyQJH/cca-emnlp2026。

summary: The Mutual Reinforcement Effect (MRE) asks whether a fine, span-level and a coarse, document-level task help each other when one model handles both. We test it in multimodal document understanding on three corpora, two of receipts and one of scanned business forms, comparing single-task, joint and conditioned training, which puts one granularity's gold output in the other's prompt during training only. We build Doc-MRE, an annotation layer pairing gold field extraction (point) with four document-level facets (line), from a three-judge LLM committee under a pre-registration, validated by blind re-annotation. One predicate, fixed in advance: at a shared recipe, a regime reinforces if it beats the matched single-task model on both granularities. Mixed joint training, the arrangement prior MRE work assumes, reinforces on no corpus at the main scale: it is below both single-task models on CORD and trades one granularity for the other on the two others, as single-task tuning does. Conditioned training reinforces on two of the three, CORD (+0.5 point, +4.8 line) and the forms corpus (+7.2 point, +11.0 line), resolvably on the coarse side and directionally on the fine one, and trades on WildReceipt; at that recipe no alternative measurably beats it on either side anywhere. Two byte-identical-prompt controls separate content from format: shuffled conditioning destroys the coarse-side skill but costs the fine side far less, and a neutral-content control reproduces the whole fine-side gain on WildReceipt, which is therefore prompt structure but buys nothing resolvable on the other two. On the forms corpus conditioning buys collapse avoidance: mixed training and the neutral control both assign the majority semantic label to all 50 test documents; only conditioning recovers the gold distribution. Probes find the information decodable under every regime with no resolvable increase under conditioning.
title: Joint Training Is Not Enough: Conditioned Cross-Granularity Training for Multimodal Document Understanding
title_translated: 联合训练不足：面向多模态文档理解的条件跨粒度训练
summary_translated: 互增强效应（MRE）探讨当单一模型同时处理细粒度（跨度级）和粗粒度（文档级）任务时，二者是否能够相互促进。我们在三个语料库上测试这一假设，包括两个收据语料库和一个扫描商业表单语料库，比较单任务、联合训练与条件训练（仅在训练期间将一种粒度的真实输出放入另一种粒度的提示中）。我们构建了Doc-MRE，一个标注层，将真实字段提取（点级）与四个文档级方面（行级）配对，由三名评委组成的LLM委员会在预注册下完成，并通过盲法重新标注验证。设定一个固定前提：在共享方案下，若某方案在两个粒度上均优于对应的单任务模型，则视为增强。混合联合训练（MRE先前研究假设的安排）在主规模下未在任一语料库上实现增强：在CORD上低于两个单任务模型，在其他两个语料库上则以牺牲一个粒度换取另一个，与单任务调优表现一致。而条件训练在三个语料库中的两个上实现增强：CORD（+0.5分，+4.8行）和表单语料库（+7.2分，+11.0行），在粗粒度侧可分辨地增强，在细粒度侧方向性增强，而在WildReceipt上则出现权衡；在此方案下，任何替代方法在任一侧均无显著优势。两个字节完全相同的提示控制实验分离内容与格式：打乱条件破坏了粗粒度技能但对细粒度影响较小，而中性内容控制重现了WildReceipt上的全部细粒度增益，表明该增益源于提示结构，但在其他两组上无法带来可分辨的收益。在表单语料库中，条件训练避免了崩溃：混合训练和中性控制均将多数语义标签分配给全部50个测试文档；唯有条件训练恢复了真实分布。探测实验显示，在所有训练模式下信息均可解码，但条件训练并未带来可分辨的提升。

summary: A transformer carries each token's state from layer to layer, and the whole vocabulary carried together forms a cloud that moves with depth. We ask whether a trained network moves this cloud the way optimal transport would: at the cheapest cost, and along the map that pairs each token with its optimal destination. We measure both on Pythia-160m and Pythia-410m, with an exact assignment between consecutive layer clouds, a measured sampling floor, calibration on couplings known to be optimal, and a split of the cost into the common shift of the cloud and the token-specific moves. At the last layer, both models move their tokens where the optimal-transport map sends them, at the optimal cost for Pythia-410m and slightly above it for Pythia-160m. At the first layer they do not. In between, single layers can be judged on cost at only two of ten transitions, and blocks of several layers move the cloud at close to the optimal cost. The agreement at the last layer is much weaker at initialisation (0.64 against 0.86) and grows with training.
title: Measuring Optimal Transport in Transformer Depth
title_translated: 测量Transformer深度中的最优传输
summary_translated: Transformer模型将每个token的状态从一层传递到另一层，整个词汇表共同构成一个随深度移动的“云”。我们探究训练后的网络是否以最优传输的方式移动这个“云”：以最低成本，并沿着将每个token与其最优目的地配对的地图移动。我们在Pythia-160m和Pythia-410m模型上进行了测量，采用连续层间云之间的精确匹配，测量采样下限，使用已知最优的耦合关系进行校准，并将成本分解为云的整体平移和token特异性的移动。在最后一层，两个模型都将token移动到最优传输地图所指向的位置，Pythia-410m达到最优成本，而Pythia-160m略高于最优成本。但在第一层，模型并未如此操作。在中间层，仅有十次转换中的两次可以按成本判断单个层的表现，而多个层的组合块则几乎以最优成本移动云。在最后层的匹配度在初始化时较弱（0.64 vs 0.86），并随着训练逐步提升。

summary: Large language models increasingly generate research ideas, yet judging their novelty or feasibility at generation time does not establish whether they anticipate subsequent work. We introduce IdeaForecastBench to evaluate research idea forecasting. Given a community's literature up to a cutoff, a system produces up to five ranked ideas, which are evaluated against later papers. The benchmark comprises 624 rolling episodes across 52 topics, with a fixed retrieve-then-judge protocol and separately reported results from two judges. We compare five history-compression strategies across GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-7B/14B, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with a learned Mode-Decomposition Forecaster (MDF). Under the primary GPT-4.1-mini judge, Summary improves on Direct in Hit@5 and Precision@5 across all four backbones. Qwen2.5 scores above GPT-4.1, whereas Qwen3.5 scores below it. An outcome-blind assessment finds that Qwen2.5 produces broader forecasts, but does not identify how much breadth contributes to its advantage. Threshold and judge diagnostics further clarify the limits of interpreting realization as precise anticipation.
