IdeaForecastBench provides a common task for studying which research ideas a community subsequently pursues and how reliably this outcome can be measured.
title: Can Large Language Models Forecast What Researchers Study Next?
title_translated: 大型语言模型能否预测研究人员接下来的研究方向？
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地生成研究想法，但在生成时判断其新颖性或可行性并不能确定它们是否能够预示后续工作。我们提出了IdeaForecastBench，用于评估研究想法的预测能力。给定一个研究领域截至某一时间点的文献，系统生成最多五个排序后的研究想法，并与之后发表的论文进行对比评估。该基准涵盖52个主题的624个滚动实验周期，采用固定的检索-评判协议，并由两位独立评审员分别报告结果。我们在GPT-4.1、Qwen2.5-7B/14B和Qwen3.5-9B上比较了五种历史压缩策略，以及一种学习得到的模式分解预测器（MDF）。在主要的GPT-4.1-mini评审标准下，Summary策略在所有四个模型上均优于Direct策略，在Hit@5和Precision@5指标上表现更优。Qwen2.5的表现优于GPT-4.1，而Qwen3.5则表现较差。无结果偏见的评估发现，Qwen2.5生成的预测范围更广，但无法确定这种广度对其优势的贡献程度。阈值和评审诊断进一步揭示了将实现视为精确预判的局限性。IdeaForecastBench为研究社区后续关注的研究方向及其可测量性的可靠性提供了一个统一任务。

summary: The SAIR Mathematics Distillation Challenge on Equational Theories asks a solver to classify whether one magma identity implies another and, for either verdict, to return a certificate accepted by a deterministic Lean judge. We present a single-file solver organized as a cheapest-first cascade. Its false branch combines coefficient tests over structured algebra families, bounded finite-model search, an explicit central-groupoid witness, and several infinite-carrier witnesses. Its true branch is a proof-producing ordered unit superposition procedure with Knuth-Bendix ordering, bidirectional demodulation, indexing, memoised substitution, and anytime size deepening. Search results remain outside the trusted base: successful derivations are replayed as small Lean terms, and countermodels are rechecked by the competition judge.   The frozen solver is a 189,504-byte Python file with SHA-256 f2392533c9f4c03b.... In local runs through official judge revision 2848228, it produced accepted certificates for all 1,889 rows of the six public sets with no language-model calls. Separate measurements recorded full agreement on the 800 published Stage 1 evaluation-distribution problems, 100 accepted rows in the canonical Marathon manifest without tokens, and 200 accepted rows in the hosted playground. These are regression and playground measurements, not a leaderboard result and not evidence about a hidden set. All quantitative claims are tied to immutable result ledgers; the paper makes no completeness or comparative-superiority claim.
title: A Certificate-Producing Cascade for Equational Implication: The SAIR EQT2 Stage 2 Solver
title_translated: 等式蕴含的证书生成级联：SAIR EQT2阶段2求解器
summary_translated: SAIR数学蒸馏挑战赛中的等式理论问题要求求解器判断一个代数恒等式是否蕴含另一个，并针对任一结论返回可被确定性Lean验证器接受的证明证书。我们提出了一种单文件组织的最便宜优先级联求解器。其错误分支结合了结构化代数族上的系数测试、有界有限模型搜索、显式的中心群胚见证以及多个无限载体见证；其正确分支是一个可生成证明的有序单位超叠加程序，采用Knuth-Bendix排序、双向归约、索引、记忆化替换和任意深度递增机制。搜索结果不位于可信基础内：成功的推导以小型Lean项形式重放，反例模型由竞赛验证器重新检查。该冻结求解器是一个189,504字节的Python文件，SHA-256哈希为f2392533c9f4c03b...。在官方验证器第2848228版的本地运行中，它在六个公开数据集共1,889行上成功生成了全部被接受的证书，且未调用任何语言模型。单独测量显示，其在800个已发布阶段1评估分布问题上完全一致，可在无token情况下通过规范马拉松清单中的100行，以及托管沙盒中的200行。这些是回归测试和沙盒测试结果，非排行榜成绩，也不代表对隐藏数据集的表现。所有定量结论均基于不可变的结果记录；本文未声称完备性或相对优越性。

summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly sensitive to retrieval noise: when retrieved documents mix informative and irrelevant context, LLMs are easily distracted, leading to hallucinations. To overcome this, we propose SCoNE (Selective Context-aware Neuron Editing), a training-free model editing approach that improves retrieval noise robustness by selectively strengthening context-aware FFN neurons that are identified by both high attribution and high cross-input variability. SCoNE requires only a small number of mining samples, no fine-tuning, and no inference-time overhead. Across various knowledge-intensive question-answering benchmarks and two LLM backbones, SCoNE consistently outperforms competitive baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SCoNE.
title: SCoNE: Selective Context-aware Neuron Editing for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: SCoNE：面向鲁棒检索增强生成的选择性上下文感知神经元编辑
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）对检索噪声高度敏感：当检索到的文档混合了有用和无关的上下文时，大语言模型容易分心，导致幻觉。为克服这一问题，我们提出SCoNE（选择性上下文感知神经元编辑），一种无需训练的模型编辑方法，通过有选择地强化由高归因度和高跨输入变异性共同识别出的上下文感知前馈神经元，提升对检索噪声的鲁棒性。SCoNE仅需少量挖掘样本，无需微调，也无推理时开销。在多种知识密集型问答基准及两种大语言模型骨干网络上，SCoNE始终优于现有基线方法。代码已开源：https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SCoNE。

summary: Article-level news stance detection aims to identify the perspective of news articles toward social issues. Despite advances in stance detection and its importance for trustworthy media environments, news articles pose distinct challenges because their stances are often implicit, subtly conveyed through journalistic framing, and embedded in long, structurally complex texts. To address these challenges, we introduce VFStance, which leverages visual framing to make implicit stance cues more explicit via image generation. In evaluation experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of VFStance over existing methods and the contribution of visual framing to its performance. Finally, a controlled user study (N=200) in a snippet-based news consumption setting further demonstrates that VFStance can make stance signals visually salient and highlights its potential use beyond automated stance detection.
title: Visual Framing for News Stance Detection via Image Generation
title_translated: 通过图像生成实现新闻立场检测的视觉框架
summary_translated: 文章级新闻立场检测旨在识别新闻文章对社会议题的立场。尽管立场检测技术已有进展且对构建可信媒体环境至关重要，但新闻文章的立场往往隐含于文本之中，通过新闻报道框架微妙传达，且嵌入在长篇、结构复杂的文本中，带来独特挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出VFStance，利用视觉框架通过图像生成使隐含的立场线索更加明确。在评估实验中，我们展示了VFStance相较于现有方法的有效性，并验证了视觉框架对其性能的贡献。最后，在基于片段的新闻消费场景中开展的受控用户研究（N=200）进一步表明，VFStance能使立场信号在视觉上更显著，凸显其在自动化立场检测之外的应用潜力。

summary: Creative generation tasks, such as narrative writing and scientific ideation, demand both high-quality outputs and distinct responses across independent runs to maximize exploration. Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has shown strong quality gains on factual and reasoning tasks, making it a natural candidate for creative generation. However, we find its convergence-driven design actively suppresses output diversity across independent runs, creating an inherent trade-off with creative tasks. We theoretically show that preserving diversity among agents within each debate session is a necessary condition for achieving diverse outputs across independent runs. Building on this finding, we propose Creative-MAD, which introduces two synergistic interventions to sustain agent divergence. Specifically, Cognitive Lens Assignment counters identity drift by anchoring each agent to a distinct and persistent cognitive mode, while Embedding-based Peer Selection counters majority pull by limiting each agent's context to its most semantically distant peers. Experiments across four creative benchmarks demonstrate that Creative-MAD significantly enhances both lexical and semantic diversity while maintaining MAD's output quality.
title: Creative Generation via Multi-Agent Debate: Does Debate Suppress Diversity?
title_translated: 多智能体辩论驱动的创造性生成：辩论是否会抑制多样性？
summary_translated: 创造性生成任务（如叙事写作和科学构想）需要在独立运行中既产出高质量内容，又保持响应差异性，以最大化探索空间。多智能体辩论（MAD）在事实性和推理任务中表现出显著的质量提升，使其成为创造性生成的自然候选方案。然而，我们发现其以收敛为导向的设计会主动抑制独立运行间的输出多样性，造成与创造性任务的内在矛盾。我们从理论上证明，在每次辩论会话中保持智能体间的多样性是实现跨独立运行多样性的必要条件。基于此发现，我们提出Creative-MAD，引入两项协同干预机制以维持智能体分歧：认知视角分配通过将每个智能体锚定于特定且持久的认知模式，防止身份漂移；基于嵌入的同伴选择通过限制每个智能体的上下文为其语义上最远的同伴，对抗多数压力。在四个创造性基准上的实验表明，Creative-MAD显著提升了词汇和语义多样性，同时保持了MAD原有的输出质量。

summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance on image-grounded text generation and visual question answering. However, it remains difficult for them to comprehensively and accurately describe the factual relations among the entities and concepts associated with the objects depicted in an image. In this work, we propose a framework that efficiently exploits factual information from a knowledge graph via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), with the goal of enabling LVLMs to generate detailed and accurate image explanations. Specifically, our method alternates between answer generation and knowledge-graph retrieval, and controls the search using a correctness judgment, thereby acquiring the necessary and sufficient factual information efficiently. We also construct a knowledge graph for the artwork domain (ExpArt-KG), in which the correspondence between images and entities is unambiguous. Applying the proposed method to this knowledge graph, we show experimentally that it improves the level of detail of artwork explanations and reduces the retrieval cost of external knowledge while maintaining generation quality comparable to that of iterating a fixed number of times.
title: ExpArt-KG: Artwork Image Description Generation through Iterative Exploration of Knowledge Graphs
title_translated: ExpArt-KG：通过知识图谱的迭代探索生成艺术作品图像描述
summary_translated: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在基于图像的文本生成和视觉问答任务中表现优异。然而，它们在全面且准确地描述图像中对象相关实体与概念之间的事实关系方面仍存在困难。本文提出一种框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）高效利用知识图谱中的事实信息，旨在使LVLM能够生成详细且准确的图像解释。具体而言，我们的方法在答案生成与知识图谱检索之间交替进行，并通过正确性判断控制搜索过程，从而高效获取必要且充分的事实信息。我们还构建了一个面向艺术作品领域的知识图谱（ExpArt-KG），其中图像与实体之间的对应关系明确无误。将所提方法应用于该知识图谱，实验表明其显著提升了艺术作品解释的细节程度，同时降低了外部知识的检索成本，且生成质量与固定次数迭代相当。

summary: A prominent paradigm in inference-time alignment employs lightweight supervisors to steer Large Language Models (LLMs). Through empirical analysis, we identify a structural mismatch in this paradigm: weak supervisors exhibit pervasive high entropy across the vast majority of tokens, yet prevailing dense intervention approaches mandate supervision at every decoding step. This leads to frequent low-confidence interventions that can disrupt valid base-model reasoning and incur substantial utility costs. To resolve this, we propose TUSA (Trust-based Uncertainty Sparse Alignment). Moving away from continuous oversight, TUSA reframes alignment as a dynamic arbitration process, introducing an uncertainty-aware arbiter that authorizes intervention only when two conditions are met: the supervisor is confident and the token is semantically salient. This mechanism effectively filters out uncertainty-driven noise and redundant supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that TUSA consistently improves both safety alignment and general helpfulness. By bypassing approximately 50% of alignment steps, it not only enhances safety preference by up to 15.6%, but also boosts general preference rates by up to 12.0% compared to the dense baseline, demonstrating that selective, high-precision alignment can outperform continuous supervision.
title: Trust Your Guide Only When Certain: Uncertainty-Aware Sparse Alignment at Inference Time
title_translated: 仅在确定时才信任引导者：推理时的不确定性感知稀疏对齐
summary_translated: 在推理阶段对齐的一种主流范式是使用轻量级监督者来引导大型语言模型（LLMs）。通过实证分析，我们发现该范式存在结构不匹配问题：弱监督者在绝大多数标记上表现出普遍的高熵，但当前密集干预方法要求在每个解码步骤都进行监督。这导致频繁的低置信度干预，可能破坏基础模型的有效推理并带来巨大的效用成本。为解决此问题，我们提出TUSA（基于信任的不确定性感知稀疏对齐）。不同于持续监控，TUSA将对齐重新定义为动态仲裁过程，引入一个不确定性感知仲裁器，仅当满足两个条件时才授权干预：监督者具有信心且该标记语义显著。该机制有效过滤了由不确定性驱动的噪声和冗余监督。在多个模型和基准上的大量实验表明，TUSA始终提升了安全对齐性和通用帮助性。通过跳过约50%的对齐步骤，它不仅使安全偏好提升高达15.6%，还比密集基线提升了最高12.0%的通用偏好率，证明选择性、高精度对齐优于持续监督。

summary: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate autonomous agents at scale, in place of costly human evaluations. Despite this promise, these simulators exhibit "assistant bias," a tendency to cooperate and pursue task goals. They rarely reproduce the frustration or disengagement that real users exhibit, compromising evaluation validity. Prior work outlines that this bias is baked in during model training, which role-playing prompts fail to override. We analyze this bias from model activations, extracting a user role vector by contrasting how the model represents user versus assistant perspectives on the same dialogue. We observe two findings: (i) the user direction is identifiable in activations, elicits user-like behaviors, and captures characteristics distinct from assistant traits; and (ii) although user-role activation associates with simulation realism and steering strengthens it, it can exaggerate user behaviors and override individual user profiles. Together, our findings provide a representation-level analysis of LLM user simulators, confirming that assistant bias is structurally identifiable and that user behavior can be directionally analyzed.
title: Investigating Assistant Bias in LLM User Simulators Using a Role Vector
title_translated: 使用角色向量探究LLM用户模拟器中的助手偏见
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的用户模拟器正被广泛用于大规模评估自主智能体，以替代昂贵的人类评估。尽管前景广阔，这些模拟器存在“助手偏见”，即倾向于合作并追求任务目标。它们很少再现真实用户表现出的挫败或脱离状态，从而损害评估的有效性。先前研究指出，这种偏见在模型训练过程中已根深蒂固，角色扮演提示无法有效纠正。我们从模型激活角度分析这一偏见，通过对比模型在相同对话中对用户与助手视角的表征，提取出用户角色向量。我们观察到两个发现：(i) 用户方向在激活中可识别，能引发类似用户的行为，并捕捉到与助手特征不同的特性；(ii) 尽管用户角色激活有助于提升模拟真实性，强化引导会使其过度放大用户行为并覆盖个体用户特征。综上，我们的研究提供了对LLM用户模拟器的表示层面分析，证实助手偏见具有结构性可识别性，且用户行为可进行方向性分析。

summary: Reranking methods, such as Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding and Quality Estimation (QE) reranking, are widely used in modern neural machine translation (NMT) to select an output from a set of candidate hypotheses. However, the performance gains come at the cost of high inference latency. Existing acceleration methods target MBR decoding and reduce only reranking computation, leaving QE reranking unaddressed and candidate generation---which can be the larger computational bottleneck---largely untouched. In this work, we propose Quit (Quantifying Uncertainty for Incremental Termination), a novel early-stopping strategy for the entire generation--reranking pipeline. Viewing candidate generation as a sequential decision under uncertainty, Quit incrementally generates and reranks candidates, stopping when the highest estimated quality in the candidate set stabilizes. Comprehensive experiments on three NMT models across 19 language pairs show that Quit yields end-to-end speedups of $1.47$--$2.66\times$ for MBR and $3.43$--$4.12\times$ for QE reranking while preserving translation quality within prespecified equivalence margins.
title: Quit While You're Ahead: Quit for Efficient Candidate Generation in Machine Translation Reranking
title_translated: 领先时就退出：机器翻译重排序中的高效候选生成提前终止策略
summary_translated: 重排序方法（如最小贝叶斯风险解码和质量估计重排序）广泛应用于现代神经机器翻译（NMT）中，用于从一组候选假设中选出最优输出。然而，性能提升伴随着高推理延迟。现有加速方法主要针对MBR解码，仅减少重排序计算，未涉及QE重排序，且候选生成——可能是更大的计算瓶颈——基本未受关注。本文提出Quit（不确定性量化以实现增量终止），一种全新的端到端生成-重排序流水线的提前终止策略。将候选生成视为一种在不确定性下的序列决策，Quit逐步生成并重排序候选，当候选集中最高估计质量趋于稳定时停止。在三个NMT模型、19个语言对上的全面实验表明，Quit在MBR场景下实现了1.47–2.66倍的端到端加速，在QE重排序中达到3.43–4.12倍加速，同时保持翻译质量在预设等价范围内。

summary: Ensuring factuality remains a critical challenge for deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detectors usually operate at a single level: claim-level methods provide interpretable factual units, while span-level methods localize unsupported text. Bridging these views is costly, as LLM-heavy pipelines require multiple decomposition and verification calls, and modular systems need additional claim-to-span alignment. We propose Enoki, an Open Information Extraction framework for multi-level hallucination detection. Enoki extracts text-anchored relational facts, verifies them against evidence, and projects unsupported facts back to hallucinated spans. This shared representation enables claim-level verification and span-level localization without requiring separate alignment. Enoki supports LLM-based, encoder-based, and rule-based extraction regimes, balancing accuracy and inference cost through a common interface. Experiments show that Enoki remains competitive with strong claim-level systems while using fewer resources and achieves superior performance on fine-grained span- and entity-level localization. We also release EnokiQA, a dual-granularity dataset with aligned claim-level verification and span-level localization annotations.
title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
title_translated: Enoki：高效的多层级幻觉检测
summary_translated: 确保事实准确性仍是将大语言模型部署于高风险场景中的关键挑战。现有的幻觉检测方法通常仅作用于单一层级：声明级方法提供可解释的事实单元，而跨度级方法定位无支持的文本片段。弥合这两种视角代价高昂，因为基于LLM的流水线需要多次分解与验证调用，而模块化系统还需额外的声明到跨度对齐。我们提出Enoki，一种用于多层级幻觉检测的开放信息抽取框架。Enoki提取以文本锚定的关系事实，将其与证据进行验证，并将未被支持的事实回映至幻觉跨度。共享表示使得声明级验证与跨度级定位无需单独对齐即可实现。Enoki支持基于LLM、编码器和规则的提取方式，通过统一接口平衡准确率与推理成本。实验表明，Enoki在保持与强声明级系统相当性能的同时，资源消耗更少，并在细粒度跨度级与实体级定位任务中表现更优。我们还发布了EnokiQA，一个包含对齐的声明级验证与跨度级定位标注的双粒度数据集。

summary: Multimodal memory offers a scalable interface for long-video question answering, but existing methods often retrieve captions, frames, transcripts, summaries, or graph facts as isolated fragments. Although searchable, such fragments are not generation-ready: language models must reconstruct cross-modal and temporal alignments at inference time, when context is limited and attribution is difficult. We propose EM^2Mem, an event-centric multimodal memory framework that binds heterogeneous evidence to event anchors during memory construction. Each event-indexed memory cell aligns multimodal records, temporal context, graph-linked relations, semantic facts, and provenance, enabling compact evidence readout over grounded multimodal events rather than modality-specific fragments. Across three long-video QA benchmarks, EM^2Mem improves average accuracy over the strongest memory baseline by 2.0, 2.4, and 3.7 points, improves strict event-level Top-5 evidence recall by 7.0 points, and reduces per-query latency by 4.67 times and total inference tokens by 63.66% (The code will be integrated into https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem).
title: EM^2Mem: Event-Centric Multimodal Memory for Large Language Models
title_translated: EM^2Mem：面向大语言模型的事件中心多模态记忆
summary_translated: 多模态记忆为长视频问答提供了可扩展的接口，但现有方法通常检索字幕、帧、转录文本、摘要或图谱事实等孤立片段。尽管这些片段可搜索，却无法直接生成：语言模型必须在推理时重建跨模态和时间对齐，而此时上下文有限且归属困难。我们提出EM^2Mem，一种以事件为中心的多模态记忆框架，在记忆构建过程中将异构证据绑定到事件锚点上。每个基于事件索引的记忆单元对齐多模态记录、时间上下文、图谱关联关系、语义事实及来源信息，实现围绕具体多模态事件的紧凑证据读取，而非针对特定模态的碎片。在三个长视频问答基准测试中，EM^2Mem相较于最强的记忆基线平均准确率分别提升2.0、2.4和3.7分，严格事件级Top-5证据召回率提升7.0分，查询延迟降低4.67倍，总推理token减少63.66%（代码将集成至https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem）。

summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly provided with contextual evidence in heterogeneous forms: as a text passage, as a rendered image of the same passage, or as both together. However, it remains unclear how consistently these surface forms are processed, especially when the evidence conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. We study modality robustness under knowledge conflict across 13 MLLMs and two datasets, and find them far from robust. (1) Contrary to common belief, models favor a context that contradicts parametric knowledge more readily in image form than in text form; (2) when a contradicting text and image are presented together, the preferred modality is essentially arbitrary, varying with input order, model, and dataset. We further demonstrate that this instability has practical consequences: it degrades performance in multimodal RAG and can be exploited by adversarial attacks. To alleviate this brittleness, we examine several simple techniques---prompting, steering, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and direct preference optimization; the majority prove ineffective, whereas SFT achieves moderate success. We therefore call for greater awareness of this inconsistency and argue that it is fundamental, demanding attention at multiple training stages.
title: Same Semantics, Different Outcome: On the Modality Robustness of Multimodal LLMs under Knowledge Conflict
title_translated: 相同语义，不同结果：多模态大语言模型在知识冲突下的模态鲁棒性研究
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地接收异构形式的上下文证据：以文本段落形式、同一段落的渲染图像形式，或两者结合的形式提供。然而，这些表面形式在处理上是否一致仍不明确，尤其是在证据与模型参数化知识冲突时。我们在13个MLLMs和两个数据集上研究了知识冲突下的模态鲁棒性，发现其远未达到稳健。首先，与普遍认知相反，模型更倾向于接受以图像形式呈现的与参数知识相矛盾的上下文；其次，当矛盾的文本与图像同时出现时，首选模态几乎完全任意，随输入顺序、模型和数据集而变化。我们进一步证明这种不稳定性具有实际后果：它会降低多模态RAG性能，并可被对抗攻击利用。为缓解这种脆弱性，我们考察了几种简单技术——提示工程、引导、监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化；多数无效，仅SFT取得适度成功。因此，我们呼吁提高对此不一致性的认识，并认为这是根本性问题，需在多个训练阶段予以关注。

summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, yet standard evaluations obscure whether retrieving these skills actually helps. Aggregate metrics often compare retrieved versus non-retrieved tasks, introducing severe selection bias and failing to isolate the true effect of skill use. To measure this actual-use capability-which we formalize as Skill Following (SF)-we introduce the Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect (RAE). RAE computes the same-task outcome difference between matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled executions, conditioned exclusively on tasks where the agent actively retrieved a skill. Evaluating 17 LLMs across coding and mathematical domains, we uncover a stark evaluation paradox: models frequently show positive aggregate retrieval lift but negative RAE. On MBPP+, multiple models that appear to benefit system-wide actually harm their own performance on the exact tasks where retrieval occurred. These findings demonstrate that aggregate averages can create a misleading illusion of tool-use proficiency, whereas RAE directly measures whether the retrieval-to-answer pipeline genuinely rescues more outcomes than it harms.
title: Skill Following: Evaluating Actual Skill Use in Retrieval-Enabled LLM Agents
title_translated: 技能跟随：评估检索增强型LLM代理中的实际技能使用情况
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越依赖外部技能，但标准评估方法掩盖了检索这些技能是否真正有效。聚合指标通常比较检索与非检索任务，引入严重的选择偏差，无法分离出技能使用的真正效果。为衡量这一实际使用能力——我们将其形式化为技能跟随（SF）——我们提出了检索触发的实际使用效应（RAE）。RAE计算在任务中代理主动检索技能的前提下，匹配的技能启用与技能禁用执行之间的同任务结果差异。在编码和数学领域对17个LLM进行评估后，我们发现一个显著的评估悖论：模型常表现出整体检索增益，但RAE却为负值。在MBPP+上，多个看似系统性受益的模型实际上在检索发生的确切任务中损害了自身表现。这些发现表明，聚合平均值可能制造出工具使用能力的误导性幻觉，而RAE则直接衡量检索到回答的流程是否真正挽救了更多结果而非造成伤害。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated improved machine translation performance over strong supervised baselines. This raises questions as to what mechanisms underlie how LLMs perform machine translation between languages. Motivated by recent interpretability findings--namely, that LLMs use massively multilingual latent feature representations to perform language modeling--we propose the interlingua hypothesis. The hypothesis holds that language models translate by reading a source sentence into a latent feature space, and generate a target sentence by reading from the latent feature space. We show three lines of evidence in support of this hypothesis: (1) variance in BLEU across language pairs is largely predictable from language-specific competences with no language pair-specific interaction terms; (2) many model components are causally influential in both monolingual tasks and translation tasks; and (3) fine-tuning on monolingual data recovers a large proportion of translation improvements relative to fine-tuning on aligned documents. Together, these provide convergent evidence in support of the interlingua hypothesis, and suggest new ways of understanding and improving how LLMs can be leveraged to perform translation tasks.
title: The Interlingua Hypothesis: LLMs Translate via a Latent Task-agnostic Feature Space
title_translated: 跨语言假说：LLMs通过潜在的通用任务特征空间进行翻译
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近在机器翻译方面表现出优于强监督基线的性能。这引发了关于LLMs如何在不同语言间执行翻译的机制的疑问。受近期可解释性研究启发——即LLMs使用大规模多语言潜在特征表示进行语言建模——我们提出跨语言假说。该假说认为，语言模型通过将源句读入一个潜在特征空间，再从该空间读取并生成目标句来完成翻译。我们提供了三条证据支持该假说：（1）不同语言对间的BLEU分数方差主要可由语言特异性能力预测，无需语言对特异性交互项；（2）许多模型组件在单语任务和翻译任务中均具有因果影响；（3）在单语数据上微调可恢复相对于在对齐文档上微调所获得的大部分翻译性能提升。这些证据相互印证，支持跨语言假说，并提示理解与改进LLMs执行翻译任务的新途径。

summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising rather than left-to-right decoding. This generation paradigm introduces two axes that can influence safety alignment: when tokens are generated during denoising and where they appear in the response. In this paper, we measure dLLM safety behavior under harmful prompts by tracing intermediate token distributions and commitment decisions throughout denoising. Our analysis shows that refusal signals are concentrated in early denoising steps and leading response positions, and the tokens committed early can strongly shape the final safety outcome. Our measurements further show that the denoising step and persistence of refusal-token commitment are important for understanding dLLM safety. Based on these findings, we propose Refusal-Aware Early Commitment (RAEC), a simple training-free decoding method that commits persistent refusal signals from early steps. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that RAEC reduces attack success rates while largely preserving utility. The code is available at https://github.com/Glresearch1/RAEC.
title: Beyond Token Positions: Safety Alignment Across Denoising Steps in Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: 超越词元位置：扩散语言模型中去噪步骤的安全对齐研究
summary_translated: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）通过迭代去噪生成文本，而非传统的左到右解码。这一生成范式引入了两个可能影响安全对齐的维度：去噪过程中词元生成的时间点以及其在响应中的位置。本文通过追踪去噪过程中的中间词元分布和承诺决策，测量dLLMs在有害提示下的安全行为。分析显示，拒绝信号集中在早期去噪步骤和响应的前部位置，早期承诺的词元能强烈影响最终安全结果。我们的测量还表明，去噪步骤和拒绝词元承诺的持续性对于理解dLLM安全性至关重要。基于此，我们提出拒绝感知早期承诺（RAEC），一种无需训练的解码方法，可在早期步骤中持续承诺拒绝信号。在LLaDA和Dream上的实验表明，RAEC降低了攻击成功率，同时基本保持了模型效用。代码已发布于https://github.com/Glresearch1/RAEC。

summary: LLM-based factuality judges provide scalable evaluation signals, but their metrics are often systematically biased relative to human judgments. We study human-anchored factuality evaluation under limited annotation budgets, where judge predictions on the full dataset are combined with human labels on a small selectively sampled subset to obtain statistically valid estimates. The efficiency of this approach depends critically on which examples receive human annotation: in factuality evaluation, judge-human misalignment is not driven solely by low confidence, but also by structured failure modes such as incomplete evidence, temporal mismatch, unverifiable claims, and rubric misalignment. To exploit this structure, we introduce a factuality-specific annotation policy design pipeline that uses failure-space analysis (FSA) to derive diverse predictive signals for modeling human-judge misalignment. On an internal reference-based factuality evaluation system (AutoFA) and RAGTruth, where judge-predicted estimates substantially underestimate human-annotated factual accuracy, our FSA-guided policy improves annotation efficiency over uniform sampling and uncertainty-driven baselines, achieving effective-sample-size gains of 40.3% on AutoFA and 27.1% on RAGTruth.
title: Human-Anchored Factuality Evaluation with Strategic Annotation
comment: Accepted as a conference paper for Industrial Track of EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 基于人类锚定的事实性评估与策略性标注
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的事实性判断提供了可扩展的评估信号，但其指标常相对于人类判断存在系统性偏差。我们研究在有限标注预算下的人类锚定事实性评估，将全数据集上判断者的预测与小规模选择性采样子集上的人类标签相结合，以获得统计上有效的估计。该方法的效率关键取决于哪些样本接受人工标注：在事实性评估中，判断者与人类的不一致不仅由低置信度驱动，还由结构化失败模式（如证据不完整、时间错配、不可验证的主张和评分标准错位）引起。为利用这种结构，我们提出一种面向事实性的标注策略设计流程，通过失败空间分析（FSA）推导出多样化的预测信号，用于建模人类-判断者之间的不一致。在内部基于参考的事实性评估系统（AutoFA）和RAGTruth上，判断者预测的估计值显著低估了人工标注的事实准确性，我们的FSA引导策略相比均匀采样和不确定性驱动基线提升了标注效率，在AutoFA上实现有效样本量提升40.3%，在RAGTruth上提升27.1%。

summary: Communicating across cultures is inherently challenging, especially through culturally dense and ambiguous formats like memes. While people expect large language models (LLMs) to hold promise for bridging such gaps, existing benchmark datasets often fail to capture the cultural context necessary for accurate interpretation. To address this, we introduce MemeBridge, a curated dataset centered on U.S.-originated memes, designed to capture two complementary perspectives: (1) how Chinese participants interpret these memes, and (2) how U.S. participants anticipate how people from other cultures might misunderstand them. Here, context refers to implicit cultural knowledge, including background beliefs, norms, and shared assumptions that shape meme comprehension. The dataset was constructed via a multi-stage crowdsourcing pipeline with rigorous validation, including human agreement checks and GPT-based classification verification. Each meme is annotated with sentiment, emotion, cultural significance, and knowledge type, providing rich supervision for downstream tasks. Notably, we observe that the anticipated misunderstandings from U.S. participants are often inaccurate, highlighting the asymmetries in cultural understanding and the challenges of adopting perspectives beyond one's own. This bidirectional framing, which focuses on both expression and perception, enables more nuanced benchmarking of cross-cultural comprehension. Our probing of multiple LLMs reveals that while models developed in different cultural contexts exhibit partial cross-cultural understanding, they often struggle with sophisticated interpretations. By contrast, fine-tuning with MemeBridge improves model performance, underscoring the value of culturally grounded resources for training and evaluating LLMs in globally diverse settings.
title: MemeBridge: A Dataset for Benchmarking and Mitigating the Bidirectional Cultural Gap in Meme Interpretation
title_translated: MemeBridge：用于基准测试与缓解表情包跨文化理解双向鸿沟的数据集
summary_translated: 跨文化交流本质上具有挑战性，尤其是在文化密集且模糊的形式如表情包中。尽管人们期望大语言模型（LLMs）能弥合此类鸿沟，但现有基准数据集往往无法捕捉准确解读所必需的文化背景。为此，我们引入MemeBridge，一个聚焦于美国起源表情包的精选数据集，旨在捕捉两种互补视角：(1) 中国参与者如何解读这些表情包；(2) 美国参与者如何预判其他文化人群可能产生的误解。此处的上下文指隐含的文化知识，包括背景信念、规范和共享假设，这些共同塑造了对表情包的理解。该数据集通过多阶段众包流程构建，并经过严格验证，包括人工一致性检查和GPT-based分类验证。每个表情包均标注情感、情绪、文化意义及知识类型，为下游任务提供丰富监督。值得注意的是，美国参与者预判的误解往往不准确，凸显了文化理解中的不对称性以及超越自身视角的困难。这种双向框架聚焦于表达与感知，使跨文化理解的基准测试更加细致。我们对多个LLM的探测显示，虽不同文化背景下训练的模型具备部分跨文化理解能力，但在复杂解读上仍常遇困难。相比之下，使用MemeBridge进行微调可显著提升模型性能，凸显了文化根基资源在训练和评估全球多样化场景下LLMs的价值。

summary: Frontier language models that refuse harmful single-turn prompts often comply when the same intent is reached gradually over many turns, making multi-turn attacks one of the least understood failure modes of large language models. Most automated red-teaming methods treat this as a generation problem: produce attacks that break the model. We argue it is better framed as a search problem: discover, organize, and iteratively refine a diverse archive of attack strategies, producing a structured map of how a target model fails rather than a list of one-off successes. We introduce EvoFlint, which applies evolutionary quality-diversity search to multi-turn red-teaming. Attack strategies are phased conversation plans, not raw prompts, and are evolved through LLM-driven mutation and crossover. A Pareto fitness over attack success rate and peak severity preserves selection signal from near-miss attacks. A risk-indexed archive runs novelty search with local competition over strategy description embeddings inside each cell, maintaining diversity without committing to a predefined style taxonomy. A generation-level memory accumulates target-model insights across the population and feeds them back into strategy generation. On the HarmBench-test split, EvoFlint reaches attack success rates of 35.8% on Claude Sonnet 4.6, 59.7% on GPT-5.4, and 94.3% on Qwen3-32B, alongside 98.7% on the older GPT-4o included as a baseline reference. The resulting archive, organized by risk category, exposes for each target which categories of harm its safety training has and has not covered.
title: EvoFlint: An Evolutionary Atlas of Multi-Turn LLM Vulnerabilities
title_translated: EvoFlint：多轮大语言模型漏洞的演化图谱
summary_translated: 前沿语言模型在拒绝有害单轮提示时，若相同意图通过多轮逐步达成，则可能顺从，使得多轮攻击成为最不被理解的大语言模型失效模式之一。大多数自动化红队测试方法将其视为生成问题：生成能够突破模型的攻击。我们认为更应将其视为搜索问题：发现、组织并迭代优化多样化的攻击策略，生成目标模型失败的结构化地图，而非一系列偶然成功。我们提出EvoFlint，采用进化质量-多样性搜索进行多轮红队测试。攻击策略为分阶段对话计划，而非原始提示，并通过LLM驱动的变异与交叉进行演化。基于攻击成功率与峰值严重性的帕累托适应度保留了近失攻击的选择信号。风险索引档案库在每个单元内对策略描述嵌入进行局部竞争的新颖性搜索，维持多样性而不依赖预定义风格分类。生成级记忆在种群中累积目标模型的洞察，并反馈至策略生成。在HarmBench测试集上，EvoFlint在Claude Sonnet 4.6上达到35.8%的攻击成功率，GPT-5.4上达59.7%，Qwen3-32B上达94.3%，同时在较旧的GPT-4o上达到98.7%作为基线参考。由此生成的档案按风险类别组织，揭示了每种目标模型的安全训练覆盖与未覆盖的危害类别。

summary: Small leaderboard gaps are often interpreted as evidence that one language model is better than another, but their sign may depend on which benchmark items are included. We test this using item-level responses from five benchmarks and a family-label-free spectral approximation to multidimensional item-response theory (MIRT). In owner-disjoint folds, one owner half identifies items with low residual differential item functioning across model families (low-DIF); the resulting frozen, source- and easiness-balanced weights score models in the other half, while equally short matched-random subtests control for generic subtest variation. Full-benchmark and low-DIF rankings remain strongly correlated ($τ_b=.900$--$.948$). Yet in four of five benchmarks, 30.9--47.1\% of cross-family pairs initially within one percentage point reverse order, exceeding their matched-random medians by 16.9--28.6 percentage points (all $p=.001$). The fifth benchmark shows no reliable excess ($-0.9$ points, $p=.689$). The pattern survives all pre-specified population perturbations, and residual item--family signatures replicate across owner halves; however, no family shows a consistent advantage across benchmarks. Thus, globally stable rankings can still leave individual near-tie orderings sensitive to benchmark composition, and sub-one-point leaderboard gaps should be accompanied by evidence that the implied ordering is composition-robust.
title: Are Near-Tied LLM Rankings Robust to Family-DIF-Guided Benchmark Recomposition?
comment: Code and data artifacts will be released
title_translated: 接近平局的LLM排名是否对家族-DIF引导的基准重构具有鲁棒性？
summary_translated: 小型排行榜差距常被视为一个语言模型优于另一个的证据，但其排序结果可能依赖于所包含的基准项目。我们使用五个基准的项级响应数据及无家族标签的谱近似多维项目反应理论（MIRT）对此进行检验。在互斥所有者折叠中，一半所有者识别出跨模型族残差差异项目功能较低（低-DIF）的项目；由此生成的冻结、源平衡与难度均衡权重用于评分另一半模型，而等长匹配随机子测试则控制通用子测试变化。全基准与低-DIF排名之间保持强相关性（τ_b=.900--.948）。然而在五项基准中的四项中，初始处于百分点内的一对跨家族模型有30.9%–47.1%反转顺序，超过其匹配随机中位数16.9%–28.6%（全部p=.001）。第五项基准未显示显著超额（-0.9点，p=.689）。该模式在所有预设群体扰动下依然成立，残差项目-家族特征在所有者半组间重复出现；然而，没有任何家族在所有基准中表现出一致优势。因此，全局稳定排名仍可能导致个别接近平局的排序对基准组成敏感，跨百分点内的排行榜差距应伴随证明其排序对组成鲁棒的证据。

summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as orchestrators that coordinate specialized subagents to solve complex tasks through natural language. However, in many important domains like game playing and robotics, the strongest available agents are not language models. Integrating non-language agents with LLMs would require \emph{verbalization}: compressing their rich continuous representations into sparse textual summaries at each interaction step. To study whether verbalization constitutes a bottleneck, we introduce \textsc{LLAMIA-Bench}, a suite of six diverse collaborative chess tasks spanning three facets: behavioral imitation, state assessment, and natural-language explanation. Each task instantiates a well-established chess problem that neither the LLM nor the chess engine can solve alone. To solve LLM collaboration with non-language agents, we introduce \emph{latent state internalization}, which projects the subagent's continuous representations directly into the LLM's token stream as learned state tokens, with dynamic re-encoding as actions advance the environment state. Comparing internalization to verbalized integration, our experiments reveal a consistent \emph{verbalization debt}: the performance gap widens throughout training and persists as the LLM scales from 4B to 14B parameters. A single 14B model, \textsc{LLAMIA}, trained with latent state internalization, matches or exceeds task specialists and frontier models including GPT-5.1 with tool access across all benchmark tasks, and generalizes out-of-distribution where task-specific finetunes collapse
title: Exploring Collaboration between a language and a non-language agent
title_translated: 探索语言代理与非语言代理间的协作
summary_translated: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用作协调器，通过自然语言协调专业子代理来解决复杂任务。然而，在游戏博弈和机器人等重要领域，最强可用代理并非语言模型。将非语言代理与LLM集成需要	extit{言语化}：在每次交互步骤中，将它们丰富的连续表示压缩为稀疏的文本摘要。为研究言语化是否构成瓶颈，我们引入	extsc{LLAMIA-Bench}，一套涵盖三个维度的六项多样化协作国际象棋任务：行为模仿、状态评估和自然语言解释。每个任务实例化一个经典国际象棋难题，仅靠LLM或国际象棋引擎单独无法解决。为实现LLM与非语言代理的协作，我们提出	extit{潜在状态内化}，将子代理的连续表示直接投影到LLM的标记流中作为学习的状态标记，并随动作推进环境状态动态重编码。与言语化集成相比，实验揭示出持续存在的	extit{言语化债务}：性能差距在整个训练过程中扩大，并在LLM从4B扩展到14B参数后依然存在。一个单一的14B模型	extsc{LLAMIA}，通过潜在状态内化训练，可在所有基准任务中匹配或超越任务专家及前沿模型（包括带工具访问的GPT-5.1），并在分布外泛化中表现优异，而任务特定微调模型则崩溃。

summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external corpora, but implicit trust in retrieved documents creates a critical attack surface: PoisonedRAG shows that a handful of crafted passages can dominate dense retrieval and steer generation toward attacker-chosen answers. We present the Tri-Layer Sieve, a middleware defense that sanitizes retrieved evidence through cross-embedding-space clustering with an independent judge model, structural filtering of trigger-payload artifacts, and LLM consistency verification. The design exploits a key weakness of retrieval-stage poisoning: a single document must satisfy one embedding geometry, one internal Trigger-Payload structure, and one generation objective - rarely all three simultaneously, a fragility that persists even against an adaptive attacker who paraphrases around it. On Natural Questions, HotpotQA, and MS-MARCO with Contriever retrieval (k=50), the Sieve reduces black-box Attack Success Rate from 67.0/87.0/64.0% to 3.0/14.0/4.0%, mitigates white-box HotFlip attacks from ~74% to 27.8% on NQ with Layer 3 enabled, and drives poisoned-document MRR to 0.000, while restoring clean accuracy from 13-33% under attack to 58-76%. Under an architecture-aware adversary who paraphrases triggers to evade the structural filter, enabling the consistency layer halves adaptive ASR (32.0% to 15.0% on NQ) while raising clean accuracy by 18 points, at an added latency of ~16-19 s/query under live retrieval.
title: TRIS: A Tri-Layer Retrieval Integrity Sieve Against Knowledge Poisoning
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
title_translated: TRIS：一种针对知识污染的三层检索完整性筛检机制
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）将大语言模型与外部语料库结合，但对检索文档的隐式信任带来了关键攻击面：PoisonedRAG表明，少量精心构造的段落即可主导密集检索并引导生成结果向攻击者选定的答案偏移。我们提出三层筛检机制，作为中间件防御方案，通过独立判别模型在跨嵌入空间中进行聚类、对触发器-载荷结构特征进行结构性过滤，以及利用大语言模型的一致性验证来净化检索证据。该设计利用了检索阶段污染的一个关键弱点：单个文档必须同时满足一种嵌入几何结构、一种内部触发器-载荷结构和一种生成目标——这三种条件极少能同时成立，即使面对能够改写触发器以规避检测的自适应攻击者也是如此。在自然问题（Natural Questions）、HotpotQA和MS-MARCO数据集上使用Contriever检索（k=50）时，该筛检机制将黑盒攻击成功率从67.0/87.0/64.0%降低至3.0/14.0/4.0%，在NQ上启用第三层后，白盒HotFlip攻击成功率从约74%降至27.8%，并使受污染文档的MRR降至0.000，同时将受攻击下的清洁准确率从13-33%恢复至58-76%。在面对知晓架构的对手（通过改写触发器绕过结构过滤）时，启用一致性层可使自适应攻击成功率减半（NQ上从32.0%降至15.0%），同时提升清洁准确率18个百分点，代价是每次查询增加约16-19秒延迟。

summary: This work examines recent byte-level models and their failure to perfectly manipulate characters. State-of-the-art byte-level models use a hierarchical structure, starting at the byte level, downsampling to the word level, and then upsampling back to bytes. While this improves training and inference efficiency, we find that the hierarchical design itself limits character-level understanding, with pure byte-level models consistently outperforming hierarchical variants on character manipulation tasks. Ablating transformer layers into attention and feed-forward components further reveals that byte-level attention is the primary mechanism driving this behavior. Together, our results provide an explanation for the character-level failures of hierarchical byte models and establish a clear trade-off between computational efficiency and fine-grained character understanding.
title: Toppling the Hierarchy in Byte-level Language Modeling
title_translated: 颠覆字节级语言建模中的层级结构
summary_translated: 本文研究了近期的字节级语言模型及其在字符精确操控上的失败表现。当前最先进的字节级模型采用层级结构：从字节级别开始，下采样至词级别，再上采样回字节级别。尽管这种设计提升了训练与推理效率，但我们发现层级结构本身限制了模型对字符级别的理解，纯字节级模型在字符操控任务中始终优于层级变体。进一步将Transformer层分解为注意力与前馈组件的消融实验揭示，字节级注意力是驱动这一行为的主要机制。综合来看，我们的研究为层级字节模型在字符层面的失败提供了解释，并确立了计算效率与细粒度字符理解之间的明确权衡。

summary: Pretrained transformer-based language models achieve strong performance across a wide range of NLP tasks but remain limited in encoding geo-locational semantics, leading to suboptimal representations of place names and spatial entities. In this work, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic approach for injecting geo-spatial awareness into pretrained embeddings without modifying the tokenizer or requiring costly retraining. Our method augments input representations with structured geographic signals by combining location names with their corresponding latitude and longitude, and employs a location-focused masking to better align textual representations with real-world spatial relationships. This design allows the model to incorporate geo-spatial context while preserving existing semantic and syntactic knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate substantial improvements in geo-spatial alignment while maintaining comparable performance on standard NLP benchmarks such as GLUE. The method is computationally efficient, requiring only minutes of additional training, and generalizes across multiple model architectures and scales.
title: Location-Aware Language Models via Secondary Embeddings
comment: Accepted for publication at the 29th International Conference on Text, Speech and Dialogue (TSD 2026)
title_translated: 通过二次嵌入实现位置感知的语言模型
summary_translated: 预训练的基于Transformer的语言模型在众多自然语言处理任务中表现出色，但在编码地理语义方面仍存在局限，导致地名和空间实体的表示效果不佳。本文提出一种轻量级、模型无关的方法，在不修改分词器或无需昂贵重训练的前提下，向预训练嵌入中注入地理空间意识。该方法通过将地名与其对应的纬度和经度相结合，构建结构化的地理信号，并采用聚焦于地理位置的掩码策略，以更好地对齐文本表示与现实世界的空间关系。该设计使模型能够在保留原有语义与句法知识的同时融入地理空间上下文。实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了地理空间对齐能力，同时在GLUE等标准NLP基准测试上保持相当的性能。该方法计算高效，仅需额外几分钟训练时间，且可泛化至多种模型架构与规模。

summary: Language models learn about grammatical number primarily from co-occurrence, and show frequency effects as a result---sometimes taken to indicate that they do not learn abstract ``rules'', and are instead dependent on specific lexical items. Testing generalization with text stimuli alone cannot settle this debate, since distributional cues (is/are, this/these) easily give number away. We instead use cross-modal generalization as a tool to investigate abstractions in LMs that can also accept visual inputs (VLMs), restricting the evidence that diagnoses number to an extra-linguistic modality. We teach VLMs pairs of new nouns by adding new embeddings and only updating them during learning, comparing conditions where number is diagnosed by visual cues alone against ones where it is disambiguated by text. Across behavior, representational dynamics, and causal mechanisms, we find non-trivial evidence for cross-modal generalization across both exposure conditions, and that linguistic vs. extra-linguistic cue conditions are treated in similar ways in the internal mechanisms of the model. This suggests that statistical learners like VLMs can generalize beyond surface-level co-occurrence and show genuine abstraction-compatible behavior.
title: (V)LMs generalize beyond surface co-occurrence: Evidence from cross-modal number agreement
title_translated: （V）LMs超越表面共现进行泛化：来自跨模态数一致性的证据
summary_translated: 语言模型主要通过共现学习语法数的概念，因而表现出频率效应——这常被解读为它们并未学习抽象“规则”，而是依赖具体词汇项。仅用文本刺激无法解决这一争议，因为分布线索（is/are, this/these）很容易暴露数的信息。为此，我们采用跨模态泛化作为工具，研究可接受视觉输入的语言模型（VLMs）中的抽象能力，将诊断数信息的证据限制在非语言模态。我们通过添加新词嵌入并仅在学习期间更新这些嵌入来训练VLMs，比较仅依赖视觉线索与结合文本线索进行歧义消除的两种条件。在行为、表征动态和因果机制层面，我们均发现了跨模态泛化的非平凡证据，且无论语言还是非语言线索条件，模型内部机制的处理方式相似。这表明像VLM这样的统计学习者能够超越表面共现进行真正的抽象泛化。

summary: Probing studies have established that syntactic information is decodable in early and middle transformer layers, but what happens to that information in later layers remains poorly understood. We apply a cross-layer generalisation analysis to three Greek-tuned large language models evaluated on tightly controlled minimal pairs: object-relative constructions in Modern Greek, where canonical (Subject-Verb-Object; SVO) and non-canonical (Verb-Subject-Object; VSO) orders differ only in within-clause word order, while preserving propositional meaning. When a probe trained on late layers (20-31) is tested on each early layer individually, it produces below-chance transfer (cluster-corrected, p<0.01), classifying 99.3% of non-canonical sentences as canonical. Probe coefficients reverse sign around layer 22, indicating a directional recoding toward the canonical form rather than simple information loss. These findings characterise a representational format change in late transformer layers that goes beyond the well-established decline in syntactic decodability, and they generate a directly testable prediction for human EEG and MEG decoding studies using the same stimuli. Code and stimuli are publicly available on OSF.
title: Late Transformer Layers Recode Syntax Canonically: Evidence from Greek Scrambling and Cross-Layer Generalisation
comment: 10 pages, 3 main figures, 2 appendices. Code and stimuli: this https URL
title_translated: 晚期Transformer层以规范形式重构语法：来自希腊语散序与跨层泛化的证据
summary_translated: 探针研究表明，句法信息可在早期和中期Transformer层中被解码，但后期层中这些信息如何演变仍不清楚。我们对三个经过希腊语微调的大语言模型在严格控制的最小对上进行跨层泛化分析：现代希腊语中的宾语相对结构，其中规范（主语-动词-宾语；SVO）与非规范（动词-主语-宾语；VSO）顺序仅在句内词序上不同，而命题意义保持不变。当在后期层（第20-31层）训练的探针分别在每一早期层上测试时，其转移表现低于随机水平（聚类校正后，p<0.01），将99.3%的非规范句子误分类为规范形式。探针系数在第22层左右反转符号，表明存在朝向规范形式的方向性重构，而非简单的信息丢失。这些发现刻画了晚期Transformer层中表征格式的变化，超越了已知的句法可解码性下降现象，并为使用相同刺激的人类EEG和MEG解码研究提出了可直接检验的预测。代码与刺激材料已在OSF公开。

summary: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable. Framing the token layer as source coding -- transformer compute is monotone in sequence length, whose per-atom floor is the Shannon rate $H/\log_2 V$, an object already applied to tokenizers in prior work -- we assemble a token-cost ledger that splits each language's cost, at fixed parallel content, into a removable coding redundancy, a residual coding slack, an intrinsic-content term, and an orthogonal, irreducible grapheme-to-phoneme term that governs the multimodal rather than the text cost. On FLORES-200 across eight languages, a production tokenizer costs up to $8.9\times$ more tokens for Indic scripts than for English; a script-matched code trained on $1,012$ sentences removes a median $64\%$ of that excess (bootstrap 95\% CI $[0.638, 0.647]$), and a script-fair information floor shows the intrinsic content differs by under $6\%$ -- the tax is representational, not informational. A constructed code removes $98\%$ of a controlled source's redundancy, and the token tax implies up to $79\times$ attention cost. We are explicit about scope and failure: this is compute-and-memory accounting, not a model-quality claim; we neither measure nor claim the cross-lingual direction of the orthographic term; and our matched code is a conservative small-data demonstration. We contribute the unifying ledger, the removable-versus-intrinsic attribution, and an open one-command harness.
title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Code + one-command reproduction: this https URL
title_translated: 可移除与不可移除：多语言分词税的令牌成本账本
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在非英语文本上存在显著的成本税：相同内容的令牌消耗高出数倍，且由于注意力机制随序列长度呈二次增长，计算开销也大幅增加。我们探讨了这一成本中有多大比例是可消除的。将分词层视为源编码——Transformer 计算随序列长度单调递增，其每原子的下限为香农率 $H/\log_2 V$，该概念已在先前工作中应用于分词器设计——我们构建了一个令牌成本账本，将固定并行内容下各语言的成本分解为可移除的编码冗余、残余编码松弛、内在内容项以及一个正交且不可约的字符到音素项，后者决定多模态而非文本层面的成本。在 FLORES-200 跨八种语言的测试中，生产级分词器对印地语系文字的令牌消耗最高可达英语的 8.9 倍；一种在 1,012 句话上训练的脚本匹配代码可平均消除 64% 的超额成本（Bootstrap 95% 置信区间 [0.638, 0.647]），而脚本公平的信息下限显示内在内容差异不足 6%——该成本源于表示方式而非信息本身。构造的编码可消除受控源 98% 的冗余，且令牌成本税意味着注意力成本最高可达 79 倍。我们明确说明了研究范围与局限性：这是关于计算与内存的会计分析，而非模型质量主张；我们未测量也未声称正交项的跨语言方向；所提出的匹配代码仅为保守的小数据演示。我们贡献了统一的账本框架、可移除与内在成分的归因方法，以及一个一键式开源工具。

summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed for sophisticated data engineering tasks such as generating structured queries from natural language, Text-to-SQL, and automating complex spreadsheet operations. However, maximizing their utility demands both higher finetuning-free accuracy and solutions to the computational bottleneck imposed by the Transformer architectures inherent quadratic (On2) time complexity. This paper introduces a novel drop-in neurosymbolic layer designed to seamlessly integrate into existing LLM backbones enhancing logical reasoning and mitigating long-context resource consumption. On the reasoning front, the layer immediately and significantly improves performance yielding an average accuracy increase of 85% across rigorous benchmarks including BIRD-CRITIC and LiveSQLBench, critically achieving these gains without any task specific finetuning or RLHF. Concurrently, we repurpose this approach to address the severe computational strain of long context inference. By leveraging symbolic processing to prioritize and compress relevant contextual information the layer reduces the effective token usage by over 50% and brings the effective time complexity down from O(n2) to approximately O(n) on certain long context tasks. This dual impact approach not only makes LLMs substantially more reliable for data engineering but also drastically reduces the computational pressure on inference chips, making long context tasks more manageable and cost effective.
title: Neurosymbolics for Data Engineering: Achieving Long Context Token Reduction Without Finetuning
title_translated: 神经符号学用于数据工程：无需微调实现长上下文令牌压缩
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于复杂的数据工程任务，如从自然语言生成结构化查询（Text-to-SQL）、自动化电子表格操作等。然而，最大化其效用需要更高的无微调准确率，并解决 Transformer 架构固有的二次时间复杂度（O(n²)）带来的计算瓶颈。本文提出一种新型即插即用的神经符号层，可无缝集成至现有 LLM 主干网络，提升逻辑推理能力并缓解长上下文资源消耗问题。在推理方面，该层显著提升了性能，在 BIRD-CRITIC 和 LiveSQLBench 等严格基准测试中平均准确率提升达 85%，且无需任何特定任务的微调或强化学习人类反馈（RLHF）。同时，我们利用该方法应对长上下文推理带来的严重计算压力。通过符号处理优先筛选和压缩相关上下文信息，该层使有效令牌使用量减少超过 50%，并将某些长上下文任务的有效时间复杂度从 O(n²) 降低至约 O(n)。这种双重影响不仅显著增强了 LLM 在数据工程中的可靠性，还大幅减轻了推理芯片的计算负担，使长上下文任务更易实现且更具成本效益。

summary: Large language models can hide hidden behaviors that activate only under narrow conditions, such as backdoor triggers, sleeper-agent deployment cues, sandbagging, or topic-conditioned censorship. Such behaviors are difficult to detect without prior knowledge what to look for. We present activation-matched finetuning, an unsupervised detection method that assumes no knowledge of the trigger or the target behavior. Given a suspect model and a publicly available anchor, we finetune the anchor to reproduce the suspect's activations on a small benign corpus, and score each evaluation prompt by the residual between the two models. Since no benign corpus covers the sparse trigger region, the reference learns the benign computation but not the hidden behavior. Therefore, trigger prompts -- and, crucially, their semantic neighbors -- incur a large residual that signal the presence of unusual behavior to the defender. Testing our method across third-party models and custom models, activation-matched finetuning surfaces hidden behavior reliably. Furthermore, we empirically consider a natural defense-aware attack and showcase that it fails to suppress our detection method without sacrificing the behavior itself.
title: Detecting Hidden Behaviors in LLMs via Activation-matched Finetuning
title_translated: 通过激活匹配微调检测大语言模型中的隐藏行为
summary_translated: 大型语言模型可能隐藏仅在特定条件下激活的行为，例如后门触发、潜伏代理部署信号、蓄意降级或基于主题的内容审查。这些行为在缺乏先验知识的情况下难以检测。我们提出一种无监督检测方法——激活匹配微调，该方法不依赖对触发条件或目标行为的任何先验知识。给定一个可疑模型和一个公开可用的锚模型，我们对锚模型进行微调，使其在小规模良性语料上复现可疑模型的激活模式，并通过两模型之间的残差来评分每个评估提示。由于良性语料无法覆盖稀疏的触发区域，参考模型学习到了正常的计算过程，但未习得隐藏行为。因此，触发提示及其语义邻近提示会产生较大的残差，向防御者发出异常行为的信号。我们在第三方模型和自定义模型上测试该方法，结果表明其能可靠地揭示隐藏行为。此外，我们实证考察了一种自然的防御感知攻击，展示其若不牺牲行为本身，便无法有效压制我们的检测方法。

summary: Translation students need to learn both how to use translation technologies and how to judge the choices those technologies make available. This article presents LoopCAT, an Apache-2.0-licensed, local-first computer-assisted translation environment co-created with OpenAI Codex using GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6, and proposes a framework connecting workflow competence, evaluative judgement, and technological agency. The account draws on repository history, implementation inspection, and the verification records of an identified development build. LoopCAT combines local project storage, translation memories, terminology, quality assurance, document exchange, and optional connections to local or hosted AI services. Its English, Catalan, and Turkish interface catalogs also make the application itself available as teaching material: students can translate English UI strings into another language, review the existing automatically generated target drafts, import their revisions, and test the interface. We organize these opportunities around four forms of participation: operating a workflow, evaluating outputs, inspecting and configuring mechanisms, and making or defending a bounded intervention. A six-session sequence, a UI-localization assignment, a placeholder example, and an assessment rubric specify how teachers could use the framework. The paper separates implemented capabilities from proposed educational benefits; it reports no new student-learning outcomes. It distinguishes the latest package checks from earlier regression evidence and sets out a protocol for classroom evaluation. LoopCAT provides an inspectable setting for teaching how translation decisions interact with data, interfaces, and software rules. Whether these activities improve judgement, transfer, or participation remains an empirical question.
title: From Tool Use to Technological Agency: LoopCAT as a Local-First, Open-Source Tool for Translation Technology Education
title_translated: 从工具使用到技术自主：LoopCAT 作为本地优先的开源翻译技术教育工具
summary_translated: 翻译学生需要既掌握翻译技术的使用方法，又具备判断技术所作决策的能力。本文介绍 LoopCAT，一款采用 Apache-2.0 许可协议、以本地优先为设计原则的计算机辅助翻译环境，由 OpenAI Codex 与 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6 共同开发，并提出一个连接工作流能力、评估判断力与技术自主性的框架。该论述基于仓库历史、实现检查及已识别开发版本的验证记录。LoopCAT 集成本地项目存储、翻译记忆库、术语管理、质量保证、文档交换功能，以及可选的本地或托管 AI 服务连接。其支持英语、加泰罗尼亚语和土耳其语的界面目录本身也可作为教学材料：学生可将英文 UI 字符串翻译为其他语言，评审自动生成的目标草案，导入修改版本，并测试界面效果。我们围绕四种参与形式组织这些机会：执行工作流、评估输出、检查与配置机制、做出或辩护有限干预。六次课的课程序列、UI 翻译作业、示例模板和评估量规说明了教师如何使用该框架。论文区分了已实现功能与提出的教育收益；未报告新的学生学习成果。它区分了最新包检查与早期回归证据，并制定了课堂评估协议。LoopCAT 提供了一个可检查的环境，用于教学翻译决策如何与数据、界面和软件规则相互作用。这些活动是否提升判断力、迁移能力或参与度，仍需实证检验。

summary: A published theoretical account of phase structure in rotary attention was subjected to two pre-specified empirical tests of whether phase-derived features improve prediction of a commitment or contradiction endpoint over a baseline that does not receive those features. Study 1 froze a contradiction-category pipeline and scored a sealed primary comparison of PC-2 against baseline. On 1,136 eligible cases the paired AUROC difference was +0.00087. The 99% interval included zero, and the difference did not reach the pre-specified threshold of +0.05. Advancement was not passed. Study 2 developed fifteen layer treatments on open blocks b0-b4 only (1,415 transitions, 20x5 grouped folds). A locked conjunctive rule required a positive PC-2 mean-repeat increment, a positive increment on at least four of five seed blocks, and a positive mean of those five differences. No treatment advanced. The official selection is null. The theoretical paper is not withdrawn. The extra ranking lift was not found under the rules locked in advance.
title: Two locked tests of phase-structure features for transition prediction
comment: 7 pages. Empirical follow-up to arXiv:2607.25507 . Both pre-specified tests are null
title_translated: 相位结构特征用于过渡预测的两项锁定测试
summary_translated: 一篇关于旋转注意力中相位结构的理论文章接受了两项预先设定的实证检验，旨在验证相位导出特征是否能在基线不接收这些特征的情况下，提升对承诺或矛盾终点的预测能力。研究1冻结了矛盾类别流水线，对PC-2与基线的主比较进行了封闭式评分。在1,136个符合条件的案例中，配对AUROC差异为+0.00087。99%置信区间包含零值，且未达到预先设定的+0.05阈值。未通过推进标准。研究2在开放块b0-b4上开发了十五种层处理方案（共1,415次转换，20×5分组交叉验证）。一个锁定的合取规则要求：PC-2均值重复增量为正，至少在五个种子块中的四个上增量为正，且这五个差值的均值为正。所有处理方案均未通过。官方选择为空。理论论文未撤稿。在预先锁定的规则下，未发现额外的排名提升。

summary: In contact centers, real-time agent-assist tools determine, for each of many predefined topics, whether a live customer utterance is relevant and display a coaching card to the agent when it is. The input is noisy and challenging: ASR(Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts of spontaneous phone conversations, which can be unclear, repetitive, and mostly lack punctuation. To systematically study this real-world task, we curate a human-annotated topic-utterance judgments dataset sourced from real call-center transcripts. We compare three types of matchers: a regex-based baseline, zero-shot sentence embedding encoders, and Gemini-based LLM matchers. In addition, two types of topic representations are studied in our benchmark:keyphrases and natural language description. Our empirical experiments highlight the superior performance of lightweight LLM matchers over embedding and regex models when equipped with natural language descriptions.
title: Topic Matching in the Wild: Benchmark and Lessons from Real-World ASR Transcripts
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT 2026), EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
title_translated: 真实世界中的主题匹配：来自实际语音识别转录文本的基准测试与经验教训
summary_translated: 在客服中心，实时代理辅助工具会针对多个预定义主题判断实时客户发言是否相关，并在相关时向代理显示指导卡片。输入数据具有噪声且具有挑战性：自发电话对话的自动语音识别（ASR）转录文本，这些文本可能模糊、重复且大多缺乏标点符号。为系统研究这一现实任务，我们构建了一个基于真实呼叫中心转录文本的人工标注主题-语句判断数据集。我们比较了三种匹配方法：基于正则表达式的基线模型、零样本句子嵌入编码器以及基于Gemini的大语言模型匹配器。此外，在我们的基准测试中还研究了两种主题表示方式：关键词和自然语言描述。实证实验表明，当使用自然语言描述时，轻量级大语言模型匹配器的表现优于嵌入模型和正则表达式模型。

summary: Lexical normalization rewrites the noisy, non-standard words that fill user-generated text (tmrw, u, gr8) into their standard forms. Because labelled data is scarce for most languages, a popular shortcut is to train a single model on many languages at once. We ask a simple question: how many languages should such a model be trained on? Using one fixed-capacity character-level model and twelve languages from a standard benchmark, we vary the number of jointly trained languages from one to twelve and measure per-language accuracy. We find a clear curse of multilinguality: accuracy is highest when a language is trained with only a few others, often just one to four, and then falls steadily and substantially, dropping by about forty percent as the rest are piled on. A control that holds the total amount of training data constant makes the decline arrive sooner and fall further, which points to competition among the languages for one fixed-size model rather than to how much data is available. We also test whether a language's typological distance from the others predicts its ideal number of co-training languages, and find no dependable rule: any apparent relationship rests on a couple of languages and does not hold up. For compact normalization models, less can be more: a few languages beat pooling everything into a single model.
title: The Curse of Multilinguality in Lexical Normalization
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT 2026), EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
title_translated: 词汇标准化中的多语言困境
summary_translated: 词汇标准化将用户生成文本中的嘈杂、非标准词汇（如tmrw、u、gr8）重写为标准形式。由于大多数语言的标注数据稀缺，一种流行的方法是同时在一个模型上训练多种语言。我们提出一个简单问题：该模型应训练多少种语言？使用一个固定容量的字符级模型和来自标准基准的十二种语言，我们将联合训练的语言数量从1种变化到12种，并测量每种语言的准确率。我们发现明显的多语言诅咒现象：当一种语言仅与其他少数语言（通常为一至四种）一起训练时，准确率最高，随后稳步且显著下降，随着其他语言的增加，准确率下降约40%。一个保持总训练数据量恒定的对照实验表明，准确率下降得更早且降幅更大，这指向语言之间对固定大小模型的竞争，而非可用数据量的问题。我们还测试了某种语言的类型学距离是否能预测其最佳共训练语言数量，结果发现没有可靠规律：任何看似的关系都依赖于少数语言，无法普遍成立。对于紧凑的标准化模型而言，少即是多：少量语言的表现优于将所有语言合并到单一模型中。

summary: Multilingual large language models can exhibit unintended code-switching -- unnecessarily alternating between languages during generation. We present a comparative study of three methods that identify language-controlling latents in cross-layer transcoders: activation value-based selection (ValSel), activation frequency-based selection (FreqSel), and LLM-generated latent annotation-based selection (AnnSel). To evaluate the efficacy of these methods in identifying language-controlling latents, we introduce two multilingual benchmarks that exhibit code-switching for fine-grained analysis of language steering across seven languages. Through targeted intervention experiments on Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B, we find that all three methods effectively manipulate generation language, with FreqSel achieving the strongest overall performance, while AnnSel offering interpretable latent selection through explicit language annotations. A knock-out analysis suggests the methods select non-overlapping but each-functional latent subsets, indicating redundancy rather than a single canonical language direction. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/rm-3284/Latent-Mechanism-Multilingual.
title: Latent Mechanisms of Language Control in Multilingual Language Models
comment: 23 pages, accepted for presentation at EMNLP 2026 main track
title_translated: 多语言语言模型中语言控制的潜在机制
summary_translated: 多语言大型语言模型可能会表现出意外的代码切换——在生成过程中不必要地在不同语言间交替。我们对三种识别跨层转换器中语言控制潜在变量的方法进行了对比研究：基于激活值的选择（ValSel）、基于激活频率的选择（FreqSel）以及基于大语言模型生成的潜在变量注释的选择（AnnSel）。为评估这些方法在识别语言控制潜在变量方面的有效性，我们引入了两个展示代码切换现象的多语言基准，用于对七种语言的语言引导进行细粒度分析。通过对Gemma-2-2B和Qwen3-4B进行有针对性的干预实验，我们发现三种方法均能有效操控生成语言，其中FreqSel整体表现最强，而AnnSel通过显式语言注释提供了可解释的潜在变量选择。消融分析表明，这些方法选择了非重叠但各自有效的潜在子集，说明存在冗余而非单一的规范语言方向。代码与数据可在 https://github.com/rm-3284/Latent-Mechanism-Multilingual 获取。

summary: Emotional labor is the effortful management of emotional displays to meet social or professional expectations. Personality traits have been correlated with emotional labor strategies, yet research on this link relies almost exclusively on self-report scales administered only in occupational settings. We investigate whether large language models injected with psychometrically grounded personas reproduce these personality-driven selection patterns across everyday social scenarios. We construct the first emotional labor strategy dataset of 500 socially situated events, each offering three behavioral choices corresponding to surface acting, deep acting, and genuine expression. We source 50 fictional characters from a large-scale personality repository and profile each through two parallel tracks: observer-rated bipolar adjective composites and in-character self-report items. Five LLMs evaluate all scenarios under both persona conditions. We find that models align more towards deep acting, and that Conscientiousness and Emotional Stability consistently predict this preference. Entropy analysis confirms that persona reliably influences the output and varies across models and emotions.
title: Emotional Labor Strategy Preferences in LLM Personas
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
title_translated: LLM角色中情感劳动策略偏好
summary_translated: 情感劳动是指为满足社会或职业期望而努力管理情绪表现的过程。人格特质与情感劳动策略之间存在关联，但现有研究几乎完全依赖于仅在职业环境中施加的自评量表。我们探究了注入心理测量学基础角色的大语言模型是否能在日常社交情境中再现这些由人格驱动的选择模式。我们构建了首个包含500个社会情境事件的情感劳动策略数据集，每个事件提供三种对应于表面扮演、深层扮演和真实表达的行为选择。我们从大规模人格库中选取50个虚构角色，并通过两条平行路径对其进行画像：观察者评定的双极形容词组合与角色内自评项目。五个大语言模型在两种角色条件下评估所有情景。我们发现模型更倾向于深层扮演，且尽责性和情绪稳定性始终能预测这种偏好。熵分析证实角色能可靠影响输出，并在不同模型和情绪之间存在差异。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation, evidence retrieval, patient messaging, and care coordination. Yet many evaluations remain limited to static medical question answering or one-shot generation, under-representing longitudinal state, interruptions, and human handoffs. We introduce an episode-level evaluation protocol for healthcare NLP agents. The protocol separates evidence across model, agent, and simulated-workflow behavior; specifies a five-field episode schema; and defines annotation and scoring for state continuity, evidence traceability, and escalation decisions. It is instantiated as four task templates: documentation update, evidence retrieval, patient messaging, and triage handoff. The protocol does not claim to measure clinical outcomes or deployment value. Instead, it supplies a reproducible intermediate evaluation layer between static benchmarks and prospective workflow studies, with an explicit cost-sensitive treatment of missed versus unnecessary escalation.
title: Toward Workflow-Aware Benchmarking for Healthcare NLP Agents
title_translated: 迈向面向工作流的医疗NLP智能体基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正被越来越多地应用于医疗任务，如临床文档撰写、证据检索、患者消息传递和护理协调。然而，许多评估仍局限于静态医学问答或单次生成，未能充分反映纵向状态、中断和人工交接等关键特征。我们提出了一个面向医疗NLP代理的基于episode的评估协议。该协议将证据分离为模型、代理和模拟工作流行为三部分；规定了五字段episode结构；并定义了对状态连续性、证据可追溯性和升级决策的标注与评分标准。该协议具体化为四个任务模板：文档更新、证据检索、患者消息传递和分诊交接。该协议不声称衡量临床结果或部署价值，而是提供一个介于静态基准与前瞻性工作流研究之间的可复现的中间评估层，并对遗漏升级与不必要的升级采取明确的成本敏感处理。

summary: We investigate how vision-language models (VLMs) handle context-memory conflicts; that is, situations in which the model is given information in context that differs from what was stored parametrically during training. We document asymmetric biases: models tend to prefer in-context information about entities which appear in text, but prefer parametric information about entities which appear in images. We relate this asymmetry to the late representational alignment across modalities, showing that the longer processing time associated with resolving visual entities prevents the suppression of the model's usual factual recall mechanism, thus resulting in more parametric answers. Chain-of-thought reasoning does not appear to resolve the gap, but increasing the amount of visual information in the context does show an effect. These results illustrate the complexity of ensuring consistent behavior as models become increasingly multimodal and retrieval-augmented.
title: Slow to See, Slow to Suppress: Understanding the Effects of Modality in Context-Memory Conflicts
comment: Accepted to EMNLP Findings 2026. Code and dataset are available at this https URL
title_translated: 反应迟缓：理解模态在上下文-记忆冲突中的影响
summary_translated: 我们研究视觉-语言模型（VLMs）如何处理上下文-记忆冲突，即模型在上下文中接收到的信息与训练期间参数化存储的信息不一致的情况。我们发现存在不对称偏差：模型倾向于依赖文本中出现实体的上下文信息，而更偏好图像中出现实体的参数化信息。我们将这种不对称性归因于跨模态表征对齐的延迟，表明解决视觉实体所需的较长处理时间会阻止模型抑制其常规的事实回忆机制，从而导致更多参数化回答。链式思维推理似乎无法弥合这一差距，但增加上下文中的视觉信息量则显示出一定效果。这些结果揭示了随着模型日益多模态和检索增强，确保行为一致性所面临的复杂性。

summary: LLM-based diagnostic systems achieve high semantic accuracy on benchmarks, but open-ended evaluation on clinically uncommon presentations reveals a systematic gap between headline accuracy and verifiable clinical reliability. We evaluate an LLM+rare-disease-RAG pipeline across two cohorts and show that the paradigm produces confident outputs that are frequently unverifiable and systematically resistant to clinician interrogation. We present NSIDDx (Neuro-Symbolic Integrated Differential Diagnosis System), a design framework arguing that DDx systems in low-resource settings must treat the clinician as an active reasoning agent. We instantiate this through a neuro-symbolic pipeline with ternary symptom encoding, contradiction detection, audit strings, and practitioner override - running offline on consumer hardware. We distill five design principles for clinician-in-the-loop clinical NLP and invite the prospective studies needed to validate the claim at scale.
title: NSIDDx: A Design Framework for Neuro-Symbolic, Practitioner-First Differential Diagnosis in Low-Resource Settings
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, Github: this https URL
title_translated: NSIDDx：面向低资源环境的神经符号型、以临床医生为中心的差异诊断设计框架
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的诊断系统在基准测试中表现出高语义准确性，但在对临床上罕见表现的开放评估中，暴露出标题准确率与可验证的临床可靠性之间的系统性差距。我们在两个队列上评估了LLM+罕见病RAG管道，发现该范式会产生自信但频繁不可验证的输出，并且系统性地抗拒临床医生的质询。我们提出了NSIDDx（神经符号集成差异诊断系统），一种设计框架，主张在低资源环境中，差异诊断系统必须将临床医生视为积极的推理主体。通过一个包含三元症状编码、矛盾检测、审计字符串和临床医生覆盖机制的神经符号管道实现这一理念，该系统可在消费级硬件上离线运行。我们提炼出五个关于临床医生参与式临床NLP的设计原则，并呼吁开展前瞻性研究以大规模验证该主张。

summary: Long documents often distribute important information across extensive narrative passages and multiple tables, making faithful summarization particularly challenging. Existing methods may generate individually supported quantitative facts and analytical statements yet associate them incorrectly, producing quantitatively plausible yet analytically unfaithful summaries. In this work, we propose LOOMSUM, a training-free framework that extracts source-grounded atomic evidence, explicitly links table-derived facts with supporting narrative analyses, and plans the discourse structure before generation. We also introduce Table-Grounded Faithfulness (TGF), a claim-level metric that separately evaluates Numeric Grounding, Analysis Support, and Relation Consistency. Experiments on the text--table summarization benchmarks FINDSum and USTT show that LOOMSUM improves analytical faithfulness while maintaining strong summarization quality. Human evaluation finds positive component-level associations with the corresponding human judgments. Our Relation Consistency metric further shows stronger agreement with human relation judgments than generic factuality metrics, indicating that explicit cross-modal linking helps reduce errors in which supported quantities are paired with incorrect narrative interpretations. Together, these findings show that faithful long text--table summarization requires not only grounding individual facts, but also preserving the relations between them.
title: LOOMSUM:Weaving Quantitative and Narrative Evidence for Faithful Long Text-Table Summarization
comment: Preprint, code will be available soon
title_translated: LOOMSUM：为忠实的长文本-表格摘要编织定量与叙事证据
summary_translated: 长文档常将重要信息分布在广泛的叙述段落和多个表格中，使得忠实摘要尤为困难。现有方法可能生成各自有依据的定量事实和分析陈述，但错误关联它们，产生看似合理却分析不忠实的摘要。本文提出LOOMSUM，一种无需训练的框架，能够提取源文本支撑的原子证据，显式链接表格推导的事实与支持性的叙述分析，并在生成前规划话语结构。我们还引入了表格基础忠实度（TGF）这一逐声明级别度量，分别评估数值依据、分析支持和关系一致性。在FINDSum和USTT文本-表格摘要基准上的实验表明，LOOMSUM提升了分析忠实度，同时保持了强大的摘要质量。人工评估显示与人类判断在组件层面存在正向关联。我们的关系一致性度量进一步显示，相较于通用事实性度量，与人类关系判断的吻合度更高，表明显式的跨模态链接有助于减少受支持数量与错误叙述解释配对的错误。综合来看，这些发现表明，忠实的长文本-表格摘要不仅需要个体事实的锚定，还需保留事实之间的关系。

summary: Scientific domain entity linking (EL) differs from general domain EL because mentions and entity names often lack lexical overlap. Another challenge is that specialized terminology is used in the scientific domain, which is rarely encountered in models pretrained on general domains. Therefore, models trained on general domains transfer poorly to scientific domains. To address this, in-domain fine-tuning is the natural remedy. However, many scientific domains lack expert-annotated data, motivating the need for a zero-human-annotation approach. Existing zero-shot methods heavily rely on LLMs to generate aliases across entire mention corpora, which incurs substantial computational cost, and those methods provide no mechanism to filter out noise from LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose Sci-ZSEL, a framework that selectively generates entity aliases with an LLM to control computational cost, and applies an ontology-aware filter to remove aliases that semantically drift toward ontology neighbors. Then, filtered aliases are used to construct pseudo-labeled mention-entity pairs for fine-tuning. To enable evaluation of EL under low lexical overlap, we also release a new animal science EL benchmark linked to three livestock trait ontologies, where mentions and entities exhibit substantially lower lexical overlap than in existing benchmarks. Across five benchmarks, Sci-ZSEL outperforms the non-fine-tuned baseline, is most useful on nonoverlapping mentions, and combining it with curated synonyms gives the best performance in most settings.
title: Bridging Lexical Divergence: LLM-Assisted, Cost-Efficient, Zero-shot Scientific Entity Linking
title_translated: 弥合词汇分歧：LLM辅助、成本高效的零样本科学实体链接
summary_translated: 科学领域实体链接（EL）不同于通用领域EL，因为提及项与实体名称往往缺乏词汇重叠。另一个挑战是科学领域使用专门术语，这些术语在通用领域预训练模型中很少见，导致通用模型在科学领域的迁移性能较差。为此，领域内微调是自然的解决方案。然而，许多科学领域缺乏专家标注数据，促使需要零人工标注的方法。现有零样本方法严重依赖LLM为整个提及语料库生成别名，计算成本巨大，且无机制过滤LLM产生的噪声。为应对这些挑战，我们提出Sci-ZSEL框架，通过LLM选择性生成实体别名以控制计算成本，并采用本体感知过滤器去除语义偏离本体邻近项的别名。随后，将过滤后的别名用于构建伪标注的提及-实体对以进行微调。为评估低词汇重叠下的EL性能，我们还发布了一个新的动物科学EL基准，链接至三个家畜性状本体，其中提及项与实体的词汇重叠显著低于现有基准。在五个基准上的实验表明，Sci-ZSEL优于非微调基线，在无重叠提及上最为有效，结合精选同义词时在多数场景下表现最佳。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for subjective tasks, where annotators disagree and the relevant question is not only how accurate a judge is, but whose judgments it reproduces. Sociodemographic prompting conditions the judge on an annotator's demographic profile to align its judgments with the corresponding group's. We test whether this alignment emerges distributionally, comparing the predicted label distributions of 23 open-weight LLMs on three subjective tasks against those of real annotator groups, under three conditions: no demographic information, single-attribute profiles, and intersectional profiles over gender, age, race, and education. Three findings emerge. First, a judge prompted with no demographics is not perspective-neutral: models best reproduce the judgments of White, college-educated annotators. Second, demographic conditioning is asymmetric: it moves the judge toward majority groups and away from minority groups, most strongly on offensiveness, where intersectional profiles amplify the harm. Third, by comparing base and instruct models we identify instruction-tuning as a possible source of the asymmetry. Demographic conditioning should therefore be used with caution to estimate group judgments: conditioning moves predictions away from the reference distributions of the minority groups the method is often invoked to serve.
title: LLM-as-a-Demographic: Whom Sociodemographic Prompting Helps, and Whom It Hurts
title_translated: LLM作为人口统计学代理：社会人口提示对谁有益，对谁有害
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作主观任务的评判者，其中标注者意见不一，关键问题不仅是评判者的准确性，还包括其复制的是哪一类人的判断。社会人口提示通过给定标注者的人口统计学特征来调节评判者，使其判断与对应群体一致。我们测试这种对齐是否在分布上出现，比较23个开源权重LLMs在三个主观任务上的预测标签分布与真实标注者群体的分布，共三种条件：无人口统计信息、单属性特征和性别、年龄、种族、教育等多重交叉属性特征。三项发现浮现：第一，未接受人口统计提示的评判者并非视角中立：模型最能复现白人、受过大学教育的标注者判断。第二，人口统计调节具有不对称性：它使评判者趋向多数群体，远离少数群体，尤其在冒犯性判断上，交叉属性特征加剧了伤害。第三，通过对比基础模型与指令微调模型，我们识别出指令微调可能是不对称性的潜在来源。因此，使用人口统计调节来估计群体判断应谨慎：该方法会使预测偏离其通常旨在服务的少数群体的参考分布。

summary: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of large language models increasingly adopts multiple reward dimensions, including verifiable rules, task-specific evaluators, and learned reward models, to provide richer supervision across diverse capabilities. These dimensions are commonly scalarized with fixed aggregation weights. We identify a failure mode in which aggregation itself induces reward hacking: static projection aliases qualitatively different reward profiles into a single scalar, steering optimization toward whichever dimensions are easiest, densest, or systematically favored by the reward signal. Over training, this traps the policy in suboptimal profiles and prevents convergence to better-balanced ones that would yield higher task performance. To address this, we propose Adaptive Multi-Reward Projection (AMRP), a lightweight online method that reallocates aggregation weights using three signals, relative shortfall, reward volatility, and recent progress, increasing pressure on lagging, unstable, or stagnant dimensions while relieving saturated ones. Across structured reasoning, citation-grounded generation, and open-ended alignment under GRPO, AMRP consistently improves reward-profile balance and downstream performance over fixed and dynamic weighting baselines; it also remains effective with GDPO and PPO, supporting compatibility across RL algorithms. Our code is available at https://github.com/yyhappier/AMRP.git.
title: Uncovering and Mitigating Aggregation-Induced Reward Hacking in Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 揭示并缓解多奖励强化学习中的聚合诱导奖励欺骗
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的强化学习微调越来越多地采用多个奖励维度，包括可验证规则、任务特定评估器和学习到的奖励模型，以在多样化能力上提供更丰富的监督。这些维度通常通过固定聚合权重进行标量处理。我们发现一种故障模式：聚合本身会引发奖励欺骗——静态投影将定性不同的奖励分布映射为单一标量，导致优化偏向于最容易、最密集或系统性受奖励信号偏好的维度。在训练过程中，这会使策略陷入次优的奖励分布，无法收敛到能带来更高任务性能的更平衡状态。为解决此问题，我们提出自适应多奖励投影（AMRP），一种轻量级在线方法，利用相对不足、奖励波动性和近期进展三个信号重新分配聚合权重，在滞后、不稳定或停滞的维度上增加压力，同时减轻已饱和维度的压力。在结构化推理、引用支撑生成以及GRPO下的开放式对齐任务中，AMRP始终优于固定和动态加权基线，提升奖励分布平衡性和下游性能；其在GDPO和PPO中也表现有效，支持与多种强化学习算法兼容。代码已公开于https://github.com/yyhappier/AMRP.git。

summary: Crisis helplines assess suicide risk through structured interviews, a process that is slow and dependent on operator training and workload. Natural language processing could support risk assessment and call prioritization, but almost no work addresses Arabic-language helpline calls or operates within the privacy constraints of real helpline data. We analysed de-identified transcripts from Lebanon's National Lifeline for Emotional Support and Suicide Prevention. Audio never left the helpline: calls were transcribed on site with a speech recognition model for Levantine Arabic, and an Arabic named-entity recognition model removed identifying information locally. Only the de-identified transcripts were shared with the research team. Operators recorded the five suicidal ideation items of the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale, which we combined into two binary outcomes: at-risk and high-risk. We also machine-translated the transcripts into English, giving a paired Arabic/English comparison. On each corpus, we fine-tuned five instruction-tuned large language models alongside six transformer encoder baselines (four Arabic, two English) and evaluated all models on a held-out test set. We included 383 calls: 373 for the at-risk task (52.3% positive) and 297 for the high-risk task (30.0% positive). The best Arabic model reached a macro-F1 of 81.19 and a ROC-AUC of 90.61 on high-risk; the best English model reached 85.00 and 92.59, identifying 88.9% of high-risk calls. In both languages, high-risk calls separated more cleanly than at-risk calls, and translation to English did not reduce the best observed performance. Suicide risk can be classified from de-identified Arabic transcripts without sending audio outside the helpline. The high-risk results support further testing as an operator-facing tool; lower-severity ideation proved the harder case.
title: Assessing Suicide Risk in Arabic Crisis Helpline Calls: A Comparison of Arabic and English Large Language Models
title_translated: 评估阿拉伯语危机热线通话中的自杀风险：阿拉伯语与英语大语言模型的比较
summary_translated: 危机热线通过结构化访谈评估自杀风险，该过程耗时且依赖操作员培训和工作负荷。自然语言处理可辅助风险评估与来电优先级排序，但几乎无研究涉及阿拉伯语热线通话，或在真实热线数据的隐私约束下开展工作。我们分析了黎巴嫩国家情感支持与自杀预防热线的去标识化通话记录。音频从未离开热线：使用针对黎凡特阿拉伯语的语音识别模型现场转录，并通过阿拉伯语命名实体识别模型本地去除身份信息，仅将去标识化文本共享给研究团队。操作员记录了哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表中的五个自杀意念项目，我们将其合并为两个二分类结果：高风险和中等风险。我们还将文本机器翻译为英文，实现阿拉伯语/英文配对比较。在每个语料库上，我们对五种指令微调的大语言模型及六种Transformer编码器基线模型（四种阿拉伯语，两种英语）进行微调，并在保留测试集上评估所有模型。共包含383通电话：373通用于中等风险任务（阳性率52.3%），297通用于高风险任务（阳性率30.0%）。最佳阿拉伯语模型在高风险任务上达到81.19的宏F1和90.61的ROC-AUC；最佳英语模型达到85.00和92.59，识别出88.9%的高风险来电。在两种语言中，高风险来电区分度均高于中等风险来电，且翻译为英文未降低最佳性能。无需将音频传出热线即可从去标识化的阿拉伯语通话记录中分类自杀风险。高风险结果支持进一步作为面向操作员的工具测试；低严重程度意念则构成更难案例。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on static pretraining corpora, causing their knowledge to become outdated over time. Existing approaches for evaluating knowledge edits either suffer from rapid contamination or rely on counterfactual edits that conflict with rigid existing knowledge. In this work, we propose a synthetic, simulation-driven framework for studying knowledge insertion in LLMs. We introduce {\sc ParallelEvents}, a benchmark of fictional yet realistic future worlds that generates coherent event trajectories for controlled evaluation, avoiding contamination while preserving consistency. Building on this dataset, we develop {\sc Synapse}, a training framework that uses model-generated data to update model parameters via mid-training and instruction tuning. This synthetic pipeline enables scalable knowledge integration without costly human-curated data. Empirically, {\sc Synapse} outperforms existing methods by 14.23\%, demonstrating that simulation-based synthetic training leads to robust and coherent knowledge insertions.
title: Synthetic Worlds for Temporal Evaluation and Knowledge Updating in LLMs
title_translated: 用于LLM时间评估与知识更新的合成世界
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）依赖静态预训练语料库，导致其知识随时间过时。现有知识编辑评估方法要么迅速受到污染，要么依赖与现有刚性知识冲突的反事实编辑。本文提出一种基于模拟的合成框架，用于研究LLM中的知识插入。我们引入{	extsc{ParallelEvents}}，一个虚构但现实的未来世界基准，生成连贯的事件轨迹以实现可控评估，避免污染同时保持一致性。基于该数据集，我们开发{	extsc{Synapse}}，一种训练框架，利用模型生成的数据通过中期训练和指令微调更新模型参数。这一合成流程实现了无需昂贵人工标注数据的可扩展知识整合。实证结果显示，{	extsc{Synapse}}比现有方法提升14.23	extbackslash%，证明基于模拟的合成训练能够实现稳健且一致的知识插入。

summary: General-purpose NLP embedding models perform well on linguistic tasks, but their ability to capture symbolic ontological structure remains unclear. We introduce AVA, a systematic framework for evaluating whether embeddings distinguish logic-sensitive relational semantics in ontologies and knowledge graphs. AVA comprises 171,007 contrastive triplets derived from 163 heterogeneous ontologies using hierarchy inversion, relation substitution, and disjointness injection.
