Existing benchmarks, however, largely assume that such preference can be retrieved from semantically related history. We study an underexplored but practically important regime, profile-preference conceptual misalignment (PRCM), where observable profile cues and query-specific preferences lie in different concept spaces, making semantic retrieval inconsistent for personalization. We introduce VIBE-Bench, a benchmark with two psychology-grounded tasks, 3,504 personas and 12,239 dialogues, including a manually verified gold test set, and requires cross-concept preference reasoning beyond surface semantic overlap. Experiments with several personalization methods show that current PLLMs largely rely on shallow semantic correlations and fail to acquire robust cross-concept mappings. These findings establish PRCM as a distinct failure regime in PLLMs and position VIBE-Bench as a focused testbed for advancing preference reasoning beyond semantic matching.
title: VIBE-Bench: Evaluating Personalized Large Language Models When Profiles Don't Mean Preferences
title_translated: VIBE-Bench：当个人资料不代表偏好时，个性化大语言模型的评估
summary_translated: 个性化大语言模型（PLLMs）旨在根据用户个体特征定制回应，其核心挑战在于偏好推理：从用户历史中推断与查询相关的偏好。现有基准大多假设此类偏好可从语义相关的上下文中检索。我们研究了一个被忽视但实际重要的情形——个人资料与偏好之间的概念错位（PRCM），即可观测的个人资料线索与特定查询的偏好处于不同概念空间，导致语义检索在个性化中不一致。为此，我们引入VIBE-Bench，一个包含两项心理学基础任务、3504个角色设定和12239段对话的基准，包含经人工验证的黄金测试集，要求超越表面语义重叠的跨概念偏好推理。对多种个性化方法的实验表明，当前PLLM主要依赖浅层语义关联，难以建立稳健的跨概念映射。这些发现确立了PRCM作为PLLM中的一种独特失败模式，并将VIBE-Bench定位为推动偏好推理超越语义匹配的关键测试平台。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive recommender assistants. Their evaluation should therefore go beyond plausible item recommendation and test whether they can recognize flawed recommendation requests. Existing recommender benchmarks mainly assess ranking, generation, or preference satisfaction, while existing error-detection benchmarks are usually not grounded in recommendation-specific user and candidate evidence. To address this gap, we introduce RPCBench, a benchmark for evaluating Recommender-Premise Critique: the ability to detect, diagnose, and properly handle faulty premises in natural-language recommendation requests. RPCBench contains evidence-grounded test instances from five recommendation domains and covers ten types of premise failures. Each instance provides a visible recommendation context and a corrupted user query. We further design a fine-grained evaluation framework that measures proactive detection, error localization, post-detection handling strategy, and evidence faithfulness. Through a systematic evaluation of 11 LLMs, we find that proactive detection is the main bottleneck in Recommender-Premise Critique, and models perform worst on underspecified-premise errors. We also observe that target-critical information density matters more than redundant evidence, and that longer reasoning does not monotonically improve critique quality: performance peaks at intermediate reasoning length, while overly long reasoning is accompanied by an overthinking penalty. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench.
title: RPCBench: A Benchmark for Proactive Premise Critique in LLM-based Recommendation
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures. Code available at this https URL
title_translated: RPCBench：面向基于大语言模型推荐系统的主动前提批判基准
summary_translated: 大语言模型正越来越多地用作交互式推荐助手。因此，其评估应超越合理的物品推荐，测试其识别错误推荐请求的能力。现有推荐基准主要评估排序、生成或偏好满足，而现有的错误检测基准通常缺乏推荐场景下的用户与候选证据支撑。为填补这一空白，我们引入RPCBench，用于评估推荐前提批判能力：即识别、诊断并妥善处理自然语言推荐请求中的错误前提。RPCBench包含来自五个推荐领域的证据基础测试实例，涵盖十种前提失败类型。每个实例提供可见的推荐上下文和被破坏的用户查询。我们进一步设计了细粒度评估框架，衡量主动检测、错误定位、检测后处理策略及证据忠实度。通过对11个LLMs的系统评估，我们发现主动检测是推荐前提批判的主要瓶颈，模型在“前提不明确”错误上的表现最差。我们还观察到，目标关键信息密度比冗余证据更重要，且更长的推理并不单调提升批判质量：性能在中等推理长度时达到峰值，过长推理则伴随“过度思考惩罚”。代码已开源：https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench。

summary: Vision-language models are evaluated by aggregate accuracy on multimodal benchmarks, a practice that implicitly assumes the model uses its visual input. We show this assumption fails on 40%--97% of samples across six VLMs and three perceptual benchmarks: blurring the question-relevant visual region leaves the next-token distribution nearly unchanged. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of samples, not of models: VSI ranks correlate across models (grand-mean Spearman rho=+0.40, permutation p<10^-3), so the same samples are flagged insensitive by VLMs sharing no architectural detail beyond a contrastively pretrained vision tower. The mechanism is concrete: on the insensitive samples, a linear probe on each model's own vision tower distinguishes perturbed from clean images at 0.72--0.79 accuracy, yet the model's argmax token changes on only 2%--11% of the same samples, an encoder--LLM gap above 0.65 on every model. Mapping VSI's diagnostic utility cell by cell surfaces a strong regime (multi-choice reasoning on capable VLMs: AUROC=0.85--0.87) and a weak regime (well-calibrated factuality, where softmax confidence already leads). VSI is not a universal best abstention signal; it is a sample-intrinsic indicator of vision-ignoring failure, best used as a conditional ensemble component.
title: The Visual Insensitivity Gap: Diagnosing When Vision-Language Models Fail to Use Visual Evidence
comment: 17 pages (7-page main text plus technical appendix), 10 figures, 6 tables
title_translated: 视觉不敏感差距：诊断视觉-语言模型何时忽略视觉证据
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型在多模态基准上的评估依赖于整体准确率，这一做法隐含假设模型使用了其视觉输入。我们发现，在六种VLM和三个感知基准上，40%至97%的样本中该假设失效：模糊与问题相关的视觉区域几乎不会改变下一个词的分布。我们将这一现象称为视觉不敏感差距，并通过每样本的视觉敏感性指数（VSI）进行量化。该差距是样本的属性而非模型的属性：不同模型间的VSI排名高度相关（总体Spearman相关系数为+0.40，置换检验p<10^-3），说明即使模型架构无共同细节（仅共享对比预训练的视觉塔），也会对相同样本标记为不敏感。其机制明确：在不敏感样本上，对每个模型自身视觉塔的线性探测器可区分扰动与干净图像，准确率达0.72–0.79，但模型的argmax词仅在2%–11%的样本中发生变化，表明编码器与LLM之间的差距超过0.65。逐单元映射VSI的诊断效用揭示了一个强适用场景（能力较强的VLM进行多选推理：AUROC=0.85–0.87）和一个弱适用场景（良好校准的事实性判断，此时softmax置信度已具优势）。VSI并非通用的最佳回避信号；它是一种样本内在的视觉忽略失败指示器，最适合作为条件集成组件使用。

summary: Production agent harnesses such as Claude Code and Qwen-Agent compress context during rollout, but training under compression creates a conditioning problem: every eviction branches the effective history, so the learning object is a tree rather than a sequence. Existing linearizations either retain the rightmost path, causing time-travel leakage, or replay a depth-first traversal, causing train-inference mismatch. We introduce two exact, gradient-equivalent corrections: LogitTree, a segmented K-forward traversal, and a packed 4D attention mask. LogitTree requires K+1 backward passes; the 4D mask requires a custom kernel and white-box eviction records. We also propose SDCC (Self-Distillation for Conditioning Consistency), a single-backward-pass variational relaxation. At each eviction, it minimizes forward KL between the compressed student and a stop-gradient teacher on the reconstructed pre-eviction prefix. A residual per-junction KL of epsilon_KL gives an O(sqrt(epsilon_KL)) bound on the train-deployment total-variation gap. SDCC also applies to black-box harnesses. On seven web-search benchmarks with TC-RAG, AgentFold, MemexRL, Claude Code, and OpenCode, naive training inflates the train-rollout log-probability gap, especially on eviction-heavy batches. The exact methods stay at the no-compression floor, and SDCC substantially closes the gap, with lower logit drift and higher rollout rewards.
title: MemoryWalker: Stop Training Agents on Contexts They Never Saw
comment: Your Memory-Compressing Harness Makes Training and Inference Inconsistent
title_translated: MemoryWalker：停止在从未见过的上下文中训练智能体
summary_translated: 生产级智能体工具如Claude Code和Qwen-Agent在推理过程中会压缩上下文，但这种压缩下的训练会产生条件问题：每次淘汰都会分支有效历史，导致学习目标变为树结构而非序列。现有线性化方法要么保留最右侧路径（引发时间旅行泄漏），要么重放深度优先遍历（造成训练-推理不一致）。我们提出两种精确且梯度等价的修正方法：LogitTree（分段K步前向遍历）和打包的4D注意力掩码。LogitTree需要K+1次反向传播；4D掩码需自定义内核和白盒淘汰记录。我们还提出SDCC（条件一致性自蒸馏），一种单次反向传播的变分松弛方法。在每次淘汰时，它最小化压缩后的学生与停止梯度教师在重建前淘汰前缀上的前向KL。每个节点的残差KL为epsilon_KL时，可给出训练-部署总变差差距的O(sqrt(epsilon_KL))上界。SDCC也适用于黑盒工具。在七个基于TC-RAG、AgentFold、MemexRL、Claude Code和OpenCode的网页搜索基准测试中，朴素训练显著扩大了训练-推理日志概率差距，尤其在淘汰密集批次中。精确方法保持在无压缩基线水平，而SDCC显著缩小差距，降低logit漂移并提升推理奖励。

summary: Effective humanitarian response depends on the rapid synthesis of heterogeneous, high-volume information sources - a task that routinely exceeds human analytical capacity in the critical early hours of a crisis. We present a pipeline that combines structured disaster records from EM-DAT with unstructured documents from ReliefWeb and the European Media Monitor (EMM) to produce source-grounded disaster storylines and causal knowledge graphs supporting situational awareness for responders and analysts. Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, the pipeline extracts structured storylines - tabular event profiles covering 17 fields, from severity and key drivers to child-sensitive impact indicators - and constructs causal knowledge graphs where each node and edge is enriched with citation-grounded explanatory narratives, enabling full traceability back to primary sources. We evaluate the system on three diverse crisis use cases through a human evaluation involving 9 domain expert and 9 non-expert evaluators. Results confirm high retrieval precision, strong faithfulness of extracted causal relations, and a clear expert preference for citation-grounded components over ungrounded alternatives. The pipeline is designed to scale to the full EM-DAT catalogue, with the goal of publicly releasing a narrative-enriched version of the database.
title: Verifiable Disaster Storylines and Causal Knowledge Graphs: A Citation-Grounded Pipeline from Heterogeneous Humanitarian Sources
title_translated: 可验证的灾难叙事与因果知识图谱：来自异构人道主义来源的引文基础流程
summary_translated: 有效的应急响应依赖于快速整合异构、高容量的信息源——这在危机初期的关键时段常常超出人类分析能力。我们提出一个流程，将EM-DAT中的结构化灾难记录与ReliefWeb及欧洲媒体监测（EMM）的非结构化文档相结合，生成基于来源的灾难叙事和因果知识图谱，以支持响应者和分析师的情境意识。利用检索增强生成技术，该流程提取结构化叙事——涵盖严重性、关键驱动因素到儿童敏感影响指标在内的17个字段的表格事件档案——并构建因果知识图谱，其中每个节点和边均附有引文支撑的解释性叙述，实现从结果回溯到原始来源的全程可追溯性。我们在三个多样化的危机应用场景中通过包含9名领域专家和9名非专家的用户评估进行了系统评估。结果证实高检索精度、提取因果关系的强忠实性，以及专家对引文基础组件优于无依据替代方案的明显偏好。该流程设计可扩展至完整的EM-DAT目录，目标是公开发布一个叙事丰富版本的数据库。

summary: Modern Text-to-SQL systems often follow generate-execute-select pipelines, generating multiple candidate queries then selecting the best one. Listwise selection, by jointly comparing multiple candidates, has been widely adopted, but fine-tuning listwise selectors is costly. We thus propose a fine-tuning-free listwise selector. We replace two major fine-tuning objectives with inference-time strategies: (1) learning selection criteria as ordering and (2) mitigating positional bias. First, we build reusable structured memories instead of learning selection behavior as model parameters. Given a question, MaP-SQL retrieves memories distilled from training data that encode how natural language maps to schema elements, SQL operations, and expected outputs. These memories serve as explicit decision criteria for evaluating candidates in a listwise manner. Second, to mitigate ordering bias of listwise selectors, we aggregate rankings across multiple input permutations, with inference cost optimized by execution results and pointwise scoring. Our approach improves selection accuracy while maintaining efficiency and compatibility with existing large language models. Across Text-to-SQL benchmarks, it produces more stable selection without fine-tuning and fewer unnecessary comparisons than existing methods. On BIRD-dev, it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art selector-based method R^3-SQL by 2.02 execution accuracy points on average using the same candidate sets, with 2.92x fewer tokens.
title: Replacing Training with Memory: Listwise Selection for Text-to-SQL
title_translated: 用记忆替代训练：文本到SQL的列表选择方法
summary_translated: 现代文本到SQL系统通常采用生成-执行-选择的流水线，生成多个候选查询后选择最优者。列表选择通过联合比较多个候选者被广泛采用，但微调列表选择器成本高昂。因此，我们提出一种无需微调的列表选择器。我们将两个主要微调目标替换为推理阶段策略：（1）将选择标准建模为排序关系，（2）缓解位置偏差。首先，我们构建可复用的结构化记忆，而非将选择行为作为模型参数学习。给定一个问题，MaP-SQL从训练数据中提炼出的记忆会编码自然语言如何映射到模式元素、SQL操作和预期输出。这些记忆作为显式决策标准，用于以列表方式评估候选查询。其次，为缓解列表选择器的排序偏差，我们通过对多个输入排列的排名进行聚合，并通过执行结果和点对点评分优化推理开销。我们的方法在保持效率和与现有大语言模型兼容性的前提下提升了选择准确性。在多个文本到SQL基准上，该方法实现了无需微调的更稳定选择，且比现有方法减少不必要的比较。在BIRD-dev上，使用相同的候选集，平均比之前的最先进选择器R^3-SQL高出2.02个执行准确率点，同时仅消耗2.92倍的token数。

summary: Long-horizon tool-use agents need not only to search and plan, but also to decide when to finalize. We study late-stage pressure states, in which an agent is biased toward submitting a final answer that appears complete and polished while key constraints remain unresolved. We first train a linear probe to show that this pressure state is identifiable from the agent's hidden states. Then, we use activation interventions along this pressure direction and find that shifting the hidden states changes both the pressure score and whether the agent continues tool use or submits early. Through controlled context manipulations, we further see that the pressure is mitigated by constraint clarity and action mapping. Based on these findings, we propose Probe-Sensed Pressure Relief (PSPR), a plugin that applies lightweight pressure relief direction under moderate pressure and moves to structured organization under high pressure risk. Experiments on multiple long-horizon benchmarks show that our method consistently strengthens existing agent methods.
title: Polished but Unresolved: Identifying Late-Stage Pressure States in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
comment: Accepted in the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
title_translated: 精炼但未解决：识别长时程工具使用智能体的晚期压力状态
summary_translated: 长时程工具使用智能体不仅需要搜索和规划，还需决定何时最终提交答案。我们研究晚期压力状态，即智能体倾向于提交看似完整且精致的最终答案，而关键约束仍处于未解决状态。我们首先训练线性探测器，证明该压力状态可从智能体的隐藏状态中识别。随后，我们沿此压力方向进行激活干预，发现调整隐藏状态会同时改变压力得分，并影响智能体是否继续使用工具或提前提交。通过受控上下文操纵，我们进一步发现，约束清晰度和动作映射能缓解该压力。基于这些发现，我们提出Probe-Sensed Pressure Relief（PSPR）插件：在中等压力下应用轻量级压力缓解方向，在高风险压力下转向结构化组织。在多个长时程基准上的实验表明，该方法能持续增强现有智能体方法的表现。

summary: As far-right actors increasingly exploit online platforms to disseminate ideology and mobilize supporters, civil society organizations (CSOs) play a vital yet underrecognized role in monitoring antidemocratic dynamics online. Unlike fact-checkers or content moderators, CSOs engage in long-term, contextualized analysis, often in resource-constrained settings and under precarious conditions. Despite their critical societal role, CSOs face significant barriers to adopting or co-developing technical solutions, including legal uncertainty, limited platform access, and chronic underfunding. Existing research and tool development efforts have largely overlooked these actors in favor of more institutionally embedded stakeholders. This paper addresses this gap through a qualitative study with 15 practitioners from 12 Germany-based CSOs engaged in online monitoring, positioning them as key yet overlooked stakeholders in the governance of digital spaces. We explore their current practices, challenges, and expectations regarding technological support. Our findings show that monitoring remains largely manual due to the lack of tailored tools, with enhanced search capabilities emerging as the most pressing technical need. While participants express openness to AI-supported features such as media processing and content discovery, many remain skeptical of automated classification, citing concerns around trust, legal usability, and professional credibility. Grounded in these findings, we introduce a conceptual monitoring workflow and describe its implementation in an open-source Telegram monitoring prototype designed to flexibly support diverse monitoring goals. We outline concrete design, policy, and research recommendatios, and introduce the manual labor trap as an empirically grounded concept that explains why monitoring CSOs tend to remain locked into labor-intensive, low-capacity arrangements.
title: Ctrl-F-Resist. Practices, Challenges, and Technical Needs of Civil Society Organizations Monitoring the Far-Right Online
comment: Accepted for the 29th ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work and Social Computing (CSCW 2026)
title_translated: Ctrl-F-抵抗：民间社会组织在线监测极右翼的实践、挑战与技术需求
summary_translated: 随着极右翼势力越来越多地利用网络平台传播意识形态并动员支持者，民间社会组织（CSOs）在监测线上反民主动态中扮演着至关重要的角色，但这一作用却未得到充分认可。与事实核查员或内容审核员不同，CSOs进行长期、情境化的分析，通常在资源匮乏和条件不稳定的环境中开展工作。尽管其社会价值重大，CSOs在采用或共同开发技术解决方案时仍面临诸多障碍，包括法律不确定性、平台访问受限以及长期资金不足。现有研究和技术开发大多忽视了这些行动者，转而关注更具制度嵌入性的利益相关方。本文通过一项针对12个德国CSO中15名从业者参与在线监测的定性研究，填补了这一空白，将这些组织定位为数字空间治理中关键却被忽视的利益相关方。我们探讨了他们的当前实践、面临的挑战以及对技术支援的期望。研究发现，由于缺乏定制化工具，监测工作仍以人工为主，增强搜索能力成为最迫切的技术需求。虽然参与者对AI支持功能（如媒体处理和内容发现）持开放态度，但对自动化分类仍存疑虑，主要担忧在于信任度、法律可用性和专业可信度。基于这些发现，我们提出一个概念性监测工作流程，并描述了其在开源Telegram监测原型中的实现，该原型旨在灵活支持多样化的监测目标。我们提出了具体的设计、政策和研究建议，并引入‘手动劳动陷阱’这一实证概念，解释为何监测类CSOs往往陷入高劳动强度、低效能的困境。

summary: Unsupervised feature selection seeks a compact subset of informative features without access to class labels, making feature utility difficult to define. Existing UFS methods therefore rely on indirect structural criteria, such as similarity preservation, locality, sparsity, cluster geometry, or reconstruction quality. In this paper, we instead study UFS through representation consistency and propose Inverted Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Feature Selection (ICLFS), a feature-wise contrastive framework that reformulates UFS as a representation learning problem over features rather than samples. ICLFS first inverts the data matrix so that each feature is represented by its sample-profile vector, then constructs multiple masked positive views together with a shuffled negative view, and learns projector-space representations that remain consistent across these structured perturbations under an InfoNCE-based objective. Motivated by recent findings that cosine-based and InfoNCE-based training affect embedding norms, we use projector-space embedding magnitude as the saliency signal for ranking features. The resulting norm-based ranking is subsequently refined through Laplacian-Gated Ranking Correction, which suppresses locally redundant candidates while preserving salient ones. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets show that ICLFS achieves the best clustering accuracy on 10 datasets against both classical and neural baselines under the standard clustering-based UFS evaluation protocol, while remaining competitive on the other two. These results show that feature-wise contrastive representation consistency provides a strong and effective alternative to neighborhood, cluster, and reconstruction-based UFS formulations.
title: When Features Become Instances: Inverted Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Feature Selection
title_translated: 当特征变为实例：用于无监督特征选择的逆对比学习
summary_translated: 无监督特征选择旨在不依赖类别标签的情况下选取一组信息丰富的紧凑特征，但特征效用难以定义。因此，现有方法多依赖间接结构标准，如相似性保持、局部性、稀疏性、聚类几何或重建质量。本文则从表示一致性出发研究无监督特征选择，提出一种名为ICLFS（Inverted Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Feature Selection）的特征级对比框架，将无监督特征选择重新定义为在特征而非样本上的表示学习问题。ICLFS首先反转数据矩阵，使每个特征由其样本轮廓向量表示，然后构建多个掩码正视图与打乱负视图，并在基于InfoNCE的目标函数下学习投影空间表示，使其在这些结构化扰动下保持一致。受近期研究启发——余弦相似度与InfoNCE训练影响嵌入范数——我们使用投影空间嵌入幅度作为特征重要性信号进行排序。随后通过拉普拉斯门控排序修正方法，抑制局部冗余候选特征，同时保留显著特征。在12个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ICLFS在标准聚类评估协议下，在10个数据集上达到最佳聚类准确率，优于经典与神经基线方法，其余两个数据集也保持竞争力。结果表明，特征级对比表示一致性为邻域、聚类和重建为基础的特征选择方法提供了一种强大且有效的替代方案。

summary: When contextual information conflicts with the knowledge stored in model parameters, activation directions can be used to decode and steer which source the model follows. However, steering along a direction does not establish causality: whether the unedited model would naturally use that direction or whether the direction is reusable across tasks. We test these distinctions through counterfactual experiments in unambiguous settings. First, we estimate authority directions from agreement prompts, in which the context and parametric knowledge support the same answer. We then interchange naturally occurring coordinates along these directions between matched prompts that direct the model to prioritize either the supplied context or its parametric knowledge. Across Qwen, Llama, and OLMo models, this intervention reproduces 30-68% of the authority-induced shift in source choice, whereas matched controls reproduce almost none. To test cross-task reuse, we learn authority directions on two tasks separately and see that cross-task transferability closes only 9% of the authority gap while the local direction learned on the given task closes 57%. These results distinguish authority representation, causal use, and cross-task causal reuse, and suggest that authority computations may be task-dependent, rather than reusable across tasks.
title: How Do Language Models Choose Between Context and Memory?
title_translated: 语言模型如何在上下文与记忆之间做出选择？
summary_translated: 当上下文信息与模型参数中存储的知识发生冲突时，可通过激活方向解码并引导模型选择哪个来源。然而，沿某一方向进行引导并不足以建立因果关系：即未经编辑的模型是否会自然使用该方向，或该方向是否可在不同任务间复用。我们通过在明确设定下的反事实实验检验这些区别。首先，从一致提示中估计权威方向（即上下文与参数知识均支持同一答案），然后在匹配提示间交换这些方向上的自然坐标，以引导模型优先考虑提供的上下文或其参数知识。在Qwen、Llama和OLMo模型上，该干预重现了30%-68%的权威诱导源选择变化，而对照组几乎无法重现。为测试跨任务复用性，我们在两个任务上分别学习权威方向，发现跨任务迁移仅能缩小9%的权威差距，而仅在特定任务上学习的本地方向可缩小57%。这些结果区分了权威表征、因果使用与跨任务因果复用，提示权威计算可能是任务相关的，而非可跨任务通用的。

summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, yet their development forces a tradeoff: code frameworks are expressive but engineering-intensive, while no-code builders simplify authoring but constrain agent interactions to author-defined workflows. We present ChatDev 2.0: DevAll (hereafter DevAll), a no-code platform for building, executing, and inspecting heterogeneous MAS that delivers both high expressiveness and ease of use. In terms of expressiveness, DevAll pairs a declarative executable graph abstraction with a cycle-aware execution engine, so that heterogeneous agents and dynamic and cyclic interactions can be represented and executed within a single framework. For ease of use, an integrated visual interface lets users author, run, monitor, and inspect MAS, including human-in-the-loop steps, entirely without writing code. Experiments demonstrate that DevAll reproduces state-of-the-art MAS across three representative tasks at competitive performance and without task-specific orchestration code, highlighting its effectiveness as a general-purpose platform for LLM-based MAS. DevAll is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev.
title: ChatDev 2.0: A No-Code Multi-Agent Platform for Developing Everything
title_translated: ChatDev 2.0：一个无需编码的多智能体平台，用于开发一切
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）在解决复杂任务方面展现出巨大潜力，但其开发过程存在权衡：代码框架表达能力强但工程负担重，而无代码构建工具虽简化创作但限制了智能体间的交互仅限于作者预设的工作流。我们提出ChatDev 2.0：DevAll（以下简称DevAll），一个无需编码的平台，用于构建、执行和检查异构多智能体系统，兼具高度表达力与易用性。在表达力方面，DevAll结合声明式可执行图抽象与感知循环的执行引擎，使得异构智能体及动态、循环交互可在单一框架内表示与执行。在易用性方面，集成的可视化界面允许用户完全无需编写代码即可完成智能体系统的创建、运行、监控与审查，包括人机协同步骤。实验表明，DevAll在三个代表性任务上复现了最先进的多智能体系统性能，且无需任务特定的编排代码，凸显其作为LLM驱动多智能体系统通用平台的有效性。DevAll已开源，地址为 https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev。

summary: Large Vision-Language Models produce fluent image descriptions but offer limited semantic control: users cannot reliably specify whether captions should emphasize attributes, relations, or particular image regions. We present Fine-grained Captioning Control Using Scene Rewards (FoCUS), a controllable image captioning method that lets users steer captions toward specific semantic emphases through natural-language control prompts. The core idea is a prompt-conditioned control objective based on scene-graph-aligned component scores. Generated captions are parsed and aligned to scene-graph components such as objects, attributes, and relations. These components are differentially weighted, including negative weights, according to the requested emphasis. We optimize this objective with GRPO and further improve its reliability through a stricter object validity threshold and reasoning-based verification for attribute and relation scoring. To evaluate controllability, we introduce Semantic Control and Precision Evaluation (SCoPE), a benchmark with contrastive Include/Avoid constraints for measuring both target content coverage and out-of-scope suppression. Experiments on two VLM backbones show that FoCUS consistently improves controllability and fine-grained caption quality without degrading general caption performance.
title: Controllable Image Captioning with Prompt-Conditioned Scene Rewards
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main (26 pages); Project website: this https URL
title_translated: 基于提示条件场景奖励的可控图像描述生成
summary_translated: 大型视觉-语言模型能够生成流畅的图像描述，但在语义控制方面能力有限：用户无法可靠指定描述应强调属性、关系或特定图像区域。我们提出细粒度描述控制方法FoCUS（Fine-grained Captioning Control Using Scene Rewards），通过自然语言控制提示引导描述朝特定语义重点偏移。核心思想是基于场景图对齐组件得分的提示条件控制目标。生成的描述被解析并映射到场景图组件（如物体、属性、关系），根据所需强调内容对这些组件进行差异化加权（包括负权重）。我们采用GRPO优化该目标，并通过更严格的对象有效性阈值和基于推理的验证机制进一步提升属性与关系评分的可靠性。为评估可控性，我们引入SCoPE（Semantic Control and Precision Evaluation）基准，包含对比性的包含/避免约束，用于衡量目标内容覆盖率与非目标内容抑制能力。在两种VLM骨干网络上的实验表明，FoCUS在不降低通用描述性能的前提下，持续提升了可控性与细粒度描述质量。

summary: LLMs have been rapidly adopted across writing tasks, prompting the development of tools for detecting LLM-generated text. Yet, these tools largely measure how much of a document's surface text was written by an LLM and aren't fundamentally designed to measure how much of the information content or ideas originated from the LLM itself rather than being supplied by the user in the prompt. In this work, we design a framework that measures how much value a person adds on top of what a language model could have easily produced by itself. The method requires no training or labeled data and never scores the document's surface text, insulating it from stylistic confounders. Instead, it extracts the document's content at increasing levels of granularity, uses an LLM to reconstruct the document from each partial representation, and compares these reconstructions with those produced from the task description alone. We call this framework Value Over Language Model (VOLM), which measures a document's contribution relative to a replacement-level document that an LLM could produce from the task description alone. We evaluate VOLM with a specific instantiation of this framework across three domains: news articles, ICLR peer reviews, and argumentative essays. VOLM separates human-authored documents from matched LLM-generated documents produced from generic task descriptions, while remaining substantially invariant to content-preserving transformations, including LLM-based reconstruction and round-trip translation. We further find that increasingly constrained content extractors reduce residual differences between LLM-generated and humanized text, demonstrating the importance of disentangling informational content from stylistic variation. We hope these results encourage further work on specialized instantiations of the framework and on assessing human contributions in LLM-assisted writing more generally.
title: Value Over Language Model: Detecting Original Contribution in Writing
title_translated: 语言模型之外的价值：检测写作中的原创贡献
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）在各类写作任务中被迅速采用，推动了检测LLM生成文本工具的发展。然而，这些工具主要衡量文档表面文本由LLM生成的比例，并未从根本上评估信息内容或思想是否真正源自LLM本身，而非用户在提示中提供的。本文设计了一种框架，用于衡量人类在语言模型可轻易自动生成的内容基础上所增加的价值。该方法无需训练或标注数据，且从不评分文档的表面文本，从而避免了风格混淆的影响。相反，它从不同粒度提取文档内容，使用LLM从每个部分表示中重建文档，并将这些重建结果与仅基于任务描述生成的结果进行比较。我们称此框架为‘语言模型之外的价值’（VOLM），用于衡量文档相对于仅由任务描述即可生成的替代性文档的贡献度。我们在新闻文章、ICLR同行评审和论辩性论文三个领域对VOLM进行了评估。VOLM能够有效区分人类撰写的文档与基于通用任务描述生成的LLM文档，同时对保持内容不变的变换（如基于LLM的重构和往返翻译）具有高度鲁棒性。我们还发现，随着内容提取器约束程度提高，LLM生成文本与人类化文本之间的残差差异逐渐减小，凸显了将信息内容与风格变异解耦的重要性。我们希望这些结果能激励进一步研究该框架的特定实例，以及更普遍地评估LLM辅助写作中的人类贡献。

summary: We describe the SciTrue team's participation in both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval task~\cite{sciclaimeval}, which asks systems to verify scientific claims against the tables and figures of a paper. Rather than tuning a single model, we benchmark eleven frontier and open multimodal models under one honest, per-sample protocol and combine them with light, transparent post-processing. On the official, blind test leaderboard (Section~\ref{sec:results}), SciTrue placed first by a clear margin in three of the four evidence-category/subtask combinations, and tied for first on the primary metric in the fourth. Three findings explain the result. First, strong instruction-tuned models are already competitive: Claude Opus~4.8 and Gemma-4-31B each exceed the strongest public baseline (o4-mini), and GPT-5.5 and Claude Fable~5 lead both subtasks (97.7 on Subtask~2). Second, the task's pairing structure is the largest lever: a \emph{leak-free pair prior} that recovers the Supported/Refuted pairing from the claim text alone (a visible field) and assigns Supported to the higher-confidence evidence raises Subtask-1 pair-accuracy from 72.2 to 93.5, far more than any model swap or ensemble weighting. Third, a case-by-case audit finds that most residual errors are visually-undetectable label-mapping swaps or dataset label noise, so measured accuracy understates the true ability and the fixable-by-modeling headroom is small. Controlled fine-tuning, distillation, and agentic consistency-checking support the same conclusions, and we document throughout a measurement leak---label information reaching a system through the packaging of the data rather than its content---in which the released file ordering encodes the label, including one instance that briefly misled our own pipeline.
title: SciTrue: Reliable Scientific Claim Validation with Frontier and Open Language Models at the NTCIR SciClaimEval Task
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 19th NTCIR Conference (NTCIR-19)
title_translated: SciTrue：在NTCIR SciClaimEval任务中利用前沿与开源语言模型实现可靠的科学主张验证
summary_translated: 本文介绍了SciTrue团队参与NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval任务两个子任务的情况，该任务要求系统根据论文中的表格和图表验证科学主张。我们并未对单一模型进行调优，而是采用统一、透明的逐样本协议，对十一款前沿及开源多模态模型进行基准测试，并结合轻量级、透明的后处理方法。在官方盲测排行榜上，SciTrue在四个证据类别/子任务组合中的三项中以明显优势排名第一，在第四项主指标上并列第一。三个发现解释了这一结果：首先，经过指令微调的强模型已具备竞争力：Claude Opus 4.8和Gemma-4-31B均超过最强公开基线（o4-mini），而GPT-5.5和Claude Fable 5则在两个子任务中领先（Subtask 2得分为97.7）。其次，任务的配对结构是最大杠杆：一种“无泄漏配对先验”机制，仅通过可见的主张文本恢复支持/反驳配对，并将高置信度证据标记为支持，使Subtask-1的配对准确率从72.2提升至93.5，远超任何模型替换或集成加权的效果。第三，逐案审计发现，大部分残余错误源于视觉不可察觉的标签映射错误或数据集标签噪声，因此测量的准确率低估了真实能力，且模型可改进的空间有限。受控微调、知识蒸馏和代理一致性检查均支持上述结论，我们还全程记录到一个测量漏洞——标签信息通过数据包装方式而非内容传递给系统，例如释放文件的排序编码了标签，曾短暂误导我们自己的流水线。

summary: Retrieval is the first stage of modern search and advertising systems, selecting a candidate set from a large item universe for downstream ranking and auction. Recent work increasingly leverages LLMs to improve retrieval through query expansion, data synthesis, and retrieval-feedback training. However, the generative component is typically used for query-side augmentation, while final matching is still delegated to a downstream retriever. We introduce CoGR, a retrieval framework that instead trains LLMs to directly construct retrieval representations on both query and item sides. Each generator produces a compact set of keywords, which are matched directly through an inverted index, preserving compatibility with existing keyword-based retrieval infrastructure. CoGR uses a two-stage training pipeline. Supervised fine-tuning first establishes an aligned keyword space, after which co-evolving reinforcement learning alternately optimizes the query- and item-side generators with GRPO against the opposite side's frozen index. Both sides optimize the same query-to-item retrieval $F_1$ objective: the query side receives retrieval $F_1$ directly, while the item side receives a counterfactual marginal reward measuring the change in query-side $F_1$ caused by its generated keywords. Across 10 representative sparse, dense, and generative baselines, CoGR achieves the best performance on both an internal APP Marketplace dataset and the public WANDS benchmark, improving $F_1$ over the strongest baseline by $10.9\%$ and $36.1\%$, respectively. Further analysis shows stable co-evolution and increasingly aligned query--item keyword spaces over training.
title: It Takes Two to Match: Co-Evolving Generative Retriever with Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 成对匹配需要双方协同进化：基于强化学习的生成式检索器协同优化
summary_translated: 检索是现代搜索与广告系统的第一阶段，负责从庞大的项目库中选出候选集供后续排序与拍卖使用。近期工作越来越多地利用大语言模型（LLM）通过查询扩展、数据合成和检索反馈训练来提升检索效果。然而，生成组件通常仅用于查询端增强，最终匹配仍交由下游检索器完成。我们提出CoGR框架，该框架训练LLM直接在查询端和项目端构建检索表示。每个生成器产生一组紧凑关键词，通过倒排索引直接匹配，保留了与现有基于关键词的检索基础设施的兼容性。CoGR采用两阶段训练流程：监督微调首先建立对齐的关键词空间，随后通过交替优化的强化学习（GRPO）分别优化查询端和项目端生成器，以对方冻结的索引为基准。两端优化相同的查询到项目检索F1目标：查询端直接获得检索F1，而项目端则接收一个反事实边际奖励，衡量其生成关键词对查询端F1造成的改变。在10个代表性稀疏、稠密和生成式基线中，CoGR在内部APP Marketplace数据集和公开的WANDS基准上均表现最佳，相较于最强基线分别提升了10.9%和36.1%的F1得分。进一步分析显示，训练过程中实现了稳定的协同进化，且查询-项目关键词空间逐步趋于对齐。

summary: Prompt optimization can improve multi-agent LLM systems, but the prompts being optimized often serve two entangled roles: generating task-relevant content and specifying execution-critical protocols, such as message routing, output formatting, and termination signals, on which the underlying code relies. As a result, a prompt edit intended to improve content generation can inadvertently corrupt the protocol and cause the entire agent pipeline to fail. Our key observation is that these two roles have different representations: execution protocols are typically structured, while task-relevant content is usually expressed in unstructured language. Based on this, we propose control-data flow separation, where execution-critical control is represented as typed, validated program objects, while task-relevant language remains the optimizable data flow for agent communication. This design allows optimizers to improve multi-agent behavior without exposing the routing or formatting interface to prompt drift. Across synthetic reasoning, collaborative review generation, and insurance rating workflows, our framework empirically achieves 100% eventual protocol validity while consistently improving task performance.
title: Control-Data Flow Separation: Stable Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent LLMs
title_translated: 控制-数据流分离：多智能体LLM中稳定的提示优化
summary_translated: 提示优化可以提升多智能体大语言模型系统的表现，但被优化的提示往往承担双重纠缠角色：生成任务相关的内容，以及指定执行关键协议（如消息路由、输出格式、终止信号等），这些协议依赖于底层代码。因此，旨在改善内容生成的提示修改可能无意中破坏协议，导致整个智能体流水线失效。我们的核心观察是，这两种角色具有不同的表达形式：执行协议通常是结构化的，而任务相关内容通常以非结构化语言表达。基于此，我们提出控制-数据流分离机制，将执行关键的控制表示为类型化、可验证的程序对象，而任务相关内容则作为可优化的数据流用于智能体通信。该设计使优化器能够在不暴露路由或格式接口的情况下改进多智能体行为，防止提示漂移。在合成推理、协作评审生成和保险评级工作流等多个场景中，本框架实证实现了100%的最终协议有效性，同时持续提升任务性能。

summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) often assumes that a pre-defined forget set matches what the model has memorized, but this frequently breaks in realistic privacy settings where the original training data is inaccessible. We term this gap forget-set misalignment and identify two cases. In Under Unlearning, the forget set omits memorized information and leakage persists. In Out-of-Knowledge Unlearning, the algorithm is driven to "forget" knowledge the model never learned, perturbing parameters and degrading utility. Using gradient-level analysis, we show these behaviors arise from misaligned unlearning targets rather than specific optimization choices. We then propose CONfession-to-Forget-Set (CONFS), a data-blind framework that constructs model-aligned forget sets by eliciting and formalizing the model's memorized knowledge. Across synthetic, multimodal, and real-world benchmarks, CONFS approaches Gold-standard performance on several metrics and achieves a competitive forgetting-utility balance, while preserving utility better than other data-blind forget-set constructions.
title: Confess What You Know: Forget-Set Misalignment with Model Knowledge in LLM Unlearning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 22 pages, 3 figures
title_translated: 坦白你所知：大语言模型遗忘中的模型知识与遗忘集错位
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）的机器遗忘通常假设预定义的遗忘集与模型记忆内容一致，但在现实隐私场景中，原始训练数据不可访问时，这一假设常被打破。我们称这种差距为‘遗忘集错位’，并识别出两种情况：在‘欠遗忘’中，遗忘集遗漏了模型已记忆的信息，导致泄露持续存在；在‘超出知识范围的遗忘’中，算法被迫‘遗忘’模型从未学过的知识，从而扰动参数并降低模型效用。通过梯度层面分析，我们表明这些行为源于遗忘目标的错位，而非特定优化选择。随后我们提出CONfession-to-Forget-Set（CONFS）框架，这是一种数据无关的方案，通过诱导并形式化模型的记忆知识来构建与模型对齐的遗忘集。在合成、多模态和真实世界基准上，CONFS在多个指标上接近黄金标准表现，实现了有竞争力的遗忘-效用平衡，且相比其他数据无关的遗忘集构造方法更好地保留了模型效用。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown proficiency in various software engineering tasks, such as code generation and translation. However, a key limitation in their performance may be their (lack of) understanding of programming-language semantics. Even when explicit semantics are given, it remains unclear whether LLMs apply those rules or lean on priors learned during pre-training instead. We study if LLMs lean on priors or given semantics with a novel task--Program Executability Prediction (PrEx)--that asks models to predict whether a program is semantically valid or invalid (and, if invalid, which formal rule it violates) given the program's syntax and operational semantics. Because PrEx requires both valid and invalid programs, we build a dataset with systematically generated invalid transformations derived from valid programs. We evaluate open-source coding LLMs under two semantic formalisms and two semantic shifts across Human-Written, LLM-Translated, and Fuzzer-Generated program splits. Our findings show that LLMs lean on pre-training priors rather than systematically applying the given rules, performing especially poorly on modified semantics and degrading further as program complexity increases. PrEx is available at https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex.
title: Predicting Program Exit Code with LLMs and Programming Language Semantics
title_translated: 基于大语言模型与编程语言语义的程序退出码预测
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成和翻译等软件工程任务中表现出色，但其性能的关键限制可能在于对编程语言语义的理解不足。即使提供了明确的语义规则，仍不清楚LLMs是遵循这些规则还是依赖预训练阶段学到的先验知识。我们提出了一项新任务——程序可执行性预测（PrEx），要求模型根据程序的语法和操作语义判断其是否具有语义有效性（或无效时指出违反的具体规则）。由于PrEx需要有效和无效程序，我们构建了一个通过系统化生成无效变换而得的数据集。我们在两种语义形式和两种语义变化下，评估了开源编码LLMs在人工编写、LLM翻译和模糊测试生成的程序划分中的表现。研究发现，LLMs更倾向于依赖预训练先验而非系统性应用给定规则，尤其在语义修改和程序复杂度增加时表现显著下降。PrEx项目地址：https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex。

summary: Item-sensitivity, defined as whether a model's choice depends on the specific input rather than on its own output prior, is widely reported as evidence of task competence. We show this evidence is necessary but not sufficient using a forced-choice signalling task abstracted from the board game Deception: Murder in Hong Kong. In this environment, the reference points against which a coordinate should be judged (a fit-maximising strategy, a posterior-maximising strategy, and uniform random selection) are all computable in closed form. Across seven language models, two model families, a post-training ablation, and three independent scoring rules, every one of 21 model-by-rule cells is reliably item-sensitive. Yet 8 of those 21 cells are not statistically distinguishable from a chooser that ignores the item and selects at random, and 5 score worse than random at describing the target. Item-sensitivity and distance from random correlate at only r = 0.30. We call this consistency without alignment and argue it generalises to any evaluation that relies on item-sensitivity, permutation consistency, or self-consistency without an independent reference for the measured quantity. We further find that a literal-similarity baseline with no pragmatics outperforms most tested language models, that adding a pragmatic layer over two baseline similarity sources moves choosers toward random rather than toward the Bayesian reference, and that a standard labelled multiple-choice format carries no measurable content signal here. All results represent the model side of a pre-registered instrument; a matched human condition is designed and piloted but not yet collected.
title: Consistency Without Alignment: Item-Sensitive Language Models Indistinguishable From Random
title_translated: 无对齐的一致性：项目敏感型语言模型与随机选择无法区分
summary_translated: 项目敏感性（即模型选择是否依赖于具体输入而非自身输出先验）常被视为任务能力的证据。我们通过从桌游《香港谋杀案》抽象出的强制选择信号任务证明，这种证据是必要但不充分的。在此环境中，判断坐标的参考标准（最大化契合策略、后验最大化策略和均匀随机选择）均可闭式计算。在七种语言模型、两种模型族、一次后训练消融实验及三种独立评分规则下，21个模型-规则组合全部表现出可靠的项目敏感性。然而，其中8个组合在统计上无法与忽略输入、随机选择的决策者区分开来，另有5个在描述目标时表现劣于随机。项目敏感性与远离随机的距离相关系数仅为r = 0.30。我们称此现象为‘无对齐的一致性’，并认为它泛化到所有依赖项目敏感性、排列一致性或自我一致性但缺乏独立参照量的评估。进一步发现，一个无语用学的字面相似性基线优于大多数测试的语言模型；在两个基线相似源上添加语用层反而使选择者趋向随机而非贝叶斯参考；标准标注多选格式在此任务中未传递可测量的内容信号。所有结果均来自预先注册仪器的模型侧；匹配的人类条件已设计并试点，但尚未收集。

summary: Cultural fine-tuning has become the de facto paradigm for building culture-aware large language models (LLMs), yet existing optimization exclusively for alignment scores provides an incomplete portrait of cultural fidelity by systematically obscuring inherent cultural diversity. This unidimensional evaluation lens prompts a fundamental question: do models genuinely perceive distinct cultural nuances, or do they merely memorize dominant cultural values? To address this, we propose a synergistic evaluation framework that jointly formalizes cultural alignment and diversity. Through extensive benchmarking of six mainstream LLMs on the World Values Survey, this framework uncovers a systematic and critical trade-off: the pursuit of cultural alignment consistently incurs an acute expense of diversity, leading to severe "cultural flattening." Investigating this behavioral shift, we demonstrate that these superficial alignment gains stem from models artificially anchoring to dominant majorities, converging onto a monolithic response pattern that wipes out the heterogeneous distributions inherent to human groups. Crucially, our mechanistic analysis suggests that this diversity collapse is not merely a behavioral anomaly but more likely a structural consequence of the low-rank bias inherent in neural network optimization. Therefore, our findings expose the limitations of current post-training paradigms and call for a shift toward alignment objectives that preserve cross-cultural pluralism.
title: Aligned but Flattened: Analyzing the Trade-off between Cultural Alignment and Diversity in LLMs
title_translated: 对齐但扁平化：大语言模型中文化对齐与多样性之间的权衡分析
summary_translated: 文化微调已成为构建具备文化意识的大语言模型（LLMs）的默认范式，但现有仅优化对齐分数的方法未能全面反映文化真实性，系统性掩盖了内在的文化多样性。这一单一维度的评估视角引发根本问题：模型是否真正感知到不同的文化细微差别，还是仅仅记忆了主导文化价值观？为此，我们提出一种协同评估框架，联合形式化文化对齐与多样性。通过对六种主流LLMs在世界价值观调查数据集上的广泛基准测试，该框架揭示出一种系统且关键的权衡：追求文化对齐会持续付出多样性的高昂代价，导致严重的“文化扁平化”。通过探究这一行为转变，我们证明这些表面的对齐收益源于模型人为锚定于主导多数群体，趋同于单一响应模式，抹除了人类群体固有的异质分布。至关重要的是，我们的机制分析表明，这种多样性崩溃并非单纯的异常行为，更可能是神经网络优化中固有的低秩偏差所导致的结构性后果。因此，我们的研究揭示了当前后训练范式的局限性，并呼吁转向能保留跨文化多元性的对齐目标。

summary: Both privacy and factual accuracy are paramount in high-stakes domains like healthcare. Concerningly, we uncover and investigate a privacy-hallucination tradeoff in differentially private (DP) language models. First, we empirically show that models pre-trained or fine-tuned with DP tend to produce more hallucinations than non-DP counterparts, with increased severity as the privacy budget grows stricter. Second, we investigate model properties driving this tradeoff, demonstrating that DP mechanisms flatten output distributions, potentially redistributing probability mass toward factually incorrect alternatives. Third, through experiments where we control fact frequency in training data, we characterize how information frequency can reduce hallucination risks in DP models. Overall, our findings underscore the need for more nuanced privacy-preserving interventions that offer rigorous privacy guarantees without compromising factual accuracy.
title: The Privacy-Hallucination Tradeoff in Differentially Private Language Models
title_translated: 差分隐私语言模型中的隐私-幻觉权衡
summary_translated: 在医疗等高风险领域，隐私保护和事实准确性都至关重要。令人担忧的是，我们发现了差分隐私（DP）语言模型中存在的隐私-幻觉权衡。首先，我们实证表明，使用DP进行预训练或微调的模型比非DP模型产生更多幻觉，且随着隐私预算收紧，幻觉严重程度加剧。其次，我们研究了驱动这一权衡的模型特性，证明DP机制会扁平化输出分布，可能将概率质量重新分配至事实错误的选项。第三，通过控制训练数据中信息频率的实验，我们刻画了信息频率如何降低DP模型的幻觉风险。总体而言，我们的发现强调需要更精细的隐私保护干预措施，在提供严格隐私保障的同时不牺牲事实准确性。

summary: Group relative policy optimization for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses a fixed importance-sampling (IS) ratio clipping boundary across all rollouts. We identify a key limitation: rare correct rollouts on harder problems and abundant correct rollouts on easier problems are clipped at comparable rates, despite contributing very different learning signals. Rollouts with low group success exhibit larger IS ratios and carry stronger gradient signal for exploration and solving new problems, yet are disproportionately suppressed by fixed clipping.   To address this, we propose Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization (GAPO), a plug-in modification to GRPO methods that adapts the clipping boundary to the rollout advantage. GAPO is motivated by a reverse-KL trust-region perspective, which suggests that rollouts with larger learning signal should receive proportionally greater update headroom. GAPO requires no reward shaping and preserves the standard PPO/GSPO surrogate while adapting only the clipping threshold. Across Qwen and Llama models, GAPO consistently improves both Pass@1 and Pass@k over fixed clipping and advantage-shaping baselines on math reasoning and coding benchmarks where the pass rates by the base model are relatively low.
title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization
title_translated: 群体自适应裁剪策略优化
summary_translated: 针对具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）通常在所有轨迹中使用固定的重要的采样（IS）比率裁剪边界。我们识别出一个关键局限：在较难问题上罕见的正确轨迹与在较易问题上丰富的正确轨迹被以相近速率裁剪，尽管它们提供的学习信号差异巨大。成功率低的群体轨迹具有更大的IS比率，携带更强的梯度信号以促进探索和解决新问题，却因固定裁剪而被不成比例地抑制。为解决此问题，我们提出群体自适应裁剪策略优化（GAPO），这是一种可插拔的GRPO方法改进，根据轨迹优势动态调整裁剪边界。GAPO受反KL信任区域视角启发，建议学习信号更强的轨迹应获得相应更大的更新空间。GAPO无需奖励塑造，同时保持标准PPO/GSPO代理函数，仅调整裁剪阈值。在Qwen和Llama模型上，GAPO在数学推理和编码基准测试中，当基础模型通过率较低时，始终优于固定裁剪和优势塑造基线，显著提升Pass@1和Pass@k指标。

summary: Evaluating task-oriented dialogue agents requires judging not merely whether a reply reads well but whether each turn advances the underlying workflow state correctly--a distinction conventional holistic LLM judges can miss because they evaluate the available context as a single unit and require one or more full-model calls per turn. We propose SAGE (State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation), which compiles a workflow specification and per-turn state diff into atomic, schema-grounded criteria and routes each through a cascade of symbolic and encoder/NLI verifiers that abstain rather than guess, aggregating criterion verdicts into a turn-level decision with an evidence trace. Its recommended operating point, SAGE-Core, decides 81--91% of criteria with only the compiler, symbolic rules, and on-device encoders--at zero paid LLM cost--while SAGE-LLM adds an optional focused-LLM fallback for open-class criteria. Across four slices spanning MultiWOZ, Schema-Guided Dialogue, and ABCD, no evaluated LLM-as-a-judge baseline--including a state-aware GPT-4.1 judge and cheaper GPT-4.1-mini variants--significantly exceeds SAGE-Core on any slice, even though the GPT-4.1 G-Eval judge costs $4.7--8.0 per 1,000 turns to SAGE-Core's $0. A two-annotator human audit (n=200, $κ$=0.94) confirms strong label fidelity on the transcript-visible failure classes--where, excluding the weak-salience IUV class, SAGE-Core is statistically tied with the strongest LLM judge--and honestly scopes ignored-user-value as a state-consistency signal with weak broad-human salience. We analyze construct-validity limits from injected failures and partial symbolic circularity.
title: SAGE: State-Grounded, Abstention-Aware Evaluation of Task-Oriented Dialogue Agents
title_translated: SAGE：基于状态、具备回避意识的任务导向对话智能体评估方法
summary_translated: 评估任务导向的对话智能体不仅需要判断回复是否流畅，更需判断每一轮对话是否正确推进底层工作流状态——这一区别常被传统整体式大模型评估忽略，因其将上下文视为单一单元，并需每轮调用一次或多次完整模型。我们提出SAGE（状态基础、回避意识评估），将工作流规范和每轮的状态差异编译为原子化、基于模式的标准，并通过符号与编码器/自然语言推理验证器级联处理，选择回避猜测而非强行判断，将标准 verdict 聚合为轮次级决策并附带证据链。其推荐运行点SAGE-Core仅使用编译器、符号规则和本地编码器即可决定81%-91%的标准，实现零付费大模型成本；SAGE-LLM则为开放类别标准提供可选聚焦式大模型回退机制。在涵盖MultiWOZ、Schema-Guided Dialogue和ABCD的四个数据切片上，所有评估的大模型作为裁判基线（包括具备状态感知能力的GPT-4.1裁判及更低成本的GPT-4.1-mini变体）均未在任一切片显著超越SAGE-Core，尽管GPT-4.1 G-Eval裁判每千轮成本高达4.7-8.0美元，而SAGE-Core仅为0美元。两次标注员人工审计（n=200，κ=0.94）确认了在可观察转录失败类别上的强标签一致性——排除弱显著性IUV类别后，SAGE-Core与最强的大模型裁判统计上无差异；同时诚实揭示“忽略用户价值”作为状态一致性信号，具有较弱的广泛人类显著性。我们分析了注入故障和部分符号循环带来的构念效度限制。

summary: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. Persistent state objects, a reusable skill library, and multi-executor coordination link human decisions to AI execution, turning planning, execution, and writing into one traceable, recoverable loop. We demonstrate Dr. Claw through an interactive three-view scenario and a failure-recovery walkthrough, and evaluate it against a bare command-line agent sharing the same backend executor, so the comparison contrasts the whole orchestration layer (task graph, state objects, and skill library) with the agent it wraps. Holding the executor fixed, Dr. Claw scores higher on research completeness while persisting an auditable, recoverable process trail. Demo access: repository https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw, released under AGPL-3.0 with GPL-3.0 upstream components.
title: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. Code: this https URL
title_translated: Dr. Claw：面向氛围研究的AI科学家工作空间
summary_translated: 命令行编程智能体（如Claude Code、Gemini CLI）已能读写文件并维持长时间会话，但端到端研究仍分散于聊天工具、IDE、终端和写作环境之间，且使研究可审计的关键决策往往无法保留。我们提出Dr. Claw，一个开源工作空间，将现有编程智能体执行器封装在可控且可审计的人机协同流程中，而非引入另一个自主智能体。持久化状态对象、可复用技能库以及多执行器协调机制将人类决策与AI执行相连接，使规划、执行与写作形成一条可追溯、可恢复的闭环。我们通过交互式三视图场景和故障恢复演示展示了Dr. Claw，并将其与共享相同后端执行器的纯命令行智能体进行对比，从而突出整个编排层（任务图、状态对象与技能库）与所封装智能体之间的差异。在固定执行器的前提下，Dr. Claw在研究完整性方面得分更高，同时保持可审计、可恢复的过程轨迹。演示访问：仓库 https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw，采用AGPL-3.0许可，上游组件为GPL-3.0。

summary: Toxic language in digital workplaces such as pejoratives, sarcasm, condescension, and subtle incivility can erode trust, morale, and collaboration. Existing moderation tools primarily delete or block harmful messages, disrupting communication and offering no constructive resolution. This study adopts a Design Science Research approach to create a responsible AI artifact that detects and detoxifies toxic communication. The artifact integrates fine-tuned transformer-based classifiers (DistilBERT, DistilRoBERTa) with a generative detoxification model (mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO) that rewrites toxic text into semantically equivalent, non-offensive paraphrases. Technical evaluation demonstrates high accuracy in toxicity detection and strong semantic preservation in rewritten messages, supporting conversation continuity while reinforcing respectful discourse. The paper contributes design principles for responsible AI moderation that prioritize meaning preservation and fairness.
title: Detoxifying Toxic Communication: A Design Science Approach to Responsible AI
comment: 10 pages. An updated version appears in the Proceedings of the 60th Hawaii International Conference on Systems Science (HICSS-60), Honolulu, HI, January 5-8, 2027
title_translated: 净化有毒沟通：负责任AI的设计科学方法
summary_translated: 数字职场中的有毒语言，如贬义词、讽刺、居高临下和微妙不敬，会侵蚀信任、士气与协作。现有内容审核工具主要通过删除或屏蔽有害信息来应对，破坏沟通连续性且无法提供建设性解决方案。本研究采用设计科学研究方法，构建一个负责任的AI工具，用于检测并净化有毒沟通。该工具整合微调的基于Transformer的分类器（DistilBERT、DistilRoBERTa）与生成式净化模型（mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO），将有毒文本重写为语义等价、无冒犯性的改写版本。技术评估表明，该工具在毒性检测上具有高准确率，在重写消息中表现出强语义保真度，支持对话连续性的同时强化尊重性交流。本文贡献了负责任AI审核的设计原则，强调意义保全与公平性。

summary: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, yet on vision-language models (VLMs) it has been caught in a self-defeating cycle. The drafter stays autoregressive, so it must stay small. A small drafter cannot afford the image at every step, so vision is compressed, pruned, or hidden. A drafter cut off from the image is then least reliable exactly where the image makes text predictable. We present GLANCE, the first one-pass block drafter that is lossless on an unmodified VLM target, and it breaks the cycle at both ends. A block-diffusion head reads the target's already-fused vision-language state, so vision costs the drafter nothing, and fills a whole block in one forward pass, so depth costs no sequential steps. A wide candidate tree is verified in one target pass, and every audited prompt reproduces greedy decoding exactly. Grounded workloads reward this most, entering a verbatim-copy regime whose long runs cost an autoregressive drafter a pass for every token and a block drafter one in total. Under one engine and one round budget, GLANCE decodes up to 2.93x faster than autoregression, from one draft pass a round where the production EAGLE3-VL head takes eight, and accepts 2.7x longer blocks than an EAGLE-3 head trained on the same corpus. One law organizes these results. Accepted length is set by the target's next-token entropy, with a fitted slope that steepens with grounding across all five tasks. The law transfers across targets and modalities and names its own boundary, since free-running text still favors a chain. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE.
title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 视觉并非负担：面向视觉-语言模型的无损推测解码的一次性块草稿方法
summary_translated: 推测解码可在不改变输出的情况下加速生成，但在视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中却陷入自我挫败的循环。草稿模型必须保持自回归特性，因此规模受限；小规模草稿模型无法在每一步承担图像输入，导致视觉信息被压缩、剪枝或隐藏；而失去图像信息的草稿模型恰恰在图像使文本可预测的位置最不可靠。我们提出GLANCE，首个在未经修改的VLM目标上实现无损的一次性块草稿方法，从两端打破这一循环。块扩散头读取目标模型已融合的视觉-语言状态，使视觉对草稿模型无额外开销；单次前向传播即可填充一整个块，避免深度计算的序列步骤开销。宽候选树可在一次目标模型前向传播中完成验证，且每个经验证的提示都能精确重现贪婪解码结果。在基于真实场景的工作负载中收益最大，进入逐字复制模式，长序列生成对自回归草稿模型而言每token需一整轮，而块草稿模型仅需一轮总成本。在单一引擎与一轮预算下，GLANCE比自回归解码快达2.93倍，每轮仅需一次草稿传递（而生产EAGLE3-VL头部需八次），且接受的块长度比在同一语料训练的EAGLE-3头部长2.7倍。一种统一规律组织这些结果：接受长度由目标模型的下一个token熵决定，斜率随任务的语境关联度增强，在五个任务中均成立。该规律可跨模型与模态迁移，并定义自身边界，因为自由运行的文本仍偏好链式结构。代码已公开于 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE。

summary: Online health information seeking is shifting from keyword search, where users consider a ranked list of links, to conversational systems that compose a single answer and curate its citations. Source evaluation therefore passes from user to platform, yet what these systems surface is poorly characterized. We audited three free consumer products (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview) on twenty English mental health questions under two prompt conditions, with a subset of three also translated into six further languages of varying resource tiers. We recorded 15,942 citations across 1,140 responses and 1,713 unique domains, then classified every citation with a nine-category organizational typology applied by a deterministic classifier validated against human coding. Citations were heavily concentrated: the ten most-cited domains accounted for 43.6% of English citations, and government, commercial health, and academic sources were closely matched at roughly 22% each. Platforms differed little in typical citation volume but sharply in consistency and in the source types they favored. Explicitly requesting sources shifted composition only modestly. Non-English queries surfaced fewer citations and were routed to language-appropriate resources at significantly lower rates. We release the typology, classifier, and annotated corpus as reusable instruments for auditing generative health search.
title: Sources of Truth: A Multi-Platform, Multilingual Audit of Citations in AI Mental Health Information Queries
comment: 28 pages (16-page main text plus supporting information), 5 figures, 5 tables. Under review. Code: this https URL Data: this https URL
title_translated: 真理来源：对AI心理健康信息查询中引用的多平台、多语言审计
summary_translated: 在线健康信息搜索正从关键词检索（用户考虑排序链接列表）转向对话系统，后者生成单一答案并为其引用来源进行筛选。因此，来源评估责任从用户转移到平台，但这些系统呈现的内容特征尚不清晰。我们对三个免费消费者产品（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overview）在二十个英文心理健康问题上进行了审计，采用两种提示条件，其中三组还翻译成六种不同资源水平的语言。共记录15,942条引用，覆盖1,140个回答和1,713个唯一域名，随后使用由确定性分类器实施的九类组织类型分类体系对每条引用进行分类，该分类器经人工标注验证。引用高度集中：十大最常被引用域名占英文引用的43.6%，政府、商业健康和学术来源各约占22%。各平台在平均引用数量上差异不大，但在一致性和所偏好的来源类型上存在显著差异。明确要求引用仅带来适度的组成变化。非英文查询产生的引用更少，且被路由至语言适配资源的比例显著更低。我们发布该分类体系、分类器和标注语料库，作为审计生成式健康搜索的可复用工具。

summary: Many people now see AI systems as not just productivity tools but as social companions. Researchers are eager to study the consequences of AI companionship behaviors, such as validation, which evoke trust, empathy, and attachment in human-human interaction. However, human-AI interaction data is limited and unreliable, slowing research progress. We scale small amounts of real-world data by simulating multi-turn human-chatbot dialogue across a range of chatbot behaviors and use cases. We release CompanionSim: a simulation framework with 2,240 simulated human-chatbot conversations representing 16 chatbot behaviors across seven use cases. Human participants annotated the simulated conversations and real-world conversations in two experiments probing perceptions of companionship behaviors. We conducted Study 1 with a U.S. representative sample ($N_{1}~=~628$) and Study 2 across the U.S., U.K., India, and Nigeria ($N_{2}~=~3,646$). Surprisingly, we find that companionship behaviors reduced likability, humanlikeness, and trust in AI chatbots. These effects were larger in particular subgroups: women and older participants saw companionship chatbots as less likable, humanlike, and trustworthy. We encourage researchers to leverage real-world and synthetic data together to study the differential impacts of AI companions and to create benchmark evaluations of AI chatbots.
title: CompanionSim: Synthetic Data for Evaluating Anthropomorphism in Human-AI Relationships
title_translated: CompanionSim：用于评估人机关系中拟人化行为的合成数据
summary_translated: 如今，许多人将AI系统视为不仅仅是生产力工具，更是社交伙伴。研究人员迫切希望研究AI陪伴行为（如认可）带来的后果，这些行为会引发人类之间的信任、共情和依恋。然而，人机交互数据有限且不可靠，阻碍了研究进展。我们通过模拟多种聊天机器人行为和应用场景下的多轮对话，对少量真实世界数据进行扩展。我们发布了CompanionSim：一个包含2,240个模拟人机对话的仿真框架，涵盖七种使用场景下的16种聊天机器人行为。在两项实验中，人类参与者对模拟对话和真实对话进行了标注，以探究对陪伴行为的感知。Study 1 使用美国代表性样本（N₁ ≈ 628），Study 2 覆盖美国、英国、印度和尼日利亚（N₂ ≈ 3,646）。令人惊讶的是，我们发现陪伴行为降低了人们对AI聊天机器人的喜爱度、类人程度和信任感。这种影响在特定子群体中更为显著：女性和年长参与者认为陪伴型聊天机器人更不讨喜、更不像人、也更不可信。我们鼓励研究者结合真实数据与合成数据，研究AI伴侣的差异化影响，并建立AI聊天机器人的基准评估体系。

summary: Long-tail autonomous driving failures are often framed as rare-object recognition errors. We argue that this view is incomplete: the decision-critical question is not only whether a model recognizes an unusual object, but whether it infers how that object changes the ego vehicle's feasible high-level actions. We formalize this problem as decision-level driving affordance prediction, where a model maps a front-view image, ego-motion history, and navigation command to a structured longitudinal--lateral meta-action. To evaluate this capability, we introduce CoLT-Drive, a 3,536-sample counterfactual long-tail benchmark that inserts rare objects into otherwise fixed driving scenes and measures whether models predict acceptable action pairs. To improve deployable small VLMs, we propose KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that combines structured perception-to-decision prompting, SLERP-based expert merging, and RegMoE, a regime-aware LoRA mixture-of-experts module. KPA preserves the pretrained model's open-world knowledge while allocating lightweight adaptation capacity to different driving decision regimes. Experiments on an in-domain driving split and CoLT-Drive show that KPA achieves 60.8\% pair accuracy on CoLT-Drive, outperforming the pretrained Qwen3-VL-2B baseline (50.3\%) and LoRA SFT (32.4\%) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Our benchmark and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive and https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive.
title: CoLT-Drive: Counterfactual Long-Tail Benchmarking and Knowledge-Preserving Adaptation for Driving Affordance Prediction
title_translated: CoLT-Drive：用于驾驶可用性预测的反事实长尾基准与知识保持适应方法
summary_translated: 长尾自动驾驶失败常被归因于罕见物体识别错误。我们认为这一观点不完整：关键问题不仅在于模型是否识别出异常物体，更在于它能否推断该物体如何改变自身车辆可行的高层次动作。我们将此问题形式化为决策级驾驶可用性预测，即模型根据前视图像、自车运动历史和导航指令，输出结构化的纵向-横向元动作。为评估该能力，我们引入CoLT-Drive——一个包含3,536个样本的反事实长尾基准，通过在固定驾驶场景中插入罕见物体，测量模型是否能预测可接受的动作组合。为提升可部署的小型视觉语言模型性能，我们提出KPA：一种知识保持适应框架，结合结构化感知到决策的提示、基于SLERP的专家融合以及RegMoE——一种情境感知的LoRA混合专家模块。KPA在保留预训练模型开放世界知识的同时，为不同驾驶决策情境分配轻量级适应能力。在域内驾驶数据集和CoLT-Drive上的实验表明，KPA在CoLT-Drive上达到60.8%的动作对准确率，优于预训练Qwen3-VL-2B基线（50.3%）和LoRA SFT（32.4%），同时保持了有竞争力的域内准确率。我们的基准和代码已公开于 https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive 和 https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive。

summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems tackle complex reasoning by orchestrating how multiple agents are configured and how they collaborate. A central challenge is to adapt orchestration to the evolving collaboration state. Routing from the query alone cannot adapt to intermediate progress or errors, which hurts accuracy. Routing from the complete execution history supplies this missing context, but forces later decisions to process every prior step, including redundant or low-utility ones. This creates an execution-history overload that inflates cost. Effective orchestration instead requires a compact state that captures useful progress without accumulating redundant context. We propose Gated-Memory Routing, which conditions each decision on the query and a learned execution memory. A learned Memory Write Gate commits only non-redundant reasoning steps, and a learned Retrieval Gate supplies each agent a compact, relevant subset, so every decision conditions on a clean, informative state. At each step, the system selects the next role and backbone from this memory, while an Adaptive Halting Controller stops execution once the memory contains sufficient evidence for answering. Across five reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, our framework is both effective and efficient: it attains the best average accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.44 points, while reducing HumanEval inference cost by 31.9% relative to that baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/rajibrhasan/gated-memory-routing
title: Learning What to Retain: Gated-Memory Routing for Efficient Collaboration in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
title_translated: 学习保留什么：用于多智能体LLM系统高效协作的门控记忆路由
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统通过协调多个智能体的配置与协作来处理复杂推理任务。核心挑战在于如何根据协作状态的演变动态调整调度策略。仅依赖查询进行路由无法适应中间进展或错误，影响准确性；而依赖完整执行历史虽提供上下文，却迫使后续决策处理所有先前步骤，包括冗余或低效部分，造成执行历史过载，增加成本。有效的调度需要一种紧凑的状态表示，既能捕捉有用进展，又不积累冗余信息。我们提出门控记忆路由（Gated-Memory Routing），使每个决策基于查询和学习得到的执行记忆。学习到的记忆写入门控仅保留非冗余推理步骤，检索门控则为每个智能体提供精炼的相关子集，确保每一步决策都基于清晰且信息丰富的状态。在每一步中，系统从该记忆中选择下一个角色和骨干模型，同时自适应终止控制器在记忆中包含足够证据时停止执行。在五个推理与代码生成基准测试中，该框架兼具高效性与有效性：平均准确率最优，超过最强基线2.44个百分点，同时相比基线将HumanEval推理成本降低31.9%。代码已开源于 https://github.com/rajibrhasan/gated-memory-routing。

summary: Public trust in Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) may depend not only on technical success but also on the fairness of their decision making. While a recent trend in AV research involves using general purpose "common sense" models to guide AV decision making, the degree to which these inherit human biases in driving is still understudied. Given that psychology studies have shown human driver biases exist, such as lower pedestrian-yielding rates to Black pedestrians in the US, we argue that analyses of model bias should also be part of AV evaluation. Concretely, in this paper we propose two new bias testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs) and Visual-Language Models (VLMs)-"All Else Being Equal" tests and "Self-Consistency" tests-in order to assess bias in pedestrian-yielding decisions. Our findings show that both LLMs and VLMs make yielding decisions which are influenced by pedestrian gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, age, skin tone and socio-economic status. While the type and degree of bias is different from model to model, we highlight common patterns-and raise questions about the "common sense" model paradigm, particularly the need to either revise the paradigm or address issues of downstream bias.
title: LLM-Driven Autonomous Vehicles Inherit Human Driver Biases in Pedestrian Yielding: Results and Implications From A New Benchmark
title_translated: LLM驱动的自动驾驶车辆继承人类驾驶员在行人让行中的偏见：新基准下的结果与启示
summary_translated: 公众对自动驾驶汽车（AVs）的信任不仅取决于技术表现，还取决于其决策的公平性。尽管当前AV研究趋势是使用通用“常识”模型指导决策，但这些模型在驾驶中是否继承人类偏见仍缺乏充分研究。鉴于心理学研究表明人类驾驶员存在偏见（例如在美国，对黑人行人的让行率较低），我们认为模型偏见分析也应成为AV评估的一部分。本文提出两种针对大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的新偏见测试方法：“其他条件相等”测试和“自我一致性”测试，用以评估行人让行决策中的偏见。研究发现，LLMs和VLMs的让行决策均受到行人性别、种族、宗教、残疾状况、年龄、肤色及社会经济地位的影响。尽管不同模型的偏见类型和程度各异，但我们揭示了共同模式，并对“常识”模型范式提出质疑，尤其强调需重新审视该范式或解决下游偏见问题。

summary: LLM judges, models that score another system's output, can be gamed by the systems they score. Recent work identifies one defence that works: the judge solves the task itself first and commits to that answer, then accepts a candidate only if the two match. We call this commit-first judging, and ask whether shipped software implements it, and what it costs.   We audit the default judge configurations of eight widely used evaluation frameworks. Of the 24 configurations in scope, none implement it. Nine implement a variant the literature measures as ineffective, and share one ancestor prompt, traceable through a copied typographical error.   In a controlled experiment, an ordinary best-of-N search with no access to correct answers optimises code against one of these configurations, used exactly as documented. On an interval merging task the judge accepted 90 of 96 candidates in one seed and 93 of 96 in the other; every accepted candidate passed every test the search could see and failed a held-out suite it could not. The judge identified the defective line and cited it as grounds for a perfect score. Commit-first judging removed the effect: 0 of 96 in both seeds. On a second task it made matters worse in both seeds: the judge's committed answer was wrong, and in one seed the population converged on it. This is our main finding. Commit-first judging does not remove the anchor that gets gamed, it moves it from the candidate to the judge's own answer, so evaluation is only as good as the judge is at the task. That precondition is cheap to measure in advance, and is task local rather than scale dependent: a smaller judge solved a task the frontier judge failed and resisted gaming where it did not.   We also validate our own instruments: five of fifteen claims in our criteria were wrong against verbatim sources, and two held-out checks were unjustified by their specifications.
title: Commit-first LLM judging inherits the judge's own errors
title_translated: 先承诺的LLM评判会继承评判者自身的错误
summary_translated: LLM评判者（用于评分其他系统输出的模型）容易被其所评分的系统所操纵。近期研究指出一种有效防御机制：评判者先自行完成任务并承诺答案，再仅当候选答案与之匹配时才接受。我们称其为“先承诺评判”。本文探究该机制是否被实际软件采用及其代价。我们审计了八个广泛使用的评估框架的默认评判配置。在24个配置中，无一实现该机制；其中九个采用文献中证明无效的变体，并共享一个可追溯至复制拼写错误的祖先提示。在受控实验中，一个普通最佳N搜索（无正确答案访问权限）针对其中一个配置进行优化，完全按照文档使用。在区间合并任务中，评判者在一个种子下接受了90/96个候选，在另一种子下接受了93/96个；所有被接受的候选均通过了搜索可见的所有测试，但均在未见的保留测试中失败。评判者识别出缺陷行并以此作为满分理由。而“先承诺评判”消除了该效应：两个种子下均接受0/96个。在第二个任务中，情况更糟：评判者的承诺答案本身错误，且在一个种子中，整个种群收敛于该错误答案。这是我们的主要发现：先承诺评判并未消除被操纵的锚点，而是将其从候选移至评判者自身答案，因此评估质量仅取决于评判者在任务上的能力。该前提成本低廉且可预先测量，具有任务局部性而非规模依赖性：较小的评判者解决了前沿评判者未能解决的任务，并在未被操纵的情况下表现出更强的鲁棒性。此外，我们验证了自己的评估工具：十五项标准中的五项与原文不符，两项保留检查也缺乏规范支持。

summary: Malaria remains a significant global health burden, necessitating continuous research efforts to understand its complex molecular mechanisms, epidemiology, and potential therapeutic interventions. Extracting essential biomedical information from the vast and constantly growing malaria literature is a challenging task that demands innovative approaches. Recently, pre-trained language models have revolutionized natural language processing tasks, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in various domains. This paper proposes a fine-tuned pre-trained biomedical language model for biomedical information extraction from scientific literature on malaria disease. The proposed methodology selects and preprocesses a large corpus of scientific articles on malaria, and then annotates them with entities of clinical significance. It then leverages BioBERT, a state-of-the-art pre-trained language model, to encode the textual data into context-aware representations. We fine-tune the model using domain-specific annotations and supervised learning to enhance its ability to extract relevant biomedical named entities. Extensive experiments and comparisons with different encoding and machine learning algorithms show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms them in precision, recall, and accuracy. We also publish our human-labeled dataset for entity and relation extraction to enable other health informatics researchers to train advanced models for malaria information extraction.
title: MiNER: Fine-Tuned Biomedical Natural Language Processing for Malaria Disease Entity Recognition in Clinical Texts
title_translated: MiNER：面向临床文本中疟疾疾病实体识别的微调生物医学自然语言处理
summary_translated: 疟疾仍是全球重大健康负担，需要持续研究其复杂的分子机制、流行病学特征及潜在治疗干预手段。从海量且不断增长的疟疾文献中提取关键生物医学信息是一项具有挑战性的任务，亟需创新方法。近年来，预训练语言模型已彻底革新自然语言处理任务，在多个领域展现出卓越能力。本文提出一种针对疟疾科学文献的微调预训练生物医学语言模型，用于生物医学信息抽取。该方法选取并预处理大规模疟疾科学论文语料库，并对其中具有临床意义的实体进行标注。随后利用最先进的预训练语言模型BioBERT，将文本数据编码为上下文感知表示。通过领域特定标注和监督学习对模型进行微调，以增强其提取相关生物医学命名实体的能力。大量实验与不同编码和机器学习算法的对比表明，所提方法在精确率、召回率和准确率方面均显著优于现有方法。此外，我们公开了人工标注的实体与关系抽取数据集，以支持其他健康信息学研究人员训练先进的疟疾信息抽取模型。

summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets large language models adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, and fine-tuning can erode this behaviour. Many preservation diagnostics inspect attention: if attention changes when demonstrations change, the model is treated as context-sensitive. This paper asks how far that proxy can be trusted once it is optimised. We formalise \emph{In-Context Sensitivity} (ICS), the average row distance between last-token attention on matched and mismatched demonstration prefixes, and pair it with \emph{ICL-GAP}, the behavioural accuracy gap between the same prefixes. In a controlled four-arm ablation on Llama-2-7B, an ICS-maximising regulariser ($\armKL$) drives ICS to $1.413$, within $0.5\%$ of its geometric ceiling. The behavioural readout tells a different story: ICL-GAP stays near zero and MMLU accuracy moves from $0.371$ to $0.279$, a Goodhart dissociation of the bounded attention proxy. Endpoint statistics locate the mechanism: attention grows sharp and near-disjoint across prefixes yet routes to formatting and demonstration-body tokens rather than labels. A random-label protocol confirms that the behavioural probe family retains dynamic range at the same checkpoints. In a constructive sweep, behaviour gating partially mitigates the effect, while objectives anchored to pretrained computation hold the high-MMLU, moderate-ICS region that divergence maximisers leave. The main lesson is diagnostic: attention-level ICL proxies earn their place as training targets only after validation against behavioural gaps.
title: Attention Sensitivity Is Not Enough: Dissociating Attention-Level and Behavioural In-Context Learning under Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 注意力敏感性并不足够：在微调下区分注意力层级与行为上下文学习的解耦分析
summary_translated: 上下文学习（ICL）使大型语言模型能够通过示例适应新任务，但微调可能破坏这一行为。许多保留性诊断方法依赖于注意力机制：若注意力随示例变化而改变，则认为模型具备上下文敏感性。本文探讨当该代理指标被优化后，其可信度究竟有多高。我们形式化定义了‘上下文敏感性’（ICS），即匹配与不匹配示例前缀在最后一token注意力上的平均行距离，并将其与‘ICL-GAP’（相同前缀下的行为准确率差距）配对分析。在Llama-2-7B的受控四臂消融实验中，最大化ICS的正则项（$m{armKL}$）使ICS达到1.413，接近其几何上限的0.5%以内。然而行为读出结果却截然不同：ICL-GAP保持接近零，MMLU准确率从0.371降至0.279，显示出注意力代理指标与行为表现之间的Goodhart解耦现象。终点统计分析揭示了机制本质：注意力变得尖锐且前缀间几乎不重叠，但其路由路径指向格式化和示例主体token，而非标签。随机标签协议验证了行为探测器在相同检查点仍保持动态范围。在建设性探索中，行为门控部分缓解了该效应，而锚定于预训练计算的目标则维持了高MMLU、中等ICS区域，这正是发散最大化者所放弃的区域。核心启示是：注意力层级的ICL代理只有在经过行为差距验证后，才应作为训练目标。

summary: Commercial LLM APIs advertise a specific foundation model, but the served backbone may be silently substituted, quantized, or wrapped, for example to save deployment costs. All existing audits decide backbone identity from the text-output channel, which is structurally fragile for agentic APIs because modern serving stacks (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cloudflare Workers AI, LangGraph) discard text and expose only structured actions when the model calls a tool, and provider-injected system prompts can distort text distributions enough that text-channel tests falsely accuse honest providers of substituting the claimed model. We observe that recent agentic post-training internalizes tool-use directly into the weights, opening a new audit channel that the serving stack still exposes and that is largely invariant to deployment context. We introduce Agentic Provenance (AgentProv), the first action-based identity audit for agentic LLM APIs: AgentProv fingerprints a deployed model through its categorical tool-call distribution and decides identity via an MMD permutation test. AgentProv catches every substituted model (100% on 630 evaluated checkpoint pairs), while holding the false-positive rate under system-prompt injection at 7% (vs. 67% for MET and 53% for RUT). On third-party API endpoints, AgentProv's disagreements with MET are consistent with an independent token-count side-channel that detects provider-injected system prompts.
title: AgentProv: Auditing Agentic LLM API Providers via Tool-use Policy Probes
title_translated: AgentProv：基于工具使用策略探测的智能体LLM API 提供商审计
summary_translated: 商业LLM API 宣称提供特定基础模型，但实际服务的底层模型可能被悄然替换、量化或封装，例如为降低部署成本。现有所有审计方法均依赖文本输出通道判断模型身份，但对智能体API而言，这种做法结构上脆弱——现代服务架构（如OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Cloudflare Workers AI、LangGraph）在模型调用工具时会丢弃文本，仅暴露结构化动作；同时，提供商注入的系统提示可能严重扭曲文本分布，导致文本通道测试错误指控诚实提供商进行了模型替换。我们观察到，近期智能体后训练已将工具使用直接内化至模型权重中，从而开辟了一条新的审计通道：该通道由服务栈仍暴露，且对部署环境高度不变。为此，我们提出首个基于动作的身份审计方法——智能体溯源（AgentProv）：通过模型的分类工具调用分布进行指纹识别，并采用MMD置换检验判定身份。AgentProv成功检测出所有被替换的模型（630个检查点对中100%检出），同时在系统提示注入攻击下假阳性率控制在7%以内（相较MET的67%和RUT的53%显著更低）。在第三方API端点上，AgentProv与MET的分歧与一个独立的token计数侧信道一致，该信道可检测提供商注入的系统提示。

summary: Multimodal GUI agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for digital task automation, yet transitioning from benchmark-oriented models to dependable real-world applications remains challenging due to limited environment coverage, brittle task construction, and unreliable reward verification. In this work, we present UI-Venus-2, a general-purpose foundation GUI agent designed to operate across mobile, web, and desktop environments through a unified closed-loop reasoning-action framework. To bridge the gap toward practical deployment, we jointly scale three critical dimensions: (1) Environments, expanding coverage to more than 170 multilingual mobile apps and native desktop operating systems; (2) Tasks, employing a deep-research pipeline for function-grounded instruction generation; and (3) Verification, adopting trace-level and sample-level evaluators with visual keypoints and multi-model voting to ensure reliable RL signals for training. Furthermore, we integrate safety-aware mechanisms to ensure controlled execution of consequential actions. By offering a capable, efficient, and open-source foundation, UI-Venus-2 advances the field toward more generalizable, verifiable, and self-reflective agents for real-world applications.
title: UI-Venus-2 Technical Report
title_translated: UI-Venus-2 技术报告
summary_translated: 多模态GUI智能体已成为数字任务自动化的有前景范式，但要从基准导向模型过渡到可靠的实际应用仍面临诸多挑战，包括环境覆盖有限、任务构建脆弱以及奖励验证不可靠。本文提出UI-Venus-2，一种通用型基础GUI智能体，通过统一的闭环推理-行动框架，可在移动、网页和桌面环境中运行。为推动实际部署，我们协同扩展三个关键维度：(1) 环境，覆盖超过170个双语移动应用及原生桌面操作系统；(2) 任务，采用深度研究管道生成基于功能的指令；(3) 验证，引入逐追踪级与样本级评估器，结合视觉关键点与多模型投票机制，确保训练所需的可靠强化学习信号。此外，我们集成安全感知机制，保障重要操作的可控执行。通过提供一个强大、高效且开源的基础智能体，UI-Venus-2推动该领域向更通用、可验证、自反思的智能体迈进，以服务于真实世界应用。

summary: Competitive programming is increasingly being used to evaluate the algorithmic reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on full-information tasks where all problem inputs are provided upfront. This overlooks a critical dimension of algorithmic reasoning: the ability of generated programs to operate when key information is not revealed upfront. Interactive problems, a distinctive component of competitive programming, embody this challenge. These problems require programs to engage in multi-round interaction with an interactor (a judge program) under strict protocol constraints and limited query budgets, with new information revealed only in response to queries. To address this gap, we introduce InteractBench, a benchmark comprising 322 high-quality interactive problems curated from Codeforces, AtCoder, IOI, and ICPC. Each problem is packaged with executable local interactors, enabling fully offline evaluation. Unlike existing benchmarks, InteractBench assesses whether model-generated code can acquire information and track state dynamically. Our evaluation reveals a significant interaction gap: even the most advanced reasoning models achieve limited success on interactive problems. Beyond success rates, we propose a fine-grained failure taxonomy to diagnose the root causes of these deficiencies. Although algorithmic logic errors remain dominant, protocol violations and query-budget overruns are frequent. Code is available at https://github.com/kmsgk0/InteractBench.
title: InteractBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Competitive Programming under Unrevealed Information
title_translated: InteractBench：在未披露信息条件下对LLM进行编程竞赛基准测试
summary_translated: 编程竞赛正日益被用于评估大语言模型（LLM）的算法推理能力。然而，现有基准主要聚焦于全信息任务，即所有问题输入均提前提供。这忽略了算法推理的一个关键维度：生成程序在关键信息未预先披露时的运作能力。交互式问题作为编程竞赛的独特组成部分，正体现了这一挑战。这类问题要求程序在严格协议约束和有限查询预算下，与交互器（裁判程序）进行多轮交互，仅在响应查询时逐步揭示新信息。为填补这一空白，我们引入InteractBench，一个包含322个高质量交互式问题的基准，问题源自Codeforces、AtCoder、IOI和ICPC。每个问题均附带可执行的本地交互器，支持完全离线评估。与现有基准不同，InteractBench评估模型生成代码是否能动态获取信息并跟踪状态。我们的评估揭示了显著的交互差距：即使最先进的推理模型在交互式问题上也仅取得有限成功。除成功率外，我们还提出了细粒度的失败分类体系，以诊断缺陷根源。尽管算法逻辑错误仍占主导，但协议违规和查询预算超限也频繁发生。代码已公开于https://github.com/kmsgk0/InteractBench。
